items.title: Far-left leader Melenchon in firing line as France blame-game heats up
items.author: Michel Rose, Elizabeth Pineau
items.creator: Michel Rose, Elizabeth Pineau
items.summary: Rivals from the centre-left to the far right have turned on Jean-Luc Melenchon and his France Unbowed (LFI) party, accusing them of fuelling France's worst civil unrest in years.
items.body:
Rivals from the centre-left to the far right have turned on Jean-Luc Melenchon and his France Unbowed (LFI) party, accusing them of fuelling France's worst civil unrest in years.
Melenchon, who launched his fourth presidential bid in May and remains the hard left's strongest hope of reaching next year's election run-off, has faced mounting criticism since unrest engulfed several French cities, with opponents saying years of confrontational rhetoric helped fuel tensions now spilling onto the streets.
Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu sharpened those attacks on Tuesday, telling an LFI lawmaker that the party's "political agenda of instilling violence and chaos in the country was now on full display".
The 75-year-old leader has rejected suggestions that LFI bears responsibility for the unrest, accusing the government instead of failing to address deep-rooted social and economic grievances in France's poorer suburbs.
But criticism has come from across the political spectrum.
Gerard Larcher, the president of the Senate, told Le Figaro this week it was worth considering whether LFI should be banned, a suggestion decried as "authoritarian" by LFI.
Laurent Jacobelli, a spokesperson for Marine Le Pen's National Rally (RN), blamed "the ultra-left, including France Unbowed", as well as what he called uncontrolled immigration, for creating a revolutionary climate.
Marc Fesneau, of centrist party MoDem, said Melenchon had long promoted the idea that "everything must be a battleground".
"When you turn everything into a confrontation, you run serious risks," Fesneau told Reuters.
The attacks underscore both Melenchon's central place in French politics and the unease he provokes as the country heads toward a presidential election expected to pit increasingly strong anti-establishment forces against a [USN:L6N4650JF TEXT:"weakened political centre"].
The unrest has reinforced that contrast, shifting scrutiny onto the hard left while allowing Le Pen to strike a more presidential tone on law and order, an issue that traditionally favours [USN:L8N4611KF TEXT:"the far right"].
Yet with France's political landscape fragmented into three rival blocs and traditional centre-left and centre-right parties struggling, analysts say Melenchon remains a [USN:L5N2WU0KX TEXT:"formidable political force"].
YOUTH APPEAL AND THE 'NEW FRANCE' LFI has built its support by mobilising younger voters, many of whom have grown disillusioned with mainstream politics. An IFOP poll for LCI published this month put Melenchon on 16.5%, behind Le Pen's 36% but ahead of all other mainstream candidates.
A Cluster17 poll found nearly half of 18-to-24-year-olds and more than a third of 25-to-34-year-olds would back Melenchon.
That has made him a prominent voice for many students involved in the protest movement and [USN:L1N4610U5 TEXT:"wider unrest"] that has shaken France in recent weeks.
However, Frederic Dabi, head of pollster IFOP, said the unrest risked reinforcing one of Melenchon's biggest electoral weaknesses: his inability to win over older voters.
"The perception that Jean-Luc Melenchon has been too indulgent towards perpetrators of violence is an absolute red line for a large part of the electorate," Dabi said.
Nevertheless, the party has also built [USN:L1N4250UE TEXT:"strong support in poorer urban areas"] and among many voters from immigrant backgrounds who see themselves reflected in Melenchon's vision of a "New France" — a multicultural republic that embraces ethnic and religious diversity and gives greater political representation to communities that often feel overlooked.
Supporters say that reflects social realities rather than identity politics.
"It's the unique synthesis between a programme of revolutionary rupture and the desire to govern the country," LFI lawmaker Hadrien Clouet told Reuters.
Clouet said that meant tackling inequality and reversing a decades-long [USN:L8N44L1BW TEXT:"transfer of wealth towards finance"] and a narrow oligarchic elite.
Yet critics say LFI often blurs the line between democratic protest and more radical political agitation.
UPRISING LANGUAGE DRAWS SCRUTINY Melenchon has frequently invoked the [USN:L5N2WW5PF TEXT:"language of popular uprising"]. During the pensions crisis of 2023, he urged supporters to "tear down the citadel" of President Emmanuel Macron's government and has at times spoken favourably of "citizen insurrection" as a democratic force.
Supporters say such language refers to mass political mobilisation, not violence. The party officially advocates non-violent action.
LFI and its allies argue some of the accusations are politically motivated. This week, investigative news outlet Mediapart reported, citing an anonymous intelligence officer, that officials had been instructed to portray LFI as being behind the protest movement despite what the source described as a lack of evidence. The government denied the allegation.
Still, opponents say Melenchon's messaging is often deliberately ambiguous.
"They say they are against vandals, but at the same time they justify masks at demonstrations," said Sylvain Maillard of Macron's Renaissance party. "They never calm things down. They always say it's the police's fault. They want chaos."
Former Socialist President Francois Hollande, however, warned against making Melenchon the sole focus of the debate.
"It is not one political party or one individual that poured fuel on the fire," Hollande told France Inter. While criticising LFI for sometimes drawing an equivalence between rioter violence and police violence, he said: "To fixate on LFI is to fail to see what is happening in the country."

items.title: Turquía acogerá a los ministros de Exteriores europeos para tratar los conflictos regionales
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores turco, Hakan Fidan, recibirá este viernes en Estambul a sus homólogos de Egipto, Pakistán, Arabia Saudita, Reino Unido, Francia y Alemania para mantener conversaciones sobre los conflictos regionales, dijo el jueves una fuente diplomática turca.
items.body:
El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores turco, Hakan Fidan, recibirá este viernes en Estambul a sus homólogos de Egipto, Pakistán, Arabia Saudita, Reino Unido, Francia y Alemania para mantener conversaciones sobre los conflictos regionales, dijo el jueves una fuente diplomática turca.
Los siete países se reunirán en este formato por primera vez, por iniciativa de Turquía, según la fuente, en un momento en que las guerras que afectan a Irán, Yemen y Ucrania amenazan las rutas marítimas y la seguridad regional.
Se espera que los ministros debatan la cuestión israelí-palestina, la situación más reciente en el estrecho de Ormuz, los acontecimientos relacionados con Yemen, los esfuerzos para poner fin a la guerra entre Rusia y Ucrania, y las oportunidades para una cooperación más estrecha entre los países de la región y los europeos, añadió la misma fuente.
Se espera que Fidan haga hincapié en la necesidad de una solución diplomática a la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán, en la importancia de la libertad de navegación en los estrechos de Ormuz y Bab el-Mandeb, y que reitere el apoyo de Turquía a la seguridad de Arabia Saudita frente a los ataques de los milicianos hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán, en el marco del Acuerdo de Defensa Conjunta de La Meca firmado entre Turquía, Pakistán y Arabia Saudita, según la fuente.
Asimismo, comunicará a sus homólogos que Turquía ha estado trabajando para evitar que la guerra en Ucrania se extienda al mar Negro, señalando los riesgos para la seguridad regional que plantea el conflicto, añadió la fuente.

ANKARA, Oct 22 (Reuters) – Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan will host his counterparts from Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Britain, France and Germany in Istanbul on Friday for talks on regional conflicts, a Turkish diplomatic source said on Thursday.

The seven countries will meet in this format for the first time, at Turkey’s initiative, the source said, as wars involving Iran, Yemen and Ukraine threaten shipping routes and regional security.

The ministers are expected to discuss the Israeli-Palestinian issue, the latest situation in the Strait of Hormuz, developments related to Yemen, efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war, and opportunities for closer cooperation between the regional and European countries, the person added.

Show Full Article

Fidan is expected to emphasise the need for a diplomatic solution to the war between the United States and Iran, the importance of freedom of navigation in the straits of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb, and reiterate Turkey’s support for Saudi Arabia’s security against attacks by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi militants under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed between Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, the source said.

He will also tell counterparts that Turkey has been working to stop the war in Ukraine spreading to the Black Sea, pointing to the regional security risks posed by the conflict, the source added.

(Reporting by Tuvan Gumrukcu; Writing by Ece Toksabay; Editing by Daren Butler and Xevi Fontdegloria)

items.title: Bitcoin cae por debajo de US$82.000 ante temores por la IA que afectan al mercado
items.author: Suvashree Ghosh
items.summary: El bitcoin cedió las ganancias de la sesión anterior en medio de la presión sobre los activos de riesgo y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad del gasto en inteligencia artificial.
items.body: Bloomberg — El bitcoin retrocedió el jueves por debajo de los US$83.000, cediendo las ganancias de la sesión anterior a pesar de que los inversores volvieron a los fondos cotizados al contado de EE.UU. La criptomoneda original cayó hasta un 2,4% en las primeras horas de negociación en Asia, situándose en torno a los US$82.700 a las 13:00 horas de Singapur. Las criptomonedas de menor capitalización, como Ether, Solana y XRP, también registraron caídas de entre el 2% y el 3,5% aproximadamente. Ver más: JPMorgan ve al bitcoin superando a las acciones, pero advierte sobre un riesgo Este retroceso coincidió con una renovada presión sobre los activos de riesgo, ya que los inversores sopesaban unos resultados mixtos del sector tecnológico y la escalada de tensiones en Medio Oriente, que han impulsado al alza los precios del petróleo. Las acciones asiáticas y los futuros bursátiles estadounidenses registraban pérdidas, mientras que el crudo Brent superaba los US$110. La debilidad de los mercados bursátiles ha empujado al bitcoin “de vuelta a su rango reciente”, afirmó Caroline Mauron, cofundadora de Orbit Markets. “Esperamos que se vuelva a poner a prueba la cota de los US$85.000 en los próximos días, aunque es probable que la convicción siga siendo limitada”, añadió, señalando que las señales de línea dura de la Reserva Federal podrían lastrar la confianza del mercado. La demanda institucional de bitcoin parecía estar repuntando en los últimos días, con fuertes entradas en los ETF. Los ETF de bitcoin al contado cotizados en EE.UU. han registrado entradas netas por valor de US$1.100 millones en lo que va de semana, recuperándose de las salidas de US$909,6 millones registradas en las dos semanas anteriores. Ver más: Este fondo cripto se resiste a la fiebre de la IA y mantiene su apuesta por los activos digitales La valoración de las opciones en Deribit sigue mostrando una preferencia por la protección frente a caídas. Las mayores posiciones abiertas en opciones de venta de bitcoin con vencimiento el viernes se situaban en un precio de ejercicio de US$78.000. El bitcoin ha bajado un tercio desde su máximo histórico, situado por encima de los US$126.000 hace un año. Un repunte desde agosto suscitó ciertas esperanzas de que pudiera volver a alcanzar los US$100.000 este año, aunque la reciente agitación del mercado, debida en parte a las preocupaciones sobre el gasto en inteligencia artificial, ha moderado las expectativas. “El bitcoin se ha mostrado increíblemente resistente ante las perturbaciones macroeconómicas y la corrección en el sector de la inteligencia artificial”, afirmó Pratik Kala, gestor de carteras del fondo de cobertura de activos digitales Apollo Crypto. “Se espera que el próximo movimiento sea al alza”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Xi pide una mejora cualitativa y un crecimiento medible de la economía china
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El presidente de China, Xi Jinping, instó a lograr una mejora cualitativa efectiva y un crecimiento cuantitativo razonable de la economía en un discurso pronunciado el jueves, informó Xinhua.
items.body:
El presidente de China, Xi Jinping, instó a lograr una mejora cualitativa efectiva y un crecimiento cuantitativo razonable de la economía en un discurso pronunciado el jueves, informó Xinhua.
"Debemos impulsar con determinación un desarrollo de alta calidad y satisfacer continuamente las crecientes necesidades del pueblo de una vida mejor", dijo Xi al referirse a la promoción del progreso social integral sin dejar de mantener la estabilidad.
También destacó la necesidad de mantener el "liderazgo absoluto" del Partido Comunista de China sobre las fuerzas armadas y avanzar en el "fortalecimiento político del Ejército", informó la agencia estatal de noticias.
El dirigente mencionó la reforma de las fuerzas armadas y su fortalecimiento mediante la ciencia y la tecnología, así como el talento y una gestión conforme a la ley.
El discurso formó parte de las conmemoraciones del 90º aniversario de la Larga Marcha, una serie de retiradas del Ejército Rojo, liderado por Mao Zedong, para eludir la persecución de las fuerzas nacionalistas de Chiang Kai-shek en 1934 y 1935.

items.title: China Evergrande liquidators recover 1% of debt claims after 2-1/2 years
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China Evergrande Group's liquidators have recovered $435.9 million from asset sales and loan recoveries so far, highlighting the challenge of repaying creditors with claims of about $46 billion against the developer.
items.body:
China Evergrande Group's liquidators have recovered $435.9 million from asset sales and loan recoveries so far, highlighting the challenge of repaying creditors with claims of about $46 billion against the developer.
In their second progress report since a Hong Kong court ordered Evergrande's liquidation in January 2024, the liquidators, Edward Middleton and Tiffany Wong of Alvarez & Marsal, said on Thursday they aimed to make a first interim dividend payment to creditors in the first half of 2027, although the amount has yet to be determined.
Evergrande, once China's top property developer, defaulted on most of its roughly $300 billion in liabilities and became a symbol of the property crisis that has weighed on the world's second-largest economy.
The liquidators said they had raised the $435.9 million through the sale of assets including aircraft, artwork and club memberships, as well as the settlement of loan receivables.
They said 96 of the 107 artworks found at Evergrande's Hong Kong headquarters had been sold for $28.8 million at a loss. The collection included works by Picasso, Monet and Warhol, as well as sculptures by Moore and Hepworth.
Other assets being sold include a private jet expected to fetch about $12 million in the fourth quarter. The liquidators are also seeking a $2 million refund from a US university for part of a donation made in 2020.
The liquidators have taken control of more than 100 Evergrande subsidiaries across multiple jurisdictions, but said prospects for recovering assets held by mainland Chinese subsidiaries were "considered remote".
In August, Evergrande founder Hui Ka Yan, 67, was sentenced to life imprisonment by a Chinese court, which also ordered the confiscation of his personal assets.
Industry experts say Evergrande's liquidation could take more than a decade to complete given the scale and complexity of the group.

items.title: Barclays vai cortar 5.000 empregos em iniciativa de redução de custos impulsionada pela IA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Barclays anunciou que cortará cerca de 5.000 empregos, ou 5% de sua força de trabalho, este ano, à medida que utiliza tecnologias como a inteligência artificial para reduzir custos fixos e melhorar a rentabilidade geral.
items.body:
O Barclays (BARC.L) anunciou que cortará cerca de 5.000 empregos, ou 5% de sua força de trabalho, este ano, à medida que utiliza tecnologias como a inteligência artificial para reduzir custos fixos e melhorar a rentabilidade geral.
Os cortes de pessoal foram apresentados quando o Barclays divulgou lucro no terceiro trimestre de 2,3 bilhões de libras (3,08 bilhões de dólares), acima do registrado no ano anterior, mas abaixo das previsões dos analistas, devido ao desempenho abaixo do esperado do negócio de negociação de renda fixa.
O banco informou ter realizado mais 201 milhões de libras em “medidas de redução de custos estruturais” no terceiro trimestre, como parte de seu plano de longo prazo para reduzir despesas, como custos com pessoal, por meio de maior uso de tecnologia.
Cerca de 60% do total de cortes de pessoal afetará funcionários em funções de apoio, como desenvolvedores, disse a diretora financeira Anna Cross aos repórteres, em um dos sinais mais claros até agora, vindo de um grande banco, de como a IA está permitindo que as empresas reduzam o quadro de funcionários nessas funções.
Cross disse que 1.000 cargos já foram eliminados, com o restante a ser cortado até o final do ano.
As ações do Barclays caíam 2,5% no início do pregão, apresentando desempenho inferior ao de outras instituições financeiras (.SX7P) . As ações do banco caíram 14% neste ano, em linha com os pares europeus, que sofreram correção após anos de alta, à medida que as taxas de juros mais elevadas impulsionaram os lucros.
A Shore Capital afirmou em uma nota que os resultados ficaram abaixo do esperado devido ao desempenho decepcionante do banco de investimentos.
O banco de investimentos do Barclays registrou receita total no terceiro trimestre de 3,1 bilhões de libras, abaixo das previsões de 3,3 bilhões de libras.
Os resultados do terceiro trimestre dos concorrentes do Barclays em Wall Street, divulgados no início deste mês, mostraram a natureza cíclica da receita dos bancos de investimento, à medida que as negociações desaceleraram e as mesas de renda fixa apresentaram desempenho abaixo do esperado, com apenas a negociação de ações mantendo o forte ímpeto observado no primeiro semestre do ano.
(Reportagem de Lawrence White)

items.title: US extends deadline for buyers of Lukoil foreign assets until November 21
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US has extended the deadline for companies to negotiate with Russian oil major Lukoil about buying its foreign assets until November 21, according to the US Office of Foreign Assets Control.
items.body:
The US has extended the deadline for companies to negotiate with Russian oil major Lukoil (LKOH.MM) about buying its foreign assets until November 21, according to the US Office of Foreign Assets Control.
The deadline was extended after the US private equity firm Carlyle Group [USN:L1N45V07F TEXT:"dropped"] its bid earlier this month.
Washington imposed sanctions in October 2025 on Lukoil, Russia's second-largest oil producer, and Rosneft (ROSN.MM) , its top producer, to reduce Moscow's ability to pay for its military campaign in Ukraine .
Lukoil's assets were put up for sale last year, while Rosneft has not announced any divestments.
Carlyle had [USN:L1N3YU0AY TEXT:"initially agreed"] on January 29 to buy Lukoil's assets, excluding those in Kazakhstan.
The fund was in talks to partner with Abu Dhabi-based funds Mubadala, XRG and IHC, as well as the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation for the deal, according to people familiar with the matter.
The Lukoil portfolio, initially valued at around $22 billion, had attracted interest from at least a dozen companies including Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) and the former owner of Pornhub, Bernd Bergmair.
items.raw_description: The US has extended the deadline for companies to negotiate with Russian oil major Lukoil about buying its foreign assets until November 21, according to the US Office of Foreign Assets Control.

items.title: Denmark to order missiles from Covenant, Kongsberg, TV2 reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: NATO member Denmark will on Thursday announce deals to acquire long-range precision missiles for the first time as the Nordic country seeks to beef up its security, Danish TV2 reported, citing anonymous sources.
items.body:
NATO member Denmark will on Thursday announce deals to acquire long-range precision missiles for the first time as the Nordic country seeks to beef up its security, Danish TV2 reported, citing anonymous sources.
The government in Copenhagen said last year that it intended to [USN:L5N3V40IT TEXT:"buy long-range offensive weapons"] to counter a Russian military threat to Europe, drawing sharp condemnation from Moscow.
Denmark's Defence Minister Jeppe Bruus will on Thursday announce an agreement to buy the Anthem missile type made by [USN:L8N4510P2 TEXT:"U.S. defence firm Covenant"], TV2 reported
The Nordic country will also buy Joint Strike Missiles for its F-35 fighter jets, the report said. The JSM is made by Norway's Kongsberg (KOG.OL) and US group Raytheon
Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen last year said the Danish military would "buy, buy, buy" new weapons after years of budget cuts, in a move triggered by the war in Ukraine
Russia's embassy in Copenhagen did not immediately respond to a request for comment

items.title: ATP blocks 234,000 abusive comments from reaching players, fans
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Social media abuse was directed at over 85% of men's tennis players attracting engagement online in the past year, with the ATP blocking some 234,000 comments from reaching them or fans, the governing body said on Thursday.
items.body:
Social media abuse was directed at over 85% of men's tennis players attracting engagement online in the past year, with the ATP blocking some 234,000 comments from reaching them or fans, the governing body said on Thursday.
The ATP based the findings on an analysis of more than 3.7 million comments across ATP and player social media channels by its Safe Sport initiative, which uses AI-enabled moderation and specialist threat assessment.
It said more than 284,000 abusive comments were identified, and over 82% of them were removed in real time. During its [USN:L4N3UD0GR TEXT:"first year"], the programme identified and hid upwards of 162,000 comments containing "severe" abuse.
"Player welfare sits at the heart of the ATP's safeguarding work," said Andrew Azzopardi, the ATP director of safeguarding.
"Preventing more than 234,000 abusive comments from reaching players and fans demonstrates the tangible impact the programme is having every day. Online abuse has no place in tennis.
"We will keep investing in the technology, expertise and partnerships that protect players, and we will continue working with the authorities to hold those responsible to account."
ANONYMOUS ABUSERS Tennis players, like many athletes, often have to deal with the wrath of anonymous abusers online, many of whom are [USN:L6N43I0IJ TEXT:"bettors"], with French player Gael Monfils humorously hitting back at some of them following an early defeat in Stuttgart last year.
Monfils, 40, said at the time he was surprised people still put money on him to win against much younger opponents.
Online abuse is not confined to [USN:L4N3TY0AE TEXT:"angry gamblers"], with American [USN:L1N45T0DY TEXT:"Coco Gauff"] saying earlier this month she received an "insane" amount of racist abuse at the China Open, [USN:L6N45X03Y TEXT:"prompting condemnation"] from the United Nations Human Rights Office.
World Tennis, the WTA, the All England Club and the United States Tennis Association have launched monitoring services that use a combination of artificial intelligence and open-source data to help protect players.
The French Open has also made AI-powered software available for players to block online harassment and hate speech.

items.title: The Azores are showing the world what ocean leadership looks like
items.author: Sylvia Earle
items.creator: Sylvia Earle
items.summary: When I was a child, no ship could take cameras, let alone humans, into the deep ocean to see the extraordinary life below. We knew little about the world under the surface of the sea. Today, we can explore seamounts, observe deep-sea creatures in their own homes, and ask questions that were unimaginable even a generation ago.
items.body:
When I was a child, no ship could take cameras, let alone humans, into the deep ocean to see the extraordinary life below. We knew little about the world under the surface of the sea. Today, we can explore seamounts, observe deep-sea creatures in their own homes, and ask questions that were unimaginable even a generation ago.
Yet the more we learn about the ocean, the more we understand the magnitude of how much remains to be explored and the urgency of protecting the vast living realm that has shaped and maintains the habitability of Earth.
I was reminded of this recently in the Azores, an autonomous region of nine islands that lie in 1,500 kilometres off the coast of Portugal, where I had the honour of becoming godmother to the Azores Ocean, a new research vessel.
To me, the beauty of a ship is not simply in its appearance, but in what it can do. This vessel gives scientists new ways to investigate the Atlantic and bring its hidden wonders into view.
And there is no better place for us to do that than in the Azores, which in October 2024 established the Azores Marine Park , a marine protected area covering 287,000 square kilometres, the largest MPA in the North Atlantic. Half of the area is fully protected and the other half is “highly protected”.
While nations around the world have committed to protecting at least 30% of the ocean by 2030 , only around 10% is currently protected, well below that target. The fact that the Azores have already taken a major step towards the 30% goal is something worth celebrating, and an example worth following.
Dr Sylvia Earle, right, during a dive at Midway Atoll National Wildlife Refuge in the North Pacific. Amanda Meyer/USFWS/Handout via REUTERS The Azores are also part of something much larger. Through the charity I founded, Mission Blue , these islands and their surrounding waters are recognised as a Hope Spot, one of a growing global network of special places critical to the health of the ocean. Hope Spots are championed by people who understand that protecting the ocean begins with recognising its value and taking protective actions.
Their conservation effort did not happen overnight. Scientists working in the Azores have spent decades investigating the waters around these islands, revealing deep-sea habitats, remarkable biodiversity and the vulnerabilities of marine life. Their discoveries helped build the knowledge base that the Azores government needed to establish the MPA two years ago.
The new vessel represents a major investment in the next chapter of that work. The technology on board is extraordinary, but it is the people asking questions, making discoveries and seeking to understand the ocean who will give it purpose. And in the Azores, there are world-class scientists who have dedicated years of their lives to doing just that.
We are living at once in the greatest era of ocean exploration and a time of profound loss. Now we know what our predecessors did not and could not know. The ocean is Earth's life-support system. It shapes our climate, generates much of the oxygen we breathe and sustains life from microscopic organisms to the great whales that frequent Azorean waters.
Caring for it is not an optional luxury. For too long, we have behaved as though the ocean were too vast to harm and too resilient to fail. We have learned otherwise within my lifetime. The same knowledge that reveals the damage also gives us a remarkable opportunity to choose a different path.
The Azores show what can happen when scientific knowledge is met with the determination to act. Research matters. So do the decisions made by leaders, the participation of communities and the people whose livelihoods are tied to the sea.
The Azores Ocean, a new research vessel.which is enabling scientists to find new ways to investigate the Atlantic. Marinha Portuguesa/Handout via REUTERS In fact, 100% of humankind and all living things depend on the ocean for our existence. And protection must mean more than lines on a map. Effective management, monitoring, communication, and enforcement are what turn a designation into lasting conservation.
From the Azores to communities across the world, Hope Spots bring together people, science, and a shared commitment to protecting the places that matter most to the ocean's future.
Each Hope Spot has its own challenges and opportunities, but together they demonstrate how local action can contribute to global change.
In Rio de Janeiro, for example, a new 3,000-hectare marine protected area has been established safeguarding important fish nursery habitats and ecosystems supporting traditional coastal communities, supported in part through Rolex's Perpetual Planet Initiative.
In California, the Chumash Indigenous community supported the creation of the Point Sal MPA , which falls within the Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary Hope Spot. The MPA was approved following three years of advocacy by tribal leaders, scientists and coastal communities, safeguarding the area’s marine habitats indefinitely from seabed mining and oil drilling.
The people of the Azores, however determined, cannot protect the ocean alone. But they have demonstrated that ambitious protection can move from aspiration to reality. They have shown that positive change is possible.
Children today inherit unprecedented knowledge and unique opportunities to choose an enduring future. With knowing comes caring, and with caring, there is hope for actions that will ensure an enduring, prosperous future.
The ocean keeps us alive. It is time to act as though our lives depend on protecting it. Because they do.

Today, we can explore seamounts, observe deep-sea creatures in their own homes, and ask questions that were unimaginable even a generation ago.

items.title: Meta coloca agente Muse no centro de estratégia de IA; planeja novas ações para impulsionar investimentos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Meta lançou na quarta-feira novas ações sem direito a voto para ajudar a financiar a expansão em IA da gigante das redes sociais, enquanto os executivos apresentaram sua visão de organizar o futuro da empresa em torno do negócio emergente de agentes de IA.
items.body:
A Meta lançou na quarta-feira novas ações sem direito a voto para ajudar a financiar a expansão em IA da gigante das redes sociais, enquanto os executivos apresentaram sua visão de organizar o futuro da empresa em torno do negócio emergente de agentes de IA.
As ações da controladora do Facebook e do Instagram subiam mais de 4% no pregão prolongado. A Meta também previu uma receita no quarto trimestre acima das estimativas de Wall Street e divulgou um forte crescimento de seu novo aplicativo de agente de IA para consumidores, o Muse.
A empresa vem investindo pesadamente em chips avançados e centros de dados para competir de forma mais agressiva com os líderes do mercado de IA, OpenAI e Anthropic, impulsionando-a para a vanguarda de uma corrida emergente por agentes de IA para consumidores, ao mesmo tempo em que corrói seu fluxo de caixa livre.
A Meta emitirá uma nova classe de ações ordinárias Classe C sem direito a voto em janeiro de 2027, resultando efetivamente em um desdobramento de duas por uma, para financiar aquisições e reter os melhores talentos, mantendo ao mesmo tempo o controle do presidente-executivo Mark Zuckerberg.
Zuckerberg afirmou que mais de 10 milhões de pessoas nos EUA e no Canadá criaram contas no Muse em um mês e meio e que o crescimento continua forte.
CUSTOS MAIS ALTOS Ainda assim, Zuckerberg reconheceu que os custos de oferecer o Muse eram mais altos do que aqueles associados a muitos outros novos produtos da Meta ao longo dos anos e disse que passaria a monetizar o agente “um pouco mais cedo do que o previsto em nosso plano normal”.
A diretora financeira, Susan Li, previu que os negócios de IA da Meta começariam a gerar receita incremental em 2027 e se tornariam “uma fonte significativa de diversificação de receita ao longo do tempo”.
Os executivos também enfatizaram que a IA seria o foco daqui para frente para a unidade Reality Labs da Meta, que vem registrando prejuízos e liderou a iniciativa da Meta de construir o “Metaverso”, um mundo digital imersivo que inspirou a mudança de nome do Facebook para Meta em 2021.
A Meta elevou o limite inferior de sua previsão de gastos anuais, esperando agora que os gastos de capital fiquem entre US$135 bilhões e US$145 bilhões este ano, acima dos US$130 bilhões a US$145 bilhões previstos anteriormente.
A receita do terceiro trimestre ficou acima do esperado, em US$64,60 bilhões, superando as estimativas de Wall Street de US$63,37 bilhões, de acordo com dados compilados pela LSEG.
A empresa também projetou uma receita para o quarto trimestre entre US$73 bilhões e US$76 bilhões, acima das estimativas de US$73,73 bilhões.
(Reportagem de Jaspreet Singh em Bengaluru e Katie Paul em Nova York)

items.title: Alibaba lidera caída de tecnológicas de Hong Kong tras nueva medida regulatoria de China
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.summary: Las acciones de Alibaba cayeron hasta un 6,3% después de que China exigiera normas más estrictas de calidad a las plataformas de comercio electrónico. El movimiento presionó al índice Hang Seng Tech, ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Las acciones de Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. ( BABA ) registraron su mayor caída en dos meses después de que las autoridades chinas convocaran a los operadores de comercio electrónico y exigieran normas más estrictas en materia de calidad de los productos, lo que ejerció presión sobre el sector tecnológico de Hong Kong. Las acciones del gigante chino del comercio electrónico cayeron hasta un 6,3% el jueves, su mayor caída desde el 24 de agosto. El índice Hang Seng Tech se desplomó hasta un 5,2%, la mayor caída intradía desde el 17 de julio. Alibaba fue también el factor que más contribuyó a la caída del índice de referencia de Hong Kong, el Hang Seng, que llegó a registrar un descenso del 3,2 %. Ver más: Bolsas asiáticas caen por dudas sobre la IA mientras el petróleo sube por tensiones en Medio Oriente La caída del jueves pone de relieve los retos normativos y empresariales a los que se enfrenta el sector del comercio electrónico chino, en un momento en que las empresas tratan de mantener el crecimiento en sus negocios principales al tiempo que aumentan el gasto en inteligencia artificial y otras tecnologías punteras a las que Pekín da prioridad. A la cautela generalizada de los inversores en el mercado se suma la expiración de un período de gracia de 90 días concedido a las familias acaudaladas para liquidar los impuestos sobre los fideicomisos extraterritoriales. “Este tipo de ‘recordatorio’ sobre la calidad no es nuevo en el sector, pero da la sensación de que no tiene fin”, afirmó Steven Leung, CEO de UOB Kay Hian. “El impacto en los beneficios ha ido disminuyendo, pero se nota más a nivel de confianza”. Según un comunicado de la Administración Estatal de Regulación del Mercado, asistieron a la reunión representantes de Alibaba y otras plataformas importantes, entre ellas JD.com Inc. ( JD ), PDD Holdings Inc. ( PDD ), Xiaohongshu Technology Co., Kuaishou Technology, ByteDance y Vipshop Holdings ( VIPS ). El índice Hang Seng Tech está atravesando una racha muy dura, con una caída del 31% en lo que va de año, ya que los inversores se preguntan si el enorme gasto de las grandes empresas tecnológicas en inteligencia artificial generará una rentabilidad suficiente. El índice está a punto de perder todas las ganancias que ha obtenido desde el amplio paquete de medidas de estímulo de Pekín en septiembre de 2024. Ver más: Alibaba desafía a Meta con sus nuevas gafas inteligentes con IA desde US$450 Algunas de las empresas de comercio electrónico del sector, tradicionalmente rentables, también se han enfrentado a dificultades, lo que ha suscitado inquietudes en torno al consumo de efectivo, el escrutinio regulatorio y la intensa competencia. “Parece que la ola de ventas en el sector del comercio electrónico chino, en particular en Alibaba, forma parte de una tendencia más amplia de reducción del riesgo”, afirmó Gerald Gan, director de inversiones de Reed Capital Partners Pte. “Las preocupaciones son similares a las que afectan a las acciones estadounidenses del sector de la inteligencia artificial, ya que los inversores se cuestionan cada vez más la magnitud del gasto en inteligencia artificial y si las valoraciones actuales están justificadas”. Los inversores también seguían de cerca la expiración de un periodo de gracia fiscal. A finales de julio, China tomó medidas para gravar los fideicomisos extraterritoriales en poder de sus ciudadanos, cerrando así una laguna jurídica que las familias acaudaladas habían utilizado para proteger y transmitir sus fortunas. Los titulares disponían de un plazo de gracia de 90 días, que finalizaba el 22 de octubre, para liquidar lo que adeudaban sin recargos por demora, y algunos participantes en el mercado relacionaron las recientes ventas de participaciones por parte de los principales accionistas con el plazo fiscal. “Se debe a que hoy vence el plazo de presentación de declaraciones fiscales para los fideicomisos extraterritoriales”, afirmó Bosco Wu, estratega del Bank of East Asia, refiriéndose a la caída bursátil registrada este jueves en Hong Kong. “También observamos que algunos accionistas mayoritarios de empresas privadas que cotizan en bolsa han reducido su participación accionarial, lo que probablemente esté relacionado con la cuestión fiscal y esté lastrando el ánimo del mercado”. items.title: Havells India posts quarterly profit rise on strong cables demand
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Consumer electronics and power distribution equipment maker Havells India reported a nearly 10% rise in second-quarter profit on Thursday, helped by strong demand across its portfolio that spans wires, cables and home appliances.
items.body:
Consumer electronics and power distribution equipment maker Havells India (HVEL.NS) reported a nearly 10% rise in second-quarter profit on Thursday, helped by strong demand across its portfolio that spans wires, cables and home appliances.
Consolidated net profit rose to 3.50 billion rupees ($36.89 million) in the quarter ended September 30 from 3.19 billion rupees a year earlier
Revenue jumped 34.6% to 64.32 billion rupees
Demand for electrical and infrastructure-linked products remained strong in the quarter
The cables business, Havells' largest segment, posted nearly 48% revenue growth, aided by commodity-linked price increases and a shift toward higher-sized cables, the company said
Investments in housing and power networks continued to support sales in the segment
Havells said consumption demand remained steady despite elevated inflation, while healthy operating leverage helped drive a 30.5% rise in EBITDA
However, volatility in aluminium prices weighed on margins in the cables business
($1 = 94.8100 Indian rupees)

items.title: South African operator regains longest train record with hundreds of wagons
items.author: Joe Van Wonderen
items.summary: A South African operator set a new record for the world’s longest freight train on Monday. The 696-car, 7.6-kilometre-long train, operated by the national rail operator Transnet Freight Rail (TFR), ...
items.body: A South African operator set a new record for the world’s longest freight train on Monday. The 696-car, 7.6-kilometre-long train, operated by the national rail operator Transnet Freight Rail (TFR), chugged from Saldanha to the Northern Cape on an 861-kilometre-long track, the company said on Tuesday. “The exercise was undertaken as a dynamic train evaluation programme with the dual objective of pursuing a world record and advancing technical knowledge in train design, train handling and operational performance,” according to the firm’s news release. Using electric and diesel-electric locomotives interspersed along the length of the train, the company said it was able to “operate as a synchronized unit, enabling the controlled distribution of traction and braking forces across the train’s entire length.” Australian mining company BHP previously held the world record with a train nearly seven kilometres long, according to Guinness World Records. That train consisted of 682 ore cars pushed by eight diesel-electric locomotives, set in June 2001. TFR chief executive Russell Baatjies said although the South African train ran empty, the operation “is a significant achievement.” “The real value lies in the technical knowledge and operational insights gained through this exercise,” he said. “These learnings will contribute to the continued advancement of rail operations, support innovation and strengthen our freight rail capability into the future.” The Iron Ore Export Line that TFR ran its record-setting exercise on links Sishen in the Northern Cape to Saldanha in the Western Cape. The country’s mining activity is largely concentrated north of Johannesburg and Pretoria, clustered between South Africa’s borders with Botswana, Zimbabwe and Mozambique. South Africa exported more than two million kilograms of iron products in 2024, according to the World Integrated Trade Solution. About a quarter of that went to Canada, 582,198 kilograms of product valued at approximately US$4.36 million. TFR had held the longest-train-record since 1989, before losing it to Australia.

items.title: 英バークレイズ、5000人削減へ　第3四半期利益は予想未達
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lawrence White

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lawrence White

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] - 英大手銀行バークレイズは、２０２６年中に従業員の５％に当たる約５０００人を削減すると発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）などの技術を活用して固定費を大幅に削減し、全体の収益性を高める。

同時に発表した第３・四半期決算は利益が２３億ポンド（３０億８０００万ドル）と、前年同期から増加したものの、アナリスト予想を下回った。債券トレーディング事業が振るわなかった。

Ｃ・Ｓ・ベンカタクリシュナン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、同行が伝統的に強みとしてきた債券トレーディングの不振について、値動きが激しかったことに加え、特に金利・クレジット商品の取引が低調だったことを理由に挙げた。

同行は第３・四半期に「構造的なコスト削減策」に伴う費用を追加で２億０１００万ポンド計上したと明らかにした。技術の活用を拡大し、人件費などを削減する長期計画の一環という。

アンナ・クロス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団に対し、削減対象の約６割は開発者などの支援部門の従業員になると述べた。ＡＩの活用によってこうした職種の人員削減が可能になっていることを示した。クロス氏によると、既に１０００人を削減しており、残りも年末までに削減する。

バークレイズ株は序盤の取引で２．５％下落した。

＜投資銀行部門はまちまち＞

ショア・キャピタルはリポートで、投資銀行部門の業績が振るわず、決算は予想を下回ったと指摘した。

投資銀行部門の総収入は３１億ポンドと、予想の３３億ポンドを下回った。

株式部門の収入は４７％増加した。ロイターが各社の発表資料を基に計算したところ、米大手５社の平均は３７％増で、バークレイズはこれを上回った。

一方、債券トレーディング収入は１９％減の１０億ポンドとなった。米同業他社の５％減より落ち込みが大きく、アナリスト予想の１３億ポンドも下回った。

items.title: As Americans eat out less, paper towel maker Essity feels the pinch
items.author: Vera Dvorakova, Jesus Calero
items.creator: Vera Dvorakova, Jesus Calero
items.summary: Essity is seeing greater weakness among the US restaurants it supplies than the European ones, the CEO of the Swedish hygiene products maker said on Thursday, as rising prices and a slowing jobs market put pressure on American household budgets.
items.body:
Essity (ESSITYa.ST) is seeing greater weakness among the US restaurants it supplies than the European ones, the CEO of the Swedish hygiene products maker said on Thursday, as rising prices and a slowing jobs market put pressure on American household budgets.
"Consumers are not going out to restaurants as much as they do in Europe," Ulrika Kolsrud told Reuters.
The trend is hitting Essity's professional hygiene business, which sells products such as Tork paper towels to restaurants and other businesses, and generates 40% of its revenue in the US. The unit's sales, volumes and prices all fell in the third quarter, and Essity also flagged higher costs of goods sold.
Kolsrud's comments reflect the strain faced by US consumers, whose wages are struggling to keep pace with [USN:L1N45Z0VZ TEXT:"inflation"] while companies [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"pull back"] on hiring.
US consumer prices rose 3.7% in September from a year earlier, outpacing average hourly wage growth of 3.0% over the past 12 months. Meanwhile, employers excluding farms added just 29,000 jobs during the month.
A Gallup survey published on Wednesday showed that only 39% of Americans ate at restaurants at least once a week, down from 53% in 2019.
Consumer goods companies have been walking a fine line between raising prices to offset higher input costs and protecting demand after several years of inflation-driven hikes.
Essity management said it was again raising prices across business areas to offset higher raw material and energy costs, having previously lowered them in some categories.
The pressure from higher prices is the sharpest at the lower end of the income scale. The latest Federal Reserve survey, covering 2022 to 2025, [USN:L6N45V0Q8 TEXT:"showed"] that income gains for the less well-off did little to build wealth, and net worth for the bottom fourth of households fell by more than 50%.
items.raw_description: Essity is seeing greater weakness among the US restaurants it supplies than the European ones, the CEO of the Swedish hygiene products maker said on Thursday, as rising prices and a slowing jobs market put pressure on American household budgets.

items.title: Greece says it is implementing sanctions linked to Iran
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Greek finance ministry said on Thursday it was implementing sanctions in place linked to Iran and that it backed efforts to effectively combat money laundering and the financing of terrorism.
items.body:
The Greek finance ministry said on Thursday it was implementing sanctions in place linked to Iran and that it backed efforts to effectively combat money laundering and the financing of terrorism.
The statement comes after the US Treasury Department said on Wednesday it imposed sanctions on Karnakis & Karnakis, a law firm based in Greece and Panama, saying it had for years provided legal assistance to Iranian shipping networks.
The Treasury also said that the US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network issued [USN:L1N4670VZ TEXT:"an administrative subpoena"] to advance an investigation into a Greek bank, which it did not name.
The Greek finance ministry said it had taken note of the US Treasury statement, adding that "all available information is being evaluated, and appropriate measures are being taken in accordance with established procedures and applicable national, EU, and international law."

items.title: India's JSW Paints eyes 4, 5-year debt to refinance acquisition-led funding, bankers say
items.author: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.summary: India's JSW Paints is likely to raise funds through issuance of bonds maturing in four years and five years and should go ahead with the sale in the next couple of weeks, two merchant bankers with direct knowledge of the matter said on Thursday.
items.body:
India's JSW Paints is likely to raise funds through issuance of bonds maturing in four years and five years and should go ahead with the sale in the next couple of weeks, two merchant bankers with direct knowledge of the matter said on Thursday.
The company could look to raise around 30 billion rupees ($316.56 million), the bankers said.
The bankers requested anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to media. JSW Paints did not reply to a Reuters email seeking comment.
The proceeds of the latest debt issuance are likely to be used for the refinancing of an earlier fundraise the company put towards its acquisition of Akzo Nobel India last year, the bankers added.
In November 2025, JSW Paints had raised 33 billion rupees through sale of five-year bonds, which were directly placed with large foreign banks and foreign investors. These bonds had a put option at the end of a year.
Indian companies have been turning to the bond market to fund acquisitions in recent months, driven by robust demand from investors that's contributing to what [USN:L4N4620TZ TEXT:"may become a record year"] for corporate debt issuance in the country.
($1 = 94.7675 Indian rupees)

items.title: Russia-linked hackers used decentralised network in Ukraine cyberattack, ESET says
items.author: Leo Marchandon
items.creator: Leo Marchandon
items.summary: Russia-linked hackers used a decentralised volunteer-run network to conceal communications during an attack on a Ukrainian grain logistics company, marking the first documented case of a state-linked group using the network this way, ESET researchers said.
items.body:
Russia-linked hackers used a decentralised volunteer-run network to conceal communications during an attack on a Ukrainian grain logistics company, marking the first documented case of a state-linked group using the network this way, ESET researchers said.
The attack culminated in the destruction of data at the company in September 2025. Researchers say the technique could make hacking operations harder to identify and disrupt because decentralised networks do not rely on a single centrally controlled server.
Agriculture accounted for roughly a fifth of Ukraine's economy and nearly half its [USN:L8N46305V TEXT:"exports"] before the war, according to research estimates, and Russia has targeted the sector throughout the conflict, bombing ports, grain elevators and fields.
Slovakia-based cybersecurity firm ESET said the attackers gained access to the company's systems in July 2025 through a phishing email carrying a malicious attachment.
The attackers later installed software that allowed them to remotely control compromised computers, browse files, take screenshots and steal documents before data was wiped from the company's systems on Sept. 17, 2025.
ESET attributed the data destruction to Sandworm, a hacking group widely linked to Russian military intelligence and previously blamed for cyberattacks on Ukrainian and [USN:L6N3YO13R TEXT:"Polish"] power grids.
The malicious software communicated through a server hidden inside Yggdrasil, an experimental volunteer-run network with no central owner, the first use of such a network that ESET has documented by a state-linked group.
ESET said it believed one Russia-linked hacking group gained the initial access before handing control to Sandworm, although it could not determine which group operated the newly identified malware.
The firm did not identify the victim company.

items.title: Italia y España levantan los controles fronterizos impuestos tras la llegada de migrantes a Ceuta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italia y España han acordado levantar los controles fronterizos para los ciudadanos de ambos países, dijo el jueves el Ministerio del Interior italiano, poniendo fin a una disputa de tres meses desencadenada por la afluencia de migrantes al enclave español de Ceuta.
items.body:
Italia y España han acordado levantar los controles fronterizos para los ciudadanos de ambos países, dijo el jueves el Ministerio del Interior italiano, poniendo fin a una disputa de tres meses desencadenada por la afluencia de migrantes al enclave español de Ceuta.
El Gobierno de derechas italiano suspendió por primera vez sus acuerdos de fronteras abiertas con España el 31 de julio y alegó que quería asegurarse de que ningún migrante que entrara en Ceuta pudiera continuar su viaje hacia su territorio.
Madrid respondió tomando medidas similares contra Roma y calificó la decisión italiana de "injusta, contraria a los intereses de la UE, y discriminatoria para la población española".
Los ministros del Interior de Italia y España mantuvieron una conversación telefónica y acordaron no prorrogar la suspensión de los acuerdos de Schengen de fronteras abiertas de la Unión Europea, según el comunicado italiano.
"La decisión, tomada tras una cuidadosa evaluación de la situación, irá acompañada de medidas reforzadas de intercambio de información para garantizar la plena seguridad del espacio común de Schengen", añadió el ministerio.

items.title: More LaLiga clubs join pact to cap ticket prices for away fans
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Three more clubs in Spain's top division have joined an agreement to cap away ticket prices at a maximum of €30 ($34), a spokesperson for LaLiga told Reuters on Thursday, meaning 17 clubs in the 20-team league now participate.
items.body:
Three more clubs in Spain's top division have joined an agreement to cap away ticket prices at a maximum of €30 ($34), a spokesperson for LaLiga told Reuters on Thursday, meaning 17 clubs in the 20-team league now participate.
LaLiga is strengthening the reciprocal agreement between clubs as [USN:L6N467107 TEXT:"AC Milan fans boycott their visit to Udinese"] over away ticket prices of €65 ($73)
The agreement, in place since the 2023-24 season, also ensures a minimum of 300 tickets are made available to travelling fans
Away ticket sales have increased by 33% per game on average, according to LaLiga data.
England's Premier League has a cap of £30 pounds ($40) for away fans.
German's Bundesliga guarantees 10% of available capacity for away support, with their tickets matched to home prices.
European governing body UEFA's regulations require 5% of stadium capacity to be allocated for away fans with a price cap of €50 ($56,20) in the Champions League
The LaLiga spokesperson did not name the three additional Spanish teams joining the price cap scheme
($1 = 0.8898 euros)

items.title: BOURSE ID Logistics bondit de près de 10%, le T3 sur-performe en France comme à l'étranger
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'action ID Logistics bondit en Bourse jeudi, le groupe français de transport ayant fait état la veille d'une nette hausse de son chiffre d'affaires trimestriel, les investisseurs saluant la performance supérieure aux attentes et les perspectives de croissance.
items.body:
L'action ID Logistics bondit en Bourse jeudi, le groupe français de transport ayant fait état la veille d'une nette hausse de son chiffre d'affaires trimestriel, les investisseurs saluant la performance supérieure aux attentes et les perspectives de croissance.
À Paris, vers 08h45 GMT, l'action se hisse en tête du SBF 120 (.SBF120) et décolle de 9,5% à 370 euros, l'indice reculant de 1,21% au même moment.
Le groupe [USN:FWN467236 TEXT:"a publié"] mercredi soir un chiffre d'affaires en progression de 25,6% sur un an au troisième trimestre, à 1,17 milliard d'euros, et a cité dans un communiqué la dynamique commerciale portée par ses clients internationaux.
"ID Logistics continue de surperformer quel que soit le contexte, y compris en France !", s'enthousiasme dans une note jeudi Florent Thy-tine, "Head of Equity Research" chez TP Icap Midcap, saluant une publication "une nouvelle fois plus que satisfaisante".
Le courtier rappelle que l'activité d'ID Logistics en France ne représente plus que 20% de son activité, "et que même en France le groupe parvient à maintenir un niveau de croissance satisfaisant malgré un contexte compliqué".
La croissance du groupe en Amérique du nord a bondi de 48,1% sur un an à données comparables, tandis que l’Europe hors France a grimpé de 23,4%.
"ID Logistics est ainsi le dossier à avoir en portefeuille dans le contexte actuel", souligne Florent Thy-tine.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Wen-Yee Lee　Fanny Potkin

[台北／シンガポール ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Wen-Yee Lee　Fanny Potkin

[台北／シンガポール ２２日 ロイター] - 半導体受託生産世界最大手の台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）は、工場設備に使用されるレアアース（希土類）部品の代替案を模索している。事情に詳しい関係筋３人が明らかにした。中国政府による輸出規制が世界最先端の半導体工場の操業に支障をきたすリスクを軽減することを目的としている。

レアアース磁石は、ＴＳＭＣが運営するような高度に自動化された工場で見られる機械を含め、産業用機器のモーターに広く使用されている。

関係筋によると、ＴＳＭＣは工場自動化設備におけるレアアース不使用モーターの採用について、サプライヤーへの調査を実施している。関係筋の１人は、この取り組みは中国からの供給途絶の可能性に対する懸念が背景にあると述べた。

関係筋２人によると、取り組みはなお初期段階にあり、レアアースを含まない設備の広範な導入には至っていない。

ＴＳＭＣはコメント要請に応じていない。

items.title: Turkey to host regional and European foreign ministers for talks on regional conflicts, source says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan will host his counterparts from Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Britain, France and Germany in Istanbul on Friday for talks on regional conflicts, a Turkish diplomatic source said on Thursday.
items.body:
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan will host his counterparts from Egypt, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Britain, France and Germany in Istanbul on Friday for talks on regional conflicts, a Turkish diplomatic source said on Thursday.
The seven countries will meet in this format for the first time, at Turkey's initiative, the source said, as wars involving Iran, Yemen and Ukraine threaten shipping routes and regional security.
The ministers are expected to discuss the Israeli-Palestinian issue, the latest situation in the Strait of Hormuz, developments related to Yemen, efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war, and opportunities for closer cooperation between the regional and European countries, the person added.
Fidan is expected to emphasise the need for a diplomatic solution to the war between the United States and Iran, the importance of freedom of navigation in the straits of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb, and reiterate Turkey's [USN:L6N4670PY TEXT:"support for Saudi Arabia's security"] against attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi militants under the [USN:L6N4440IT TEXT:"Mecca Joint Defence Agreement"] signed between Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, the source said.
He will also tell counterparts that Turkey has been [USN:L6N45U0U5 TEXT:"working to stop"] the war in Ukraine spreading to the Black Sea, pointing to the regional security risks posed by the conflict, the source added.

items.title: Lula hopes older voters can help power him to victory against Flavio Bolsonaro
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
items.summary: Rony Amaral, 71, is terrified right-wing Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro will slash healthcare and pension spending if he wins Sunday's runoff vote, so he is supporting leftist Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva instead.
items.body:
Rony Amaral, 71, is terrified right-wing Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro will slash healthcare and pension spending if he wins Sunday's runoff vote, so he is supporting leftist Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva instead.
Amaral and his 91-year-old mother Aisa form part of a growing cohort of voters in fast-ageing Brazil who could play a decisive role in the razor-tight election.
Since 2010, the number of voters over 60 has grown by 74%, according to IBGE, the government statistics agency, and they today make up nearly 25% of Brazil's electorate, increasing their political weight.
Polls show a growing share of them support Lula, who has overseen one of the largest and most generous welfare programs in Brazil's history during his three presidential terms. He is neck and neck with Bolsonaro going into Sunday's vote.
"What I see is a fear among people over 60 that they will be left without care," Amaral said. "Even some on the right share this fear."
According to pollster Quaest, Lula leads among seniors with 48% of voting intention. It found 42% plan on voting for Bolsonaro, who scores less highly than his father, ex-President Jair Bolsonaro, did among the same demographic at this stage in the 2022 presidential election.
OVERLOOKED DEMOGRAPHIC Despite their growing importance, seniors have traditionally been overlooked in Brazilian campaigns, said Cila Schulman, chief executive of polling firm Ideia.
Lula's campaign is now actively targeting the so-called "Lula generation" — seniors aged over 70, close in age to the 80-year-old president — hoping their support can help overcome the two-point gap between Bolsonaro and Lula in the first round.
The party has launched a website aimed at seniors with the aim of persuading more older voters to go to the polls.
"In the first round, I wasn't enthusiastic, but now that the race is so close, I'm going," said Ana dos Reis, 76, who lives in a low-income neighborhood in northern Sao Paulo. "Who knows, maybe my vote is what Lula needs to win?"
FEAR OF LOSING WELFARE GAINS Unlike younger voters, who polls show tend to back Bolsonaro, older voters' support for Lula is linked to memories of improvements in living standards, including minimum wage hikes, investment in public health, and other benefits linked to Lula's earlier governments, Schulman said.
"It's a memory that younger people don't have," Schulman said.
Some seniors fear their benefits could diminish under a Bolsonaro government, since he is under pressure to trim Brazil's heavy public debt, and could target welfare spending.
Others are concerned about what a Bolsonaro win would mean for Brazilian democracy, remembering how supporters of former President Bolsonaro attacked government buildings in January 2023 after he lost to Lula in Brazil's last election, according to research from the leftist incumbent's Workers' Party, known as PT.
Near Manaus, in northern Brazil, Olga Darc Pimentel, 78, told Reuters she was deeply concerned by the runoff.
"We remember the terror of the pandemic here," Pimentel said, referring to the elder Bolsonaro's widely criticized handling of the coronavirus outbreak, adding that she plans to vote for Lula and is encouraging others to do the same.
Bolsonaro's campaign did not respond to requests for comment, but he can still count on plenty of elderly voters.
Isaltina Rosa Peixoto, 73, a retired civil servant, said she believes Bolsonaro will continue and refresh his father's legacy.
"I'm not afraid because I know he'll do what's best," she said at a pro-Bolsonaro rally in Rio de Janeiro.
items.raw_description: Rony Amaral, 71, is terrified right-wing Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro will slash healthcare and pension spending if he wins Sunday's runoff vote, so he is supporting leftist Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva instead.

カプコンは必要な緊急対策を完了し、ＩＤを使ったサービスは引き続き利用でき、すべてのゲームでプレイへの影響はないとしている。

１９日に不正アクセスの疑いのある痕跡が見つかり、アクセス遮断や原因・影響調査の調査に着手、同日に不正アクセスを確認した。調査の結果、２０日に顧客情報が一部漏えいしたことが判明したという。

items.title: UN expert urges Indonesia to reconsider involvement in Trump's Gaza board
items.author: Stanley Widianto, Gibran Peshimam
items.creator: Stanley Widianto, Gibran Peshimam
items.summary: Indonesia should reconsider its involvement in US President Donald Trump's Gaza peace plan because it is being shaped by Israel and the US and lacks a Palestinian voice, the United Nations special rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories told Reuters on Thursday.
items.body:
Indonesia should reconsider its involvement in US President Donald Trump's Gaza peace plan because it is being shaped by Israel and the US and lacks a Palestinian voice, the United Nations special rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories told Reuters on Thursday.
The "[USN:L6N45Q023 TEXT:"Board of Peace,"]" of which Indonesia is a key troop-contributing member, was unveiled by Trump in January to address global conflicts typically handled by the United Nations. The world's largest Muslim-majority nation has also [USN:L6N40008Q TEXT:"pledged troops"] to be deployed to Gaza as part of an international stabilisation force.
Francesca Albanese, a prominent human rights lawyer known for her vocal criticism of Israel, said in an interview in Jakarta that Indonesia has historically supported the Palestinian cause, but joining the board was dangerous.
Indonesia's Foreign Ministry said on Thursday that Board of Peace discussions remained on hold, reiterating its earlier position.
Albanese has drawn the ire of a number of Western capitals. The US has imposed sanctions on her, and others, including her own native Italy, have called for her resignation.
"I understand (Indonesia's) good intentions. I still think that it's very dangerous, because it risks to normalise a very abnormal mechanism," she said.
Albanese said that, legally, Israel could not have a role in determining the future of Palestinians.
Rights experts have criticised the board for not including a Palestinian representative even though it is meant to supervise the temporary governance of a Palestinian territory.
The Board of Peace did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside US business hours.
Indonesia, which backs a two-state solution and has repeatedly condemned Israeli violence, has drawn criticism from domestic Muslim groups for agreeing to join the board, which also counts Israel as a member.
President Prabowo Subianto [USN:L6N3ZU1AE TEXT:"has vowed to quit"] if it does not bring benefits to Palestinians, his office has previously said, adding that joining the board would allow Indonesia to push for cessation of violence.
Albanese said Indonesia risked compromising its close ties with Palestinians. "It's very risky to do so when the rules are set by Israel," she said.
Albanese recommended Jakarta join the Hague Group of countries, which includes South Africa and Indonesia's neighbour Malaysia and seeks to uphold international law and processes, including in the International Criminal Court over Israel's actions.
Trump's Gaza plan has stalled. [USN:L1N45F09E TEXT:"A 2025 ceasefire"] secured the release of the remaining hostages held by Hamas and hundreds of Palestinian prisoners and detainees, but efforts to disarm Hamas and secure an Israeli withdrawal have faltered, while Israeli forces continue near-daily attacks in Gaza.
Israel's government has denied accusations, including by a UN commission and international and Israeli rights groups, that it is committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.

items.title: Rain delays start of final day of South Africa-Australia test
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rain delayed the start of play on the last day of the second test with South Africa needing six wickets against Australia to level the three-match series at St George’s Park on Thursday.
items.body:
Rain delayed the start of play on the last day of the second test with South Africa needing six wickets against Australia to level the three-match series at St George’s Park on Thursday.
Early lunch was taken after several abortive efforts to get play under way, leaving South Africa with only two sessions to try and force a result as Australia trail by 170 runs at 156-4 in their second innings after being forced to follow-on.
Play is set to resume at noon local time (1000 GMT).
Travis Head on 87 and nightwatchman Scott Boland (2) will resume the tourists' efforts at holding out while Steve Smith is available after a neck issue restricted him on Wednesday, when he batted with obvious discomfort but still top scored for Australia with 28 in their first innings of 99 and reached the milestone of 11,000 career test runs.
Smith did not come out to bat in his regular No. 4 spot in the second innings, staying in the changing room receiving treatment, but on Thursday morning he warmed up with the rest of the team.

items.title: Italy, Spain lift border controls brought in after Ceuta migrant rush
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy and Spain have agreed to lift border controls on each other's citizens, the interior ministry in Rome said on Thursday, ending a three-month dispute triggered by the rush of migrants into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta.
items.body:
Italy and Spain have agreed to lift [USN:L8N44S0K4 TEXT:"border controls"] on each other's citizens, the interior ministry in Rome said on Thursday, ending a three-month dispute triggered by [USN:L1N43X0ZO TEXT:"the rush of migrants"] into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta.
Italy's right-wing government first suspended its open-border arrangements with Spain on July 31, saying it wanted to make sure no migrants entering Ceuta could travel on to its territory.
Madrid responded by taking similar action against Rome, describing the Italian measures as "unjust, contrary to European Union interests, and discriminatory to the population of Spain".
The Italian and Spanish interior ministers spoke on the phone and agreed not to extend their suspension of the European Union's open-border Schengen arrangements, the Italian statement said.
"The decision, reached after a careful assessment of the situation, will be accompanied by enhanced information-sharing measures to ensure the full security of the common Schengen area," the ministry added.
(This story has been refiled to correct the day to Thursday, from Friday, in paragraph 1.)

items.title: 三菱自がホンダ向けピックアップ開発、四輪で初の相互補完　東南ア投入へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maki Shiraki

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maki Shiraki

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - ホンダと三菱自動車は２２日、三菱自のピックアップトラック「トライトン」をベースとするホンダ向けモデルの開発で覚書を締結したと発表した。ホンダは東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）地域などでこのピックアップトラックを投入し、２０２８年中の販売開始を目指す。両社にとって四輪車の相互補完は初めて。三菱自は生産台数の増加によりタイの生産拠点における稼働率向上を図る。

トライトンは、ＡＳＥＡＮを中心に需要が旺盛な１トンクラスのピックアップトラック。堅牢なラダーフレーム構造を採用する三菱自の世界戦略車で、ホンダはトライトンを活用し、ピックアップトラックを持たない地域で迅速かつ効率的に品ぞろえを拡充する。

今回の取り組みは、ホンダ、三菱自、日産自動車の３社が２４年８月に結んだ戦略的パートナーシップの枠組みに基づいている。３社は各社が競争力を持っている車種や技術を相互に活用し、各地域の需要や事業環境に応じた商品展開を進める方針。

items.title: Saudi Arabia seeks access to foreign strategic oil reserves for Aramco
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Aramco CEO Amin Nasser said Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry is discussing access to government-held oil storage abroad as Houthi attacks on key infrastructure raise concerns over supply disruptions ...
items.body: By Salma El Wardany Saudi Arabia is in talks with foreign governments to give state-owned Aramco access to their strategic oil storage, as the kingdom seeks to make its supplies to customers more resilient during disruptions, Chief Executive Officer Amin Nasser said. The move follows a flurry of attacks by Yemen’s Houthis on key Saudi infrastructure, including drone strikes that shut down its most important pipeline for several days in September. On Wednesday, attacks on Aramco’s Shaybah oil field and Dammam airport each killed two people, according to Saudi authorities.  Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel on Thursday as the violence heightened concerns about further disruptions to Saudi supplies.   “Commercial storage available through partners is limited. The larger capacity lies in what we call strategic storage owned by governments,” Nasser said in an interview with Al Arabiya on Thursday. “The Ministry of Energy is working with its counterparts in other countries to make strategic storage available for Aramco.” The company already holds commercial oil storage in South Korea, Japan, the Netherlands and Egypt’s Mediterranean export hub of Sidi Kerir. “We have maintained these overseas inventories for many years, but we are working to expand them, particularly in Asia,” Nasser said. Aramco wants to double its overseas capacity, Nasser said, without giving a timetable for the expansion or disclosing current capacity. The push forms part of a broader effort to reinforce Saudi Arabia’s infrastructure and export options during the regional crisis. Aramco currently has three main export corridors — the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb, and Sidi Kerir on the Mediterranean. The conflict prompted the company to begin engineering studies to increase its capacity to move crude from the Persian Gulf in the east to the Red Sea in the west to 10 million barrels a day from 7 million, alongside work on other routes, Nasser said. “We did not wait for the crisis to end,” Nasser said. Building resilience requires “decades of investment and preparation.”

items.title: スイス中銀、為替介入の必要性低下と判断＝議事要旨
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [チューリヒ ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[チューリヒ ２２日 ロイター] - スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）が２２日公表した９月の金融政策決定会合の議事要旨によると、中銀はスイスフランの上昇を抑えるために外国為替市場に介入する必要性が低下したとの認識を示した。

米国によるイラン攻撃を受け、フラン高を抑えるための為替介入に一段と前向きな姿勢を示していた。

中銀は他の通貨圏の金利が相対的に高いことから、フランは６月の政策金利決定以降、約３％下落したと分析した。安全資産としてのフラン需要も乏しかったとした。

引き続き為替市場で介入する用意があるものの、その必要性は低下したと指摘した。「現在の環境では、介入に一段と前向きな姿勢を維持する必要はなくなった」との見解を示した。

９月の会合では、今後数カ月のインフレ率がやや高めに推移するとの見通しを示しながらも、大方の予想通り政策金利を０％に据え置いた。

議事要旨によると、スイスのインフレ率を中期的に目標の０─２％に収める上で、現在の金融環境は「適切」と判断した。

インフレ率の上昇は主に原油高によるもので、経済のほかの分野に波及する兆しはみられないとしている。

items.title: エルメス、第3四半期は前年比4.3％増収　中国低迷で予想下回る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tassilo Hummel　Alessandro Parodi

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tassilo Hummel　Alessandro Parodi

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - 仏高級ブランドのエルメスが２２日発表した第３・四半期売上高（為替変動の影響を除いたベース）は前年同期比４．３％増の４１億ユーロ（４６億ドル）となったものの、主要市場である中国での需要低迷により、既製服・アクセサリー部門の売上が数年ぶりに減少したことから、アナリストの予想成長率５．２％を下回った。

同社の株価は序盤に８％下落した。

エリック・デュハルグエ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団との電話会見で、中国市場は「非常に厳しい」状況にあるとしつつ、長期的な見通しについては引き続き自信を持っており、同国への投資を継続すると述べた。

四半期の増収率としては、パンデミック（新型コロナウイルス大流行）の影響で世界中のブティックを閉鎖せざるを得なかった２０２０年初頭以来最も低くなった。

有名バッグ「バーキン」を製造する皮革製品部門の売上高は１０．８％増加し、おおむねこれまでの四半期並みの伸びを示した。しかし、四半期売上高の４分の１以上を占める既製服・アクセサリー部門の売上高は２％減少した。

デュハルグエ氏によると、この減少は主に中国における大量販売型アクセサリーの需要低迷によるものであり、その他の全ての地域では同部門の売上は引き続き伸びた。

対照的に、同社は米国での販売状況については楽観的な見方を維持。デュハルグエ氏によると、米国内ではあらゆるロケーションと商品カテゴリーが成長をけん引した。

同氏はまた、バーキンの人気は「依然として健在」と述べ、今後数年間、総生産量を約６％増加させるというペースを維持していくと付け加えた。

items.title: Fehler in Programmiersprache bringt IT-Experten um ihren Schlaf
items.author: Hakan Ersen
items.creator: Hakan Ersen
items.summary: Schwachstellen in der populären Programmiersprache PHP haben einen Wettlauf zwischen Webseitenbetreibern und Cyberkriminellen ausgelöst. Die einen arbeiteten am Donnerstag mit Hochdruck daran, eine aktualisierte Version der Software zu installieren, während die anderen die Sicherheitslücken auszunutzen versuchten. Weltweit nahmen Unternehmen, Behörden und andere Organisationen ihre Internetauftritte vorübergehend vom Netz, um ihre IT-Systeme zu schützen.
items.body:
Schwachstellen in der populären Programmiersprache PHP haben einen Wettlauf zwischen Webseitenbetreibern und Cyberkriminellen ausgelöst. Die einen arbeiteten am Donnerstag mit Hochdruck daran, eine aktualisierte Version der Software zu installieren, während die anderen die Sicherheitslücken auszunutzen versuchten. Weltweit nahmen Unternehmen, Behörden und andere Organisationen ihre Internetauftritte vorübergehend vom Netz, um ihre IT-Systeme zu schützen.
Der Cybersicherheitsfirma Cloudflare (NET.N) zufolge löste das Bekanntwerden der PHP-Fehler eine Flut von Attacken aus. In den Stunden davor habe es einige tausend Versuche gegeben, die Sicherheitslücken auszunutzen, schrieb Unternehmenschef Matthew Prince auf dem Kurznachrichtendienst X. "Diese Zahl stieg in den 45 Minuten nach der Bekanntgabe auf Zehntausende, innerhalb von zwei Stunden auf Hunderttausende und geht mittlerweile in die Millionen." Die Zahl der durch die Schwachstellen potenziell gefährdeten Server und Anwendungen beziffert die Cybersicherheitsfirma Palo Alto Networks auf mehr als 22 Millionen weltweit. Schätzungen zufolge basieren etwa zwei Drittel bis drei Viertel aller Webseiten auf PHP.
REGE UPDATE-TÄTIGKEIT "Die größeren Betreiber scheinen die Updates bereits eingespielt zu haben", sagte Felix Kuhlenkamp, Leiter Sicherheit beim Digitalverband Bitkom. "Nichtsdestotrotz wird uns das Thema noch lange beschäftigen. Es wird weiterhin Applikationen geben, die nicht auf dem aktuellen Stand sind. Die Frage ist dann, ob dies Konsequenzen für andere Anwendungen hat." Der deutsche Cloud-Anbieter und Webhoster Ionos (IOSn.DE) teilte am Donnerstagmorgen mit, er habe das PHP-Update bereits eingespielt. Lediglich Ionos-Kunden, die eigene Server betrieben, müssten selbst aktiv werden. Der Branchendienst Censys warnte jedoch, dass 1,5 Millionen der weltweit 2,6 Millionen Webseitenbetreiber eine veraltete PHP-Version nutzten, für die es kein Sicherheitsupdate gibt.
Die PHP-Sicherheitslücke habe IT-Verantwortlichen eine schlaflose Nacht beschert, sagte Microsoft (MSFT.O) -Chef Satya Nadella auf einer Veranstaltung in Köln. "So etwas habe ich schon lange nicht mehr gesehen." Es sei ein Weckruf und erinnere die Verantwortlichen daran, dass man bei IT-Systemen nicht nur einzelne Anwendungen betrachten dürfe, sondern auch die Abhängigkeiten im Blick behalten müsse.
ECKPFEILER DES WORLD WIDE WEB PHP dient als Basis für zahlreiche Webanwendungen wie Online-Shops oder Portale der öffentlichen Verwaltung. In dieser Sprache ist zudem das Softwarepaket WordPress programmiert, mit dem auch Privatpersonen Webseiten erstellen und veröffentlichen können. Die Schwachstellen seien bereits vor längerer Zeit durch Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) aufgedeckt worden, teilten zwei Cybersicherheitsfirmen unabhängig voneinander mit. Seither wurde an einer Lösung gearbeitet. Die Lücken seien mehr als ein Jahrzehnt lang unentdeckt geblieben.
"Früher war das Aufspüren von Sicherheitslücken die größte Herausforderung", sagte Madeline Lawrence, Mitgründerin der Softwarefirma Aikido Security. "Die neuesten KI-Modelle machen dies sowohl für Angreifer als auch für Verteidiger wesentlich einfacher. Es erfordert weniger Zeit, Geld und Fachwissen, um eine Schwachstelle für einen Angriff zu nutzen." Dadurch werde es immer schwieriger, rasch Gegenmaßnahmen zu ergreifen.
Die Entwickler von PHP hatten am Mittwochnachmittag (MESZ) eine aktualisierte Version (PHP 8.5.12) veröffentlicht und eindringlich dazu geraten, diese umgehend zu installieren. Das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI) schloss sich dieser Aufforderung ebenso an wie das chinesische Industrieministerium. Die südkoreanische Regierung ergriff Notfallmaßnahmen.

Indonesian president's allies distance themselves from flagship free meals programme

A poll conducted in early October by a research firm showed about 62 per cent of the public opposed the programme.

People take part in a rally demanding an end to the government's free nutritious meal programme, following cases of food poisoning, in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, on Sep 8, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Dwi Obl)

JAKARTA: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto's big-tent coalition has given him almost unchecked power for two years, but mass food poisoning and graft linked to his flagship free meals programme have emerged as the first major test of their support for the former special forces commander.
Two political parties in the coalition have already decided, after internal deliberations, to distance themselves from the programme, senior members from both parties with knowledge of the discussions told Reuters. A member of a third coalition party said their party feared the problems with the scheme would hurt their electoral prospects. 
Together, the parties of the three people, who asked not to be identified because they feared repercussions for criticising Prabowo's policies, represent more than a quarter of his coalition's 80 per cent parliamentary majority, which includes seven of the eight parties in the house. Prabowo's Gerindra party has 15 per cent. 
"Loyalty must also have limits," a member of one of the parties, which was once a vocal defender of the programme, told Reuters.
