Prabowo made providing free, nutritious meals a cornerstone of his election campaign, promising to reach 83 million children and pregnant women, but several incidents of mass food poisoning, logistical challenges and allegations of corruption have left many Indonesians questioning the multibillion dollar initiative. 
A poll conducted in early October by Saiful Mujani Research and Consulting (SMRC) showed about 62 per cent of the public opposed the programme, while approval for the president himself fell to the lowest since he took office.
"What are the limits? The survival of our party," the party member said, adding internal polls showed the party's electability had fallen in July from January. They did not give further details of the confidential survey meant only for internal party consumption.

Related:

Indonesian officials say government-supplied meals tested after more than 500 students fall ill

Two years into presidency, Indonesia’s Prabowo faces tough balancing act between ambitious promises and fiscal discipline

"If by mid-2027 there are no improvements, the coalition will be fragile and things may eventually fall apart on their own," they said. Indonesia's next elections are due in early 2029.
Until now, Prabowo - who marks two years in office this week - has faced little or no pushback. There have been no dissenting votes in parliament on any bills the government has proposed, not even by the one party that is not formally part of the ruling bloc. Nor has the leader of Southeast Asia's largest economy faced any speeches critical of his policies. 
FALLING NUMBERS Tensions in Prabowo's coalition have risen as the president's approval rating has declined.
Last November, the president had an 81 per cent rating, according to SMRC. That fell to 66.4 per cent in March, 51 per cent in July and 44.5 per cent in October.
Positive opinions of the free meals programme have also slumped - from 62 per cent last November to just over a third in the most recent poll.
In June, authorities arrested a former chief of the programme and two other officials on corruption charges.
On Aug 31, dozens of families filed a police complaint against the government, marking the first legal action over the programme that started in January 2025. Early last month, about 1,700 people fell ill in four separate incidents after eating the meals, bringing the total number of cases of food poisoning to at least 57,000 since launch.
The president's office and the National Nutrition Agency (NNA), which runs the initiative, did not respond to requests for comment.
Sugiat Santoso, the Gerindra spokesperson, said the coalition remained strong and the programme was not intended to secure electoral gains. 
"Every political party has its own targets and we respect that ... Whatever their stance, related to free meals or not, supporting Prabowo or not, we respect it," Sugiat said, adding that the NNA was working to improve the programme.

Students rest while receiving treatment for food poisoning at the regional general hospital after eating government-sponsored free school meals in Pati, Central Java province, Indonesia, on Sep 9, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Ragil Kuswanto)

The National Mandate Party, one of the six parties in Prabowo's coalition, said it remained committed to supporting the programme. Any shortcomings should be addressed "systematically and collectively," said Viva Yoga Mauladi, its deputy chief. 
The other parties did not respond to Reuters requests for comment. 
SYMPATHY FOR VICTIMS A senior member in a second coalition party said an increasing number of voters were complaining about the programme. 
The party has asked its lawmakers to start "constructive public criticism" of the scheme using "polite language," the person said. 
Both parties where the senior members said they planned to express their concerns publicly, said they also aimed to push the government to improve the programme.
Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka recently publicly apologised for the food poisoning cases, visiting some of the affected children.
Gibran is the son of Joko Widodo, who defeated Prabowo in the 2014 and 2019 presidential elections, and whose backing was key to Prabowo finally winning the presidency in 2024.   
Prabowo, meanwhile, has publicly defended the initiative. In February, he played down the food poisoning incidents, saying the number of cases was statistically insignificant.
"99.99 per cent of the programme can be considered successful,” he said.

Related:

New head of Indonesia’s free meals programme quits after 45 days citing health reasons, as budget cuts loom

Some remote Indonesian communities still await free meals as programme resumes after review

In August, Prabowo pledged improvements.
"I am determined to continue the free nutritious programme but with improvements and efficiency," he said.
"MAJOR BLOW" The free meals programme has created broader political pressure on coalition parties with ministers from those parties facing criticism and attacks on social media when speaking about it, said Burhanuddin Muhtadi, a senior visiting fellow at Singapore's Yusof Ishak Institute. 
If the scheme failed, it would be a "major blow" for the president given it was central to the 2024 election campaign, he added. 
"Prabowo could revise his policy by making the programme more targeted, so it would be more feasible to manage and would not incur such high budget. However, it appears he has not significantly changed the universal design, proven by the programme's very large budget allocation next year," Burhanuddin said. The government has budgeted 240 trillion rupiah for the scheme next year.
The problems with the free meals programme are unfolding as the president faces economic challenges from the cost of living to MSCI's warning that it could exclude Indonesia from its stock market indices, potentially cutting it off from international capital.
"Prabowo must demonstrate commitment and integrity, not only making statements," said Mohammad Ezha Fachriza Roshady, SMRC's researcher.

items.title: France reports first human case of livestock virus Shamonda
items.author: Sybille de La Hamaide
items.creator: Sybille de La Hamaide
items.summary: France on Thursday reported the first human case of the Shamonda virus usually found in livestock in a patient who later died, with authorities adding there was no risk to the general population at this stage.
items.body:
France on Thursday reported the first human case of the Shamonda virus usually found in livestock in a patient who later died, with authorities adding there was no risk to the general population at this stage.
Transmitted by biting midges and most commonly found in cattle, Shamonda has also been found in horses, alpaca, sheep and goats, the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) said.
"The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control is carefully monitoring the situation after the French authorities announced the first ever reported human infection with Shamonda virus, a disease that has until now only affected animals," the Stockholm-based ECDC said in a statement.
"ECDC is in contact with the French authorities and European partners to investigate the potential public health implications."
The French announcement said the leading hypothesis was that the patient was infected in eastern France, where the virus had circulated among animals this spring and summer.
"Based on the knowledge available regarding this virus, no health risk to the general population has been identified to date," it said.
The ECDC said the patient died in early October and noted the victim had been receiving treatment for a serious illness that made them more susceptible to infection than the general population.
"Investigations into whether the virus caused or contributed to the patient’s death and how the infection was acquired are ongoing," it said.
There are currently no commercially available vaccines against Shamonda virus, WOAH said.
Identified in Nigeria in the mid-1960s, Shamonda was first confirmed in Europe in late July after genomic tests on sick cattle in southern Germany, Switzerland and eastern France.
A report from France's weekly animal health surveillance bulletin said the virus had also been detected in Austria, Belgium, Ireland, Italy, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal, Slovenia, Spain, and UK's Jersey.
A study of French nine dairy farms found milk output fell by up to 75% in affected herds.

items.title: ネスレ既存事業売上高4％増、予想上回る　ロシア事業を連結除外
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Alexander Marrow

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Alexander Marrow

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] - スイス食品大手ネスレが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は、既存事業売上高の伸び率が４％と、市場予想の３．４％を上回った。通期の伸び率は３─４％との見通しを維持した。

アンナ・マンツ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、ロシアによる事業接収を受け、グループ売上高の約２％を占めるロシア事業を９月末から連結対象から外したと明らかにした。既存事業売上高や販売数量、価格への影響はないとした。

ただ第４・四半期からは決算上の売上高、基礎的営業利益、フリーキャッシュフローに影響が出るという。マンツ氏は純資産を連結貸借対照表から除外することで、２０２６年の純負債が約９億スイスフラン（１０億９０００万ドル）増加すると説明した。

ネスレはロシアの資産１６億フランを連結貸借対照表から除外し、為替換算調整の累計額として約１４億フランの非現金費用を計上するとした。

第３・四半期の値上げ率は１．１％と、アナリスト予想平均の１．９％を下回った。販売数量の伸びを示す実質内部成長率（ＲＩＧ）は２．８％と、予想の１．５％を上回った。

items.title: TSMC seeks factory-equipment alternatives to thwart China's rare earths grip, sources say
items.author: Wen-Yee Lee, Fanny Potkin
items.creator: Wen-Yee Lee, Fanny Potkin
items.summary: Taiwan's TSMC is exploring alternatives to rare-earth components in factory equipment, three people familiar with the matter said, aiming to reduce the risk that Beijing's export controls could disrupt operations at plants that make the world's most advanced chips.
items.body:
Taiwan's TSMC (2330.TW) is exploring alternatives to rare-earth components in factory equipment, three people familiar with the matter said, aiming to reduce the risk that Beijing's export controls could disrupt operations at plants that make the world's most advanced chips.
The move, reported for the first time, underscores how China's grip on rare earths has become a vulnerability for the global semiconductor industry after the country last year put certain rare-earth materials, magnets and related processing technology under export controls, requiring licences.
Rare-earth magnets are commonly used in motors that power moving parts in industrial equipment, including machinery found in highly automated factories such as those operated by TSMC. A shortage of such specialised parts could disrupt chip production for customers in smartphone, AI system, data centre and defence supply chains.
TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, has surveyed suppliers on using rare-earth-free motors in factory-automation equipment, according to three industry executives briefed by the company on its plans. One of the people said the effort was driven by concerns about potential supply disruptions from China.
The discussions remain at an early stage and have not yet resulted in a broad rollout of rare-earth-free equipment, according to two of the people.
TSMC declined to comment.
WASHINGTON AND TAIPEI SEEK ALTERNATIVES TSMC's efforts follow statements from the United States and Taiwan that they would begin looking for ways to reduce their reliance on Chinese rare-earth and critical-mineral supply chains.
In June, Raymond F. Greene, the director of the American Institute in Taiwan, Washington's de facto embassy in Taipei, said the United States is working with Taiwan and other partners to develop alternative sources of supply, expand processing capacity and build more resilient supply chains.
Taiwan's Economy Minister Kung Ming-hsin said in February that the government would give support to the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI), a domestic research organisation, to develop rare-earth technologies, with plans to establish a pilot production line within three years that could meet an estimated 50% of the island's domestic demand.
US officials have shown particular interest in ITRI's work and have engaged the institute in talks about diversifying critical-mineral supply chains, according to a person at a US-based think tank familiar with the discussions. The US State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
In a statement, ITRI said it was working with the Department of Industrial Technology at Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs to plan a rare-earth project. It did not provide further comment.

items.title: Bhaskar Sunkara Thinks the Market Has a Place Under Socialism
items.summary: In September, Gallup released a poll that showed that 43% percent of Americans viewed socialism positively, the highest approval since Gallup began the poll back in 2010. Since Zohran Mamdani won the NYC mayoral election, the left has made a number of gains across national politics. As a longtime DSA member and veteran of leftist media, Bhaskar Sunkara is one of socialism's leading advocates, and he's spent much of his career charting what a socialist economy in America might look like. Unlike some other leftists, he believes the market has a place. In fact, he thinks markets and entrepreneurs are an objective good in society. He proposes a vision of so-called "market socialism" in his recent co-authored book The Blueprint, and he lays out this system for us in today's episode. We talk about how many features of capitalism — from small businesses to monetary policy — might be remade under socialist principles. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: イットリウムが日本で枯渇するという事実ない＝木原官房長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - 木原稔官房長官は２２日午後の記者会見で、レアアース（希土類）のイットリウムの在庫が底をつく恐れがあり、日本政府が米国政府に対し中国の輸出制限を緩めるよう説得を要請したとの一部報道に関連して「わが国でイットリウムが枯渇するといった事実はない」と述べた。

木原官房長官は、イットリウムを含むレアアースの安定供給確保はわが国の企業活動や経済安全保障の観点から重要な課題との認識を示した。その上で、中国による重要鉱物の輸出管理に伴う影響について、普段から米国などと連携し、中国への申し入れや供給源の多角化など強靭な供給網構築に向けた施策に取り組んでいると説明した。引き続き、中国の輸出管理動向による影響を注視し、適切に対応する考えを示した。

items.body:
At least four people have died in storms and flooding in southern France, authorities said late on Wednesday, as western regions braced for another storm approaching from Ireland.
Dozens of people moved to emergency shelters in Mouries and Saint-Martin-de-Crau — two small towns between Montpellier and Marseille — and at least one person was injured, officials said
Roads and train lines in the area were disrupted, Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot wrote in a post on X
Forecasters said the weather would settle down in the south
But Storm Austen was expected to bring heavy winds across the northwest later on Thursday into Friday, weather agency Meteo France said

items.title: 中国の自然災害、1─9月で直接被害額300億ドル＝応急管理省
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [香港 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - 中国応急管理省は２２日、国内の自然災害による直接被害額が今年１─９月に１９９３億６０００万元（２９９億ドル）に達したと発表した。主に台風、洪水、土砂崩れによるものという。

前年同期比では８％減少した。

同省によると、８月にネパール・チベット一帯で発生した土石流では５６２人が死亡または行方不明となっており、これまでの公式集計と変わっていない。

被災者数と死者数の大半は、中国南西部と南部に集中。１─９月の自然災害による死者および行方不明者は計１１６２人に上り、前年同期の７４２人から増加した。

東部沿岸の各省では、台風が相次いで上陸したため、物的損害と経済的損失が最も甚大だった。

この９カ月間、全国で５００万人以上が避難を余儀なくされたり、緊急避難所を求めたりした。

items.title: インドネシア、株主集中銘柄を主要指数から除外　11月2日から
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[ジャカルタ ２２日 ロイター] - インドネシア証券取引所（ＩＤＸ）は２２日、株式保有が特定の株主に集中している企業の銘柄を１１月２日からジャカルタ総合株価指数の構成銘柄から除外すると発表した。

• 除外はインドネシアの資本市場改革の一環。指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩはこれに先立ち、インドネシア株式市場の分類を「新興国市場」から「スタンドアローン市場」に格下げする可能性があると警告していた。

• ＭＳＣＩは、支配的な株主が一部の取引を操作している疑いがあると懸念を示している。

• ＩＤＸは以前、株式保有の集中度が高い銘柄のリストに８０銘柄を掲載、指数全体の構成比率の約１８％を占めると説明していた。

• ＩＤＸによると、ジャカルタ総合指数の定期見直しは今後、毎年１月、４月、７月、１０月に実施する。従来は３月、６月、９月、１２月に実施していた。

items.author: Isabella Farr
items.summary: Barclays busca reducir costos y simplificar su estructura para liberar recursos destinados a inversión. Los recortes equivalen a cerca del 5% de su plantilla global, que rondaba los 93.000 empleados a ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Barclays Plc ( BCS ) ha anunciado que va a suprimir 5.000 puestos de trabajo como parte de una iniciativa para reducir costos, y ha añadido que la inteligencia artificial está empezando a generar mayor eficiencia. Esto afectaría a alrededor del 5% de los empleados del banco, según una presentación realizada el jueves. A finales de 2025, Barclays contaba con unos 93.000 empleados en todo el mundo. Ver más: Barclays registra ingresos récord en renta variable, pero su negocio de renta fija decepciona El banco, con sede en Londres, afirmó que estaba “reduciendo estructuralmente” los costos para “generar capacidad de inversión”. Según la presentación, señaló que se centra en simplificar la organización y aumentar la eficiencia, impulsado por la inteligencia artificial. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Trotz Gewinnplus - Barclays streicht 5000 Stellen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die britische Großbank Barclays hat trotz eines Gewinnanstiegs den Abbau von rund 5000 Stellen angekündigt. Das Unternehmen setze auf Technologien wie Künstliche Intelligenz (KI), um Fixkosten zu senken und die Gesamtrendite zu verbessern, teilte das Institut am Donnerstag mit. Finanzchefin (CFO) Anna Cross erklärte, rund 60 Prozent des geplanten Stellenabbaus entfielen auf unterstützende Funktionen, etwa im Bereich der Softwareentwicklung. Dies sei eines der bisher deutlichsten Signale einer Großbank dafür, wie KI es Unternehmen ermögliche, die Mitarbeiterzahl in solchen Bereichen zu verringern. 1000 Stellen seien bereits weggefallen, der Rest solle bis Jahresende abgebaut werden, so Cross.
items.body:
Die britische Großbank Barclays (BARC.L) hat trotz eines Gewinnanstiegs den Abbau von rund 5000 Stellen angekündigt. Das Unternehmen setze auf Technologien wie Künstliche Intelligenz (KI), um Fixkosten zu senken und die Gesamtrendite zu verbessern, teilte das Institut am Donnerstag mit. Finanzchefin (CFO) Anna Cross erklärte, rund 60 Prozent des geplanten Stellenabbaus entfielen auf unterstützende Funktionen, etwa im Bereich der Softwareentwicklung. Dies sei eines der bisher deutlichsten Signale einer Großbank dafür, wie KI es Unternehmen ermögliche, die Mitarbeiterzahl in solchen Bereichen zu verringern. 1000 Stellen seien bereits weggefallen, der Rest solle bis Jahresende abgebaut werden, so Cross.
Im dritten Quartal verbuchte die Bank einen Anstieg des Vorsteuergewinns um zwölf Prozent auf 2,3 Milliarden Pfund. Dies erlaube einen neuen Aktienrückkauf im Umfang von 500 Millionen Pfund. Bankchef C. S. Venkatakrishnan erklärte, er sei mit der anhaltenden operativen und finanziellen Dynamik zufrieden. Die Anleger zeigten sich jedoch nicht überzeugt: Die Aktie gab im frühen Handel um 2,5 Prozent nach.
Die Ergebnisse zeichneten ein gemischtes Bild, insbesondere im Investmentbanking. Während die Erträge im Aktienhandel um 47 Prozent zulegten und damit die US-Konkurrenz übertrafen, brachen sie im Handel mit festverzinslichen Wertpapieren um 19 Prozent ein. Dies war ein stärkerer Rückgang als bei den US-Rivalen. "Ich bin enttäuscht, und Sie können sicher sein, dass dies meine volle Aufmerksamkeit erhalten wird", sagte Venkatakrishnan mit Blick auf diesen traditionell starken Bereich. Insgesamt verfehlte die Investmentbank-Sparte mit Erträgen von 3,1 Milliarden Pfund die Analystenschätzungen leicht.

items.author: ロイター

items.body:
中国・香港株式市場は下落。中国の主要株価指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は１５カ月ぶりの安値となり弱気相場入りが確認された。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が、成長とバリュエーションの持続性に対する懸念から急落したことが背景。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は１．８％下落し、４０３６．３０で終了。２０２５年７月以来の安値となった。６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの直近高値から２０．２％下落し、弱気相場の目安とされる２０％下落の水準を超えた。

終値ベースでは、同指数は２００７年に付けた高値を更新しておらず、６月に相場を５年ぶりの高値に押し上げた勢いはその後急速に反転した。

香港のロータス・アセット・マネジメントのマネジングパートナー兼最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、ハオ・ホン氏は「市場は底なしの状況だ」と述べた。

上海総合指数は１．５％下落して終了し１年超ぶりの安値となった。

アジア全域のハイテク主力株に広がった売り、低調な景気刺激策への期待、新たな材料の欠如を背景に、中国市場で広範な売りが加速した。

上昇したのは生活必需品指数と公益事業指数のみ。

ホン氏は「国家隊はためらっている」とし、売り局面でしばしば介入する中国の国有投資ファンドに言及した。

ＣＳＩ半導体指数は３．６％下落、ＣＳＩ人工知能指数は３．３％下落した。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は４．４％急落し、２５年７月以来の安値を付けた。

トレーダーやアナリストによると、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策への失望も市場心理の重しとなっている。また、第３・四半期の経済成長率が予想を上回ったことで、追加の政策支援への期待が後退した。

香港市場では、ハンセン指数が３％下落し、４カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハンセンテック指数は５％下落し、２年ぶりの安値となった。

一部の投資家は、香港上場の中国企業の株主の多くが採用している一般的な仕組みであるオフショア信託に対し、中国政府が所得税の徴収を進める取り組みを、売り圧力のもう一つの要因として指摘した。

ロータスのホン氏は、きょうが税申告の最終日だと指摘。過去数週間の売りは、中国企業の創業者らが主導したとし「納税義務を果たすための現金を調達するため、資産を売却していたのは明らかだ」と述べた。

２２日の下落が大きかった銘柄では、テンセントが２．９％下落、アリババが６％超急落した。

盛期資本（香港）のゼン・ウェンカイＣＩＯは「これほど急激かつ急速な下落は非常にまれで、特にテンセントのような主力銘柄ではなおさらだ。これはおそらくパニック売りの最終局面で、市場の売りは終わりに近づいている」と説明。「ただ、これほどの傷からの回復には時間がかかるだろう」と語った。

ソウル株式市場は３％超下落し、約６カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームを巡る根強い疑念の中、半導体株が利益確定売りで下落した。また、中央銀行のタカ派的な政策姿勢がさらなる利上げを示唆したことも相場の重しとなった。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は前営業日終値比２０１．８９ポイント（３．５２％）安の５５３３．７７で終了し、４月７日以来の安値となった。前日は半導体株の反発を受け３．３％上昇し、６週間ぶりの大幅高を記録していた。

韓国中銀は政策金利を据え置いた一方、経済成長見通しを上方修正し、輸出について楽観的な見方を維持することで、タカ派姿勢を保った。

大信証券のアナリスト、イ・キョンミン氏は「半導体株は利益確定売りで下落した。メタとテスラの決算は、スペースＸやスーパー・マイクロが提供したほどの安心感を与えられなかった」と指摘した。

メタは２１日、第４・四半期の売上高見通しをウォール街の予想を上回る水準で発表し、新たな消費者向けＡＩエージェントアプリ「ミューズ」の力強い成長を報告した。

テスラは、ＡＩやロボティクス分野への投資がウォール街の予想を大きく下回ったことを受け、年間の設備投資見通しを２割引き下げた。

半導体のサムスン電子は４．０３％下落、同業のＳＫハイニックスは５．４９％下落した。

売買銘柄９１４のうち、１７４銘柄が値上がり、７０９銘柄が値下がりした。

外国人投資家は６１４億ウォン（４６４０万ドル）の買い越しだった。

シドニー株式市場は下落して引けた。フォーテスキューの事業上の課題とサントスの弱い業績見通しが鉱業・エネルギー株の重しとなった一方、金融株が堅調で下支えた。

世界第４位の鉄鉱石採掘会社であるフォーテスキューは、中国の国有企業である取引先との交渉が年末までにまとまらなければ、事業が混乱する可能性があると表明。四半期最新報告では販売量が出荷量を下回ったことが示された。株価は一時４．７％下落し、１年超ぶりの大幅安となり、鉱業株指数を２％押し下げた。

ＢＨＰグループは２．４％、リオ・ティントは１．５％、それぞれ下落した。

エネルギー株では、国内２位の独立系石油・ガス生産会社サントスが米アラスカ州のピッカ原油プロジェクトでの一時的な混乱を理由に、２０２６年の生産・販売量見通しを下方修正した。株価は１．３％下落し、１０月初旬以来の大幅安となった。

ウッドサイド・エナジーも３．５％急落。前日に生産見通しを引き下げたことが響いた。両銘柄がエネルギー株指数を２．４％押し下げた。

ショー・アンド・パートナーズのシニア株式アナリスト、フィリップ・ペペ氏は「投資家は事業執行上のリスクと生産見通しの弱さに注目しており、足元の原油価格上昇については、持続可能というよりも一時的なものと見なしている」と述べた。

産金株指数は、前日の夜間取引で金地金価格が下落したことを受け、２％急落した。

一方、金融株指数は０．４％上昇し、四大銀行は値を上げた。

ベル・ダイレクトのシニアマーケットアナリスト、グレイディ・ウルフ氏は「市場のボラティリティーが高まり見通しが不透明になるなか、銀行株は最近、安全資産として活用されている」と指摘した。

items.body:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（22日）
16:36 配信

中国・香港株式市場は下落。中国の主要株価指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は１５カ月ぶりの安値となり弱気相場入りが確認された。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が、成長とバリュエーションの持続性に対する懸念から急落したことが背景。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は１．８％下落し、４０３６．３０で終了。２０２５年７月以来の安値となった。６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの直近高値から２０．２％下落し、弱気相場の目安とされる２０％下落の水準を超えた。

終値ベースでは、同指数は２００７年に付けた高値を更新しておらず、６月に相場を５年ぶりの高値に押し上げた勢いはその後急速に反転した。

香港のロータス・アセット・マネジメントのマネジングパートナー兼最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、ハオ・ホン氏は「市場は底なしの状況だ」と述べた。

上海総合指数は１．５％下落して終了し１年超ぶりの安値となった。

アジア全域のハイテク主力株に広がった売り、低調な景気刺激策への期待、新たな材料の欠如を背景に、中国市場で広範な売りが加速した。

上昇したのは生活必需品指数と公益事業指数のみ。

ホン氏は「国家隊はためらっている」とし、売り局面でしばしば介入する中国の国有投資ファンドに言及した。

ＣＳＩ半導体指数は３．６％下落、ＣＳＩ人工知能指数は３．３％下落した。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は４．４％急落し、２５年７月以来の安値を付けた。

トレーダーやアナリストによると、中国政府の小出しの景気刺激策への失望も市場心理の重しとなっている。また、第３・四半期の経済成長率が予想を上回ったことで、追加の政策支援への期待が後退した。

香港市場では、ハンセン指数が３％下落し、４カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハンセンテック指数は５％下落し、２年ぶりの安値となった。

一部の投資家は、香港上場の中国企業の株主の多くが採用している一般的な仕組みであるオフショア信託に対し、中国政府が所得税の徴収を進める取り組みを、売り圧力のもう一つの要因として指摘した。

ロータスのホン氏は、きょうが税申告の最終日だと指摘。過去数週間の売りは、中国企業の創業者らが主導したとし「納税義務を果たすための現金を調達するため、資産を売却していたのは明らかだ」と述べた。

２２日の下落が大きかった銘柄では、テンセントが２．９％下落、アリババが６％超急落した。

盛期資本（香港）のゼン・ウェンカイＣＩＯは「これほど急激かつ急速な下落は非常にまれで、特にテンセントのような主力銘柄ではなおさらだ。これはおそらくパニック売りの最終局面で、市場の売りは終わりに近づいている」と説明。「ただ、これほどの傷からの回復には時間がかかるだろう」と語った。

ソウル株式市場は３％超下落し、約６カ月ぶりの安値で引けた。世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームを巡る根強い疑念の中、半導体株が利益確定売りで下落した。また、中央銀行のタカ派的な政策姿勢がさらなる利上げを示唆したことも相場の重しとなった。

総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は前営業日終値比２０１．８９ポイント（３．５２％）安の５５３３．７７で終了し、４月７日以来の安値となった。前日は半導体株の反発を受け３．３％上昇し、６週間ぶりの大幅高を記録していた。

韓国中銀は政策金利を据え置いた一方、経済成長見通しを上方修正し、輸出について楽観的な見方を維持することで、タカ派姿勢を保った。

大信証券のアナリスト、イ・キョンミン氏は「半導体株は利益確定売りで下落した。メタとテスラの決算は、スペースＸやスーパー・マイクロが提供したほどの安心感を与えられなかった」と指摘した。

Australian Grand Prix bids bitter-sweet farewell to Phillip Island

MELBOURNE, Oct 22 : Emotions are running high ahead of MotoGP's final Australian Grand Prix at Phillip Island on Sunday, with riders to bid a reluctant farewell to one of the championship's most beloved circuits before the race moves to the streets of Adelaide.
Barring two years lost to the COVID-19 pandemic, the seaside track south of Melbourne has been a fixture on the world championship calendar for 30 years and produced some of Australian motorcycling's most memorable moments.
Australian twice world champion Casey Stoner celebrated six wins in succession from 2007 to 2012, while compatriot Mick Doohan sealed his fifth and final world title with victory in the 1998 race. 
Both riders have sections of the track named after them, along with the country's first premier class world champion Wayne Gardner, who won back-to-back in 1989-90 in the grand prix's first two races in the global series.

The island's combination of high-speed corners and fickle weather has often produced drama, and millions of fans have attended race weekends over the decades.
Hundreds of local residents gathered at roadsides on Thursday to greet the racers as they crossed San Remo bridge to the island on a processional ride to the track.
"Phillip Island is an extraordinary circuit. Racing here for the last time will be emotional,” said Ducati’s Marc Marquez, who has won five races at the circuit including four MotoGP events.
“It is a track with a unique, breathtaking layout."
ADELAIDE STREET CIRCUIT
However, it is also a far-flung track with ageing facilities long overdue for an upgrade.
With the 2026 race marking the end of a long-term contract with the Victorian state government, MotoGP organisers Dorna pushed to move the grand prix to Albert Park, which hosts a Formula One race in central Melbourne in the autumn.
With the two sides failing to reach agreement on renewing the contract, the South Australian government stepped in to cut a deal with Dorna and will host the race in Adelaide on MotoGP's first street circuit in 2027.
Stoner said local organisers had not tried hard enough to keep the race at Phillip Island or build a festival atmosphere around it as seen every year at the buzzing F1 grand prix.
"I think it’s a lot to do with the Victorian government that’s dropped the ball with it and maybe they wanted to, I’m not sure," he told Melbourne's Herald Sun newspaper.
The Victorian government said in a statement it had declined Dorna's request to move the race to Albert Park.
Aprilia rider Jorge Martin leads the championship by two points from Ducati's Marquez.
Last year's winner Raul Fernandez said he would "cry a little" on the final weekend at Phillip Island.
"Not because I got my first MotoGP victory here but also because I always enjoy it a lot coming here to Phillip Island - it is super nice," the Trackhouse rider said in quotes published by motor racing website Crash.net.
“It's a track that everybody will miss a little bit.”
After a week of sunshine at the island, rain is forecast for qualifying on Saturday, and a storm may even disrupt Sunday's race.
Home racer Jack Miller, a decent performer in the wet, was not complaining ahead of his final Australian Grand Prix.
"Phillip Island's giving itself a proper send-off," he told reporters at the circuit on Thursday.
"I'm not angry about that."

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 旧村上ファンド系の投資会社、シティインデックスイレブンス（東京都渋谷区）が共同保有者の野村絢氏との合計でテレビ朝日ホールディングス株を５．０６％を保有していることが、２２日提出の大量保有報告書で分かった。旧村上ファンドを率いた村上世彰氏の長女である野村氏の保有分が大部分を占めている。報告義務発生日は１５日。

保有目的に関し、テレビ朝日の株価が割安だと判断した場合、今後３カ月以内に保有割合を５％超増やす可能性があるとした。また、株主価値の向上を目的として同社との対話を通じ、資本政策の変更や事業および資産譲渡、株式の非公開化について提案を行っているという。

テレビ朝日が６月に公表した定時株主総会の招集通知では、野村氏が同社株１．８６％を保有する大株主となったことが明らかになっていた。

テレビ朝日が６月に公表した定時株主総会の招集通知では、野村氏が同社株１．８６％を保有する大株主となったことが明らかになっていた。

items.title: ＬＳＥＧ、データ分析能力強化に向けオクタスを買収　35億ドル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）は２２日、金融データ企業オクタスを約３５億４０００万ドルで買収することで合意したと発表した。第３・四半期の決算発表に合わせて、データ分析能力の強化を目的としたこの取引を明らかにした。

２月にＬＳＥＧへの出資を明らかにしたアクティビスト（物言う株主）のエリオットは、人工知能（ＡＩ）が投資家や企業の取引・データ消費の在り方に影響を与える中、ポートフォリオの見直しや利益率の改善を求めている。

エリオットは今回の取引に関するロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。ＬＳＥＧは以前、「エリオットとは良好かつ建設的な対話」が行われていると述べていた。

ＬＳＥＧのデビッド・シュウィマー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「オクタスの業界をリードする独自データとインテリジェンスを、ＬＳＥＧのデータ・分析事業と統合することで、顧客に向けた強力なサービスを提供し、当社の成長をさらに加速させることができる」と述べた。

ＬＳＥＧにとって、オクタス買収は２０１９年にロイターの親会社トムソン・ロイターの一部門だったリフィニティブを２７０億ドルで買収して以来最大規模の取引となる。

ＬＳＥＧの株価は、ＡＩが同社の金融データ事業を阻害し、利益率を圧迫するのではないかという懸念から、２６年に入ってこれまでに約２％下落しており、２５年２月の最高値からは約２８％値下がりしている。

しかし、同社は２２日、２６年の売上高見通しを引き上げ、総収益（為替変動の影響・回収分を除く）が少なくとも８％成長するとの見通しを示した。

ＬＳＥＧは、同社のニュース・データ端末「Workspace」にニュースを提供しているロイターにとって最大の顧客となる。

items.title: Europe's STOXX 600 slips as mixed earnings and rising oil sour mood
items.author: Avinash P
items.creator: Avinash P
items.summary: Europe's STOXX 600 index fell nearly 1% on Thursday, surrendering all of the prior session's gains as investors weighed a slate of mixed earnings reports, while higher oil prices and rising French bond yields further dampened risk appetite.
items.body:
Europe's STOXX 600 index fell nearly 1% on Thursday, surrendering all of the prior session's gains as investors weighed a slate of mixed earnings reports, while higher oil prices and rising French bond yields further dampened risk appetite.
The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) was down 0.95% at 638.38 points by 0855 GMT, after gaining over 0.9% on Wednesday.
"We have some big concerns in the market, one is the situation in the Middle East... So that is sending oil prices higher and the other one is obviously bond yields," said Joost Van Leenders, senior investment strategist at Van Lanschot Kempen Investment.
"You have those risk factors and the positive factors which vary from day to day....and make for a bit of volatility in the markets," he said.
Oil prices climbed more than 2% after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia [USN:L1N46801N TEXT:"stoked concerns about broader escalation"] and supply disruption.
Energy-dependent Europe has been hit by soaring energy costs, which have stoked price pressures and weighed on the broader index.
Additionally, the yield spread between France's 10-year bond and German Bunds also hit a fresh 15-year high amid political uncertainty and protests in France.
Kicking off European bank earnings, Barclays (BARC.L) shares erased earlier losses to trade flat after the company [USN:L6N4680EP TEXT:"reported a third-quarter"] profit miss. The lender separately said it would cut around 5,000 jobs, or 5% of its workforce this year.
Despite this, the banking index (.SX7E) fell 2.7%.
Hermes (HRMS.PA) fell 7.3% after the Birkin bag maker posted [USN:L6N4680E3 TEXT:"slightly weaker-than-expected"] quarterly revenue, with the drop weighing on the luxury index (.STXLUXP) .
Nestle (NESN.S) added 1.2% after reporting better-than-expected [USN:L6N4680BP TEXT:"organic sales growth"] for the third quarter. The food and beverage index (.SX3P) gained 0.6%, one of the few sectors trading higher.
The tech index (.SX8P) came under renewed pressure, tracking a global selloff, and was down 2.1%.
AI-related shares such as Infineon (IFXGn.DE) , STMicroelectronics (STMPA.PA) and ASML (ASML.AS) fell between 2.8% and 3.6%.
[USN:L8N46807V TEXT:"BE Semiconductor Industries"] (BESI.AS) and [USN:L6N4671BR TEXT:"SAP"] (SAPG.DE) fell 3.1% and 1%, respectively, after their quarterly earnings.
Solid earnings from Meta Platforms (META.O) on Wednesday were not enough to placate investor worries about the sustainability and profitability of massive AI spending, reviving concerns that have triggered several selloffs in AI stocks this year.
Among other stocks, UCB (UCB.BR) gained 12.2% after biopharmaceutical group [USN:L6N4680D9 TEXT:"upgraded its 2026 guidance"] on strong demand for its Bimzelx and Cimzia drugs.

items.title: ディスコ、4－12月期は31％増益予想　生成ＡＩ向け需要で工場繁忙
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 半導体製造装置のディスコは２２日、２０２６年４－１２月期の連結純利益が前年同期比３１．６％増の１２１９億円になる見通しだと発表した。上期で精密加工装置の出荷が高性能半導体向けの高付加価値製品を中心に好調に推移した。

生成ＡＩ（人工知能）向けの需要が引き続き旺盛で、装置出荷は堅調に推移する見込み。工場は繁忙状況が継続しているという。市場との連動性が高い出荷額は、７－９月期が１４８６億円と四半期の出荷額としては過去最高を更新した。

生成ＡＩ以外では、光電融合の分野で需要が広がってきているという。木場竜一郎ＩＲ室長は決算会見で「第２・四半期（７－９月）の実績でしっかり増えているのを確認しているし、第３・四半期（１０－１２月）に向けても少しずつ増えていくという見通しを持っている」と語った。

items.title: 連合が27年春闘の基本構想、賃上げ「5％以上・6％中心」要求
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Sugiyama　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Kentaro Sugiyama　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - 連合は２２日、２０２７年春闘で要求する賃上げ率（定期昇給込み）について、「６％中心、５％以上」とする基本構想を発表した。過去３年も「５％以上」の数値目標を用いていたが、今回は表現を変更し、５％以上が最低限の目標であることを明確化した。

連合は２４年春闘で「５％以上」を賃上げ目標の目安とし、２５年は「その実現を目指す」、２６年は「その実現にこだわる」と段階的に表現を強めてきた。一方、賃上げ要求の水準は過去３年、おおむね６％前後で推移しており、２７年は５％以上を最低水準と位置付けたうえで、６％を中心水準として明示した。

実際の妥結結果は、２４年が５．１０％、２５年が５．２５％、２６年が５．０１％だった。高水準の賃上げが続いたものの、企業規模や産業別の格差が残っていることが課題だ。２７年も大企業・製造業が相場形成をけん引する構図は続くとみられるが、中小企業や非製造業への賃上げの波及が重要となる。

連合の基本構想では、単年度の賃上げ目標に加え、２０３０年をめどに現行水準から１５％程度引き上げる中期目標も新たに設定した。

海外主要国で賃金が年１─２％ずつ上昇していることを踏まえ、「少なくとも日本全体の実質賃金の改善スピードを１％以上で維持」しつつ、中期的に日本全体の生産性を引き上げることでさらに加速する必要があると指摘した。

日銀は持続的・安定的な２％の物価目標実現に向け、賃金と物価の好循環を重視している。連合は年内に正式な２７年春闘方針を決定し、その後、各産業別組織や単組が要求内容をまとめる。２７年の春闘の動向は、今後の金融政策運営を占う上でも重要な材料となる。

items.title: 日経平均は急反落、ＡＩ・半導体株売られ6万3000円割れ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - 東京株式市場で日経平均は急反落し、前営業日比２．６５％（１７１３円４０銭）安の６万２９０７円８４銭で取引を終えた。時間外取引でナスダック先物が下落したほか、韓国ＫＯＳＰＩが軟調に推移したことから、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が売られた。全体的に、じり安となったことで反発のタイミングがつかめずに安値引け、取引時間中では９月１４日以来、終値では７月３０日以来の６万３０００円割れとなった。

米半導体製造装置メーカーのラム・リサーチ株が決算発表後の時間外で下落したことを受けて、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が売られ、指数を押し下げる要因となった。

注目されたテスラの決算は、人工知能（ＡＩ）とロボット事業への支出が市場予想を大幅に下回り、フリーキャッシュフロー（ＦＣＦ）が予想外の黒字となった。しかし、年間の設備投資見通しも２割引き下げたことが嫌気され、ナスダック先物の下落を促す要因になったという。

さらに、プログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことも、直接的な材料ではないながらも、市場心理を冷え込ませる要因となった。そうした中、不正アクセス・情報漏洩のニュースが相次いだこともあり、サイバー防衛関連株が人気化した。

市場では「スペースⅩなど米ハイテク企業の好決算はある程度織り込んでおり、今後はハイパースケーラーの決算発表を見極めたいとのムードになる。これらの発表が一巡するまで買いが入りにくい」（野村証券・ストラテジストの秋山渉氏）との指摘もあった。

ＴＯＰＩＸは１．１４％安の３９９７．５０ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比１．１５％安の２０６０．００ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆０５６９億９４００万円だった。

東証３３業種では、値上がりは鉱業、保険業など１３業種、値下がりは非鉄金属、ガラス・土石製品、電気機器など２０業種。

個別では、東京エレクトロンが１万円を割り込んだほか、ソフトバンクグループ、アドバンテストなどが大幅安となった。トヨタ自動車、ファーストリテイリングなどもさえない。半面、サイバーセキュリティクラウドがストップ高。ＮＥＣが逆行高し、、ソニーグループは年初来高値を更新した。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が下落し、１．７５％安（１３．４２ポイント安）の７５３．２７ポイントだった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６８４銘柄（４４％）、値下がりは８２１銘柄（５２％）、変わらずは４８銘柄（３％）だった。

items.title: インドの9月原油輸入、中東産が急増　イラン戦争前の水準回復
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nidhi Verma

[ニューデリー ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Nidhi Verma

[ニューデリー ２２日 ロイター] - 船舶追跡データによると、インドの９月の中東産原油輸入が急増し、イラン戦争前の水準を回復した。一方、ロシア産原油は中国との激しい調達競争を受けて減少した。

中東産原油輸入は日量約２８０万バレルと、２月以来の高水準となった。インドの原油輸入全体の約５４％を占めた。

一方ロシア産原油輸入は前月比約１４％減の日量約１８０万バレルとなった。原油輸入に占める割合は４６．６％から３３．５％に低下した。

＜ロシア産原油の輸入、低調続く見通し＞

インドの石油精製業界関係者によると、輸送費などを含めたロシア産原油の調達コストは現在、イラク産など一部の中東産原油と同程度になっている。このため、インドの製油会社によるロシア産原油の購入は、今後数カ月は低調に推移する見通しだ。

この関係者によると、中東産原油が市場に流入する中、ロシア産原油の北海ブレントに対する上乗せ幅は、ここ数カ月の１バレル当たり１０ドル超から１─２ドルに縮小した。

中東産は輸送日数が短いことや、一部の産油国が運賃の高騰を相殺するために販売価格を引き下げていることから、製油会社は割安な中東産原油の購入をできる限り増やしたい考えだという。

データによると、インドの９月の原油輸入全体は前月比２０％増の日量約５３３万バレルだった。イラク産原油輸入は日量約８３万バレルと、８月の１７万１０００バレルから増加した。

items.title: Westpac's latest job cuts not AI-driven, spokesperson says
items.author: Anjali Singh, Kumar Tanishk
items.creator: Anjali Singh, Kumar Tanishk
items.summary: About 140 roles affected by workforce changes at Australian lender Westpac this week were part of a broader organisational restructure, not AI-driven job cuts, a spokesperson told Reuters on Thursday.
items.body:
About 140 roles affected by workforce changes at Australian lender Westpac (WBC.AX) this week were part of a broader organisational restructure, not AI-driven job cuts, a spokesperson told Reuters on Thursday.
The Finance Sector Union, which represents bank and finance workers in the country said in a separate statement earlier in the day that Westpac had joined larger rival National Australia Bank (NAB.AX) in accelerating the rollout of "job-destroying AI".
The spokesperson said Westpac notified the FSU of the changes on Monday, a day before NAB announced plans to cut up to [USN:L4N4651N3 TEXT:"2,500 jobs"] as part of efforts to simplify operations and reduce costs
Australia's banking industry has undergone [USN:L3N3UV1F1 TEXT:"significant workforce"] changes in recent years as lenders streamline operations and rein in costs
The changes come against the backdrop of a softening labour market, with Australia's jobless rate [USN:AZN4TP17R TEXT:"rising to 4.7%"] in September after a prolonged period of high interest rates
"These changes are not related to AI but rather a broader organisational restructure that's been underway for some time," the spokesperson said on Thursday
The changes are likely to be down to "duplication cuts in risk, institutional and finance, not roles displaced by a model," said Hersh Oberoi, global research director at Balfour Capital Group
The FSU added that more than 10,000 banking jobs had been lost over the past two years and warned that further cuts could add pressure on workers already carrying heavier workloads
"A lack of strong regulatory guardrails for AI is another factor adding to workers' sense of vulnerability," the union added
Oberoi said AI is likely to have a limited effect on jobs in the Australian banking industry over the next six months but a substantial one over three to five years, with the first impact seen by contractors and consultants
Westpac shares ended 0.4% higher at A$35.68. The stock is down about 7.6% year to date

TOKYO, Oct 22 : Japan's largest labour union group Rengo unveiled a more ambitious wage bargaining policy for next year's annual labour negotiations on Thursday, setting a target centred at a pay hike of 6 per cent while maintaining a minimum benchmark of 5 per cent or more. 
The move marks a shift from previous years, when Rengo called for wage increases of at least 5 per cent, as it seeks to reinforce wage-growth momentum after Japanese workers secured average pay gains above 5 per cent for the past three years amid persistent labour shortages.
The umbrella group, which represents about 7 million workers, sets wage targets that serve as guidance for its member unions, marking the start of a closely watched bargaining season that will help shape expectations for the Bank of Japan's interest-rate path.
The new 6 per cent midpoint target, which includes a 4 per cent base pay increase, is meant to send a message that 5 per cent should be viewed as a floor rather than a target, Rengo said.

The target does not necessarily signal a dramatic increase in actual wage demands, however, as Rengo member unions sought average pay hikes of 5.94 per cent in the 2026 wage round, which resulted in an average increase of 5.01 per cent.
RISKS OF INFLATION OVERSHOOT
Despite the more assertive target from Rengo, economists expect actual wage settlements in 2027 to remain broadly similar to this year's level of around 5 per cent.
"Chronic labour shortages, sturdy corporate profits and a declining labour share of income will justify wage gains broadly comparable to 2026 levels," said Takayasu Kudo, senior Japan economist at Bank of America Securities Japan.
While robust pay growth was previously welcomed as a means of lifting inflation towards the central bank's 2 per cent target, stronger wage gains may carry different implications now that the BOJ has shifted its focus to keeping underlying inflation anchored around that level.
Wage hikes of around 5 per cent may represent a "sweet spot" for the BOJ as well as workers, said Naoki Hattori, chief Japan economist at Mizuho Research Institute.
"Pay hikes larger than that could force companies to pass on labour costs to prices further and risk a wage-price spiral that pushes inflation above the BOJ's 2 per cent target," he said.
Japanese wages were stagnant for decades until 2022, when rising raw material costs pushed up inflation and piled pressure on firms to compensate employees with higher pay.
Strong wage growth in recent years has helped lift real wages back into positive territory, but Japan still ranks near the bottom among advanced economies in purchasing power parity-adjusted wage comparisons.
Seeking to raise Japan's wage levels in international rankings, Rengo also set a medium-term target for the first time, aiming to increase wages by 15 per cent from current levels by 2030.
Rengo will formally approve its 2027 wage policy in December, after which individual unions will draw up their demands. Annual wage negotiations typically culminate in March, when major firms respond to union requests.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Love affair to staged arrest: how a Romanian from England was jailed in Russia as a spy
items.author: Mark Trevelyan
items.creator: Mark Trevelyan
items.summary: Springtime in a park. Grey sky. A young man in a blue knitted hat and Adidas backpack walks down a path. Two burly security agents spring from a van and pin him to the pavement.
items.body:
Springtime in a park. Grey sky. A young man in a blue knitted hat and Adidas backpack walks down a path. Two burly security agents spring from a van and pin him to the pavement.
"What is your name?" asks a voice in English as a gloved hand holds the man's face towards the camera.
"David Adrian Kercso," he swiftly responds. Where is he from? "Romania. Romania."
The video, released by Russia's FSB security service and published by state media, purports to show the arrest of Kercso, now 23, a Romanian citizen who grew up in England and was sentenced earlier this year to 15 years for spying for Ukraine.
Reuters has not been able to verify all of the evidence in Kercso's case. But what is clear is that the arrest video is not what it purports to be: Reuters analysis of the video and of court records of his detention shows that at the time it was made he had already been in Russian custody for months.
It was filmed in a park inside Russia, in the southern city of Sochi. But Kercso's arrest was first announced elsewhere, by pro-Russian separatists across the border in Abkhazia, a breakaway region of neighbouring Georgia, who released their own video of him in their custody the day before he first turned up in a Russian court.
The FSB did not respond to requests for comment for this story, including why it would release a video depicting the purported arrest of a suspect who was already in custody.
Requests for comment were also sent to the Abkhazian separatists' SGB security agency, the Russian embassy in London, the Romanian and Ukrainian foreign ministries. None replied.
To Kercso's family, who say he was lured to the Black Sea coast to pursue a romance with a woman he had met online, the FSB video of a staged arrest is just another bizarre turn in a story that alarmed them from the outset. He hopes to lodge an appeal against his conviction.
"I told him to not go there because it's very dangerous, because it's a war," his mother Julia Kercso told Reuters. "And he never listened to me yet."
MOTHER WARNED HIM NOT TO GO In late 2023, Kercso was living in the English city of Reading, west of London, working for a company that recycles electronics, when he first connected online with a woman called Valeria.
She was from Abkhazia, a picturesque sliver of Georgia's mountainous Black Sea coast that has been in the hands of separatists since the early 1990s.
An online romance blossomed, and his family says he travelled via Turkey in August 2024 to meet her.
Reuters obtained contact information for Valeria from the family but did not receive a reply to requests sent to her for comment.
According to Kercso's accounts to his family, the couple met up in Sochi, and after a few days crossed the border into Abkhazia, where Kercso stayed through the autumn. But his mother said the relationship deteriorated as he began to run short of money, and he told his family he would return home.
His trip back was planned for November 28, 2024, but he never arrived. That day, he stopped answering phone calls and messages. In subsequent letters from prison, Kercso said that was the day he was arrested in Abkhazia.
The first announcement of Kercso's arrest came two weeks later from the Abkhazian separatist authorities, who released a video on December 13 depicting their own SGB security service leading the young man from a car into a building.
He was shown confessing that he had been in contact with Ukrainian intelligence and had been told to film Abkhazian military sites with a drone.
In his letters, Kercso says that initial confession videotaped in Abkhazia had consisted of a text he had been ordered to memorise by his captors. The separatists told him that if he recited it on camera he would be sent home. But instead, he wrote, he was brought to the border and transferred into the custody of the Russian FSB.
The day after the Abkhazians released their video, Kercso was indeed in Russian custody, appearing before a judge at Sochi's Khostinsky District Court on December 14, according to court records available online.
It was the first of 10 court appearances that would be registered over the next four months, at which his detention in Russia would be extended roughly every two weeks.
TAKEN FROM JAIL TO FILM 'ARREST' In his letters, Kercso says that the staged Russian video of his "arrest" was filmed in mid-April in Sochi, after he had already been captured in Abkhazia, transferred to Russia and held there for four months. He was awakened in jail around dawn by FSB officers who took him to a nearby location to film it.
Reuters analysis of the video is consistent with this account. Though the exact date cannot be established, ample green foliage is clearly visible, showing it was filmed after the start of spring, and could not have been filmed before he began the four months of detention documented in his 10 Sochi court appearances since December.
The location - a strip of parkland along Sochi's Matsesta River - can be established from visible features. These include the pathway layout, a bridge pillar, lamp posts, trees, a grassy strip and a wall, all of which match archive and satellite imagery of the area.
Evgeny Smirnov, a Russian lawyer familiar with the case, said it was common for the FSB to compel suspects to film dramatic arrest scenes long after they are detained.
"We have seen this in dozens of cases where individuals detained months earlier are taken to a city street, a forest, or a train station so that a staged arrest video can be filmed," he said.
Kercso says in his letters that in the months following his transfer to Russia he was beaten, held in isolation and tortured. Reuters could not independently verify those allegations.
When he was sentenced, the FSB said he had transmitted the location of Russian air-defence systems in Sochi to a Ukrainian intelligence agency in the summer of 2024. Video released by the agency showed him confessing to that charge.
Kercso says that confession was also coerced.
"None of that happened, they stole my life for no reason and fabricated everything," he wrote. He has learned Russian in prison, misses his family deeply and dreams of returning home.
"Now I know that coming here was a huge mistake," he said. "I was blinded by love and didn't see the warning signs."

items.title: Israeli settlers steal Palestinians' olives as attacks on harvest grow more violent
items.author: Pesha Magid, Lina Obeid
items.creator: Pesha Magid, Lina Obeid
items.summary: Settlers have intimidated Palestinians harvesting their olives in the occupied West Bank for decades, but this year, not only has violence increased sharply, theft has been widespread.
items.body:
Brought to tears as he recalled Israeli settlers hitting his cherished olive trees with sticks and taking off with the olives, Palestinian Ahmed Salem said he feared being attacked if he tried to intervene.
Settlers have intimidated Palestinians harvesting their olives in the occupied West Bank for decades, but this year, not only has [USN:L8N4620II TEXT:"violence increased sharply"], theft has been widespread, according to Palestinians, Israeli rights groups and the UN.
The settlers dumped Salem's olives into sacks and then drove them to a nearby Israeli settler outpost to be pressed into olive oil, the 50-year-old Palestinian told Reuters of the incident around two weeks ago near his village Lubban al-Gharbi.
"How would you feel if something that belonged to you was being violated, and you could do nothing about it?" he asked.
The couple living in the outpost, whose olive press settlers have urged Israelis to use for West Bank olives, declined multiple Reuters requests for comment, while the Yesha Council, which oversees Israeli settlements in the West Bank, did not immediately respond.
The attacks have accelerated ahead of an Israeli election next week that opinion polls show Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his pro-settler coalition could lose to opponents who have taken a [USN:L6N4660BW TEXT:"more critical stance"] against settler violence.
'SETTLERS CAN COME AND GO FREELY' The olive harvest starts with the onset of cooler weather, allowing Palestinian families to gather in the lush, terraced groves that they have groomed for generations.
"My six-year-old son remembers going there with me, eating there, making tea there," Salem said.
With the establishment of hundreds of small settler outposts under Netanyahu's government since 2022, the military has increasingly restricted Palestinian access to areas nearby, including many olive groves.
"This creates a situation where Palestinians, in many of the cases, many of the lands, especially in proximity to settlements and outposts, cannot enter the land and harvest the trees," said Ziv Stahl, executive director of Israeli rights group Yesh Din.
"But settlers can come and go freely, and that's what they do."
Even when Palestinians can access their trees, it is not without risk. Yesh Din on Wednesday reported 125 physical attacks on Palestinian olive harvesters over the 24 days since the season began and 168 incidents of crop theft, with Israeli military forces present in at least a quarter of cases.
An Israeli military official said it takes [USN:L6N46304S TEXT:"acts of violence"], criminal activity and attempts to undermine security very seriously. The official did not refer to settlers or comment on the reports of olive theft in the presence of the Israeli military, which has separately [USN:L8N45F1FN TEXT:"uprooted trees with excavators"], citing what it said was a need to prevent Palestinian attacks.
The removal of Palestinians' olives has met with widely differing responses from Israeli rabbis.
"I call it theft. From my perspective, I define it as theft or robbery, and it is forbidden," said Zev Weitman, the rabbi for the Alon Shvut settlement south of Bethlehem.
Prominent Orthodox rabbi Dov Lior said settlers should harvest across the West Bank, asserting in an open letter that Palestinians had no ownership rights to the land and that harvesting olives fulfilled "the commandment of conquering the land."
'IT'S EITHER US OR OUR ENEMY', SETTLERS SAY ON SOCIAL MEDIA Hundreds of acres of the land around Salem's village, Lubban al-Gharbi, including olive groves, were fenced off and seized between 2023 and 2026 by Avichai Farm, an Israeli settler outpost built on a nearby hill.
Salem said villagers have seen settlers harvest olives from the seized land and take them to the outpost's olive press.
At the start of the olive harvest, settlers posted on social media calling on Israelis to harvest West Bank olives and bring them to Avichai Farm's press.
"Both fine oil and strengthening the Jewish hold on the vast expanses of our land!," read a message on a settler Telegram group. "It's either us or our enemy!"
The press at Avichai Farm advertises "premium products produced by Avichai Farm" with olive oil at about $20 a bottle via a website run by the Farms Association, a settler group that Reuters has reported receives significant financial support from the Israeli government, which says the aim is to promote peace.
The Farms Association did not immediately respond to a request for comment and the couple who live on the farm with their children declined to be interviewed by a Reuters reporter who approached the area on Sunday.
On a road leading to Avichai Farm, Reuters spoke to a man who declined to be identified and said he had driven from a settlement around 90 minutes away to press 14 bags of olives from trees he said he grew himself.
Lubban al-Gharbi villagers and other Palestinians who have lost land to settler expansion say the harvesting of olives from trees in groves seized from Palestinian land constitutes theft.
UN bodies and most countries deem Israel's settlements on land occupied in war illegal under international law regarding military occupations. Israel rejects this, viewing the territory as disputed rather than occupied.
'WE PAY IN BLOOD FOR THE OLIVES' During this year's olive harvest, Palestinian authorities say three Palestinians have been killed in daily militant settler attacks, which have also injured several journalists, [USN:L6N46304S TEXT:"European diplomats and a French mayor"].
Stahl from the Yesh Din Israeli rights group said the violence was "part of a campaign of ethnic cleansing, paving the way for the annexation of the West Bank without its Palestinian population."
Israel, which has [USN:L1N3W407X TEXT:"considered the idea of annexation"], said it is investigating some of the incidents.
An Israeli government spokesperson said olives "picked by a Jew in the ancestral homeland of the Jewish people" did not constitute theft and that Jews owned and cultivated "millions of olive trees" in the area. No one should take the law into their own hands, the spokesperson added.
Palestinian farmer Samer Ben Shamsi said masked settlers attacked him on October 9 in the Palestinian village of Beita near Nablus, then sped away in a pickup truck with his harvest of olives after he and other farmers fled.
"This year, they steal without fear because they have a state and a powerful force backing them," Ben Shamsi said, referring to the security forces.
Within the past year alone, settlers had shot him in the leg, beaten him and smashed his possessions, he said.
"We pay in blood for the olives."

FAST

LONDON, Oct 22 : Flush with money from billionaire donors, Nigel Farage's Reform UK has started hiring staff for a YouTube-based TV channel to bypass established broadcasters and capitalise on fundraising unrivalled by any major political party in Europe.
After weeks of bruising headlines over donations and racism that have seen the populist, anti-immigration party led by the veteran Brexit campaigner lose its lead in opinion polls, Reform has started to aggressively spend a bumper £72 million ($96 million) donated by two crypto businessmen.
Twelve adverts for media jobs are part of a strategy to regain ground and present the party's message in a more controlled way, according to at least eight party officials.
By building on Reform's established YouTube offering, already home to around eight posts a week, the party aims to create a daily channel to try to break the monopoly of an "establishment media" it regards as hostile.

The expansion, enabled by the donations from Christopher Harborne and Ben Delo in September, will also help Reform train up more media performers, Gawain Towler, a member of the party's governing board, told Reuters.
That would offer respite to Reform's eight lawmakers, who face mainstream media sometimes several times a week each. 
PARALLEL WITH TRUMP TV
"The media always say they offer a fair hearing to all opinions," said Towler, at Farage's side for more than 20 years. But "when it's Reform, they just want to say we're horrible".
About half of the £72 million will cover the running of Reform's headquarters until a national election due by mid-2029, and the funds will also help produce more policy, recruit advisers, expand campaign operations and launch a newspaper with an initial print run of 15 million, the officials said.
The TV offering will be similar to US President Donald Trump's Trump TV – a streaming channel airing White House-sanctioned content 24 hours a day.
With an estimated initial budget exceeding £10 million and plans for 25 journalists and editors, Reform intends the channel's interviews, documentaries and other content to build on its already well-established social media offering.
There is peril. Reform could be forced to hand the funds back if the governing Labour Party changes the rules on donations – something Reform officials say they will contest.
But for now, Reform will spend to try to regain ground lost to Labour, under media-savvy new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, and the opposition Conservatives, which have in the past few weeks taken the two top spots in opinion polls.
Reform is the focus of police and parliamentary investigations over previous funding, including an earlier £5 million to Farage from Harborne, and what the party calls "sting operations". One, broadcast by Channel 4, showed two officials allegedly trying to solicit donations from a foreign-based businessman. Another, broadcast by ITV, showed candidates and councillors making racist, violent and sexist comments.
Reform has said its internal review into the two officials had found no breach of electoral law, and Farage told a rally that sometimes people say "unpleasant" and "silly things".
Towler and other Reform officials say they do not need to aggressively court donors. Entrepreneurs such as Delo and Harborne offer funds because they believe Reform is the only party that can fix Britain, they say.
The two donors have frontloaded their respective £36 million contributions so Reform can prepare for the next election.
Announcing his donation, Delo wrote "the party should spend less time trying to raise funds to compete on equal terms and more time preparing for government".
A source close to Delo, who no longer works in FinTech to concentrate on philanthropy, said there were no strings attached and he was happy with Reform spending the money as it wished.
Similarly, Harborne said in his announcement that Reform, as a "start-up party, needs more money than can be provided by membership fees alone, to build and sustain itself and be ready for government".
He also wrote that he wanted nothing in return. 
Reuters could not reach either donor for direct comment.
TOP FUNDING SPOT IN EUROPE
Reform's record funding not only eclipses Labour and the Conservatives but also tops Germany's centre-right Christian Democratic Union as the largest private annual fundraising haul of any major party in Europe, according to Reuters' analysis of the main European parties' accounts.
Reform has raised £87 million from private donors so far this year, with further contributions expected in the coming months, surpassing the previous European record of £86.3 million raised by the CDU in 2024 from donations and membership fees. 
Fernando Casal Bertoa, associate politics professor at the University of Nottingham, said UK politics was moving closer to a US-style funding model. "If you give large sums to a party do you really think they won't give you favours or help you?" he added. "It is never for free."
Reform officials, and Delo and Harborne, see the cash injection as levelling the playing field with the decades-old Labour and Conservative parties.
Harborne has long donated to Reform, and its previous incarnation, the Brexit Party. After contributing more than £228,888 to the Conservatives between 2001 and 2018, Harborne donated about £10 million to the Brexit Party in 2019, according to Electoral Commission data. 
It was that year when Towler first "came across" Harborne after the businessman showed interest in the Brexit Party's campaign to stop any attempts to reverse Britain's decision to leave the EU. Harborne's late sister, Katharine, stood as a Brexit Party candidate in 2019.
Delo also crossed paths with Farage that year after helping fund the Battle of Ideas festival run by Claire Fox, a former member of the Revolutionary Communist party who joined the Brexit Party in 2019.
LABOUR'S THREAT
Yet, the scale of Reform's donations has prompted renewed calls for tighter rules in Britain, with Labour threatening to use legislation to introduce retrospective changes that could force Reform to return some of the money.
In March, the government announced it would impose a cap of £100,000 on gifts from British donors living overseas. That would apply to donors who move back for a year after they relocate.
Electoral records over the summer show Harborne, who moved to Thailand in the 1990s, had registered to vote at a British address. Corporate filings show in early June Delo's place of residence was moved to Britain from Hong Kong.
But if the retrospective changes are enacted, it could make all of Harborne and Delo's recent donations ineligible.
Reform has described that as a potential "retroactive trapdoor" and a source said if the donations were ruled ineligible, the party could challenge it in court.
For now, Reform will spend.
"It's a massive game of catch up," said Towler.
($1 = 0.7496 pounds)

items.title: フィリピン中銀、予想上回る0.5％利上げ　追加引き締め排除せず
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mikhail Flores　Karen Lema

[マニラ ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Mikhail Flores　Karen Lema

[マニラ ２２日 ロイター] - フィリピン中央銀行は２２日、政策金利を５０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、５．５０％とした。利上げは４会合連続で、引き上げ幅は市場予想を上回った。物価上昇圧力に対抗する「断固とした」措置とし、インフレ抑制に向けて追加利上げを行う用意があると表明した。

中銀は声明で「金融政策委員会は、物価上昇圧力の広がりとインフレの一段の上振れリスクに対し、強力な金融政策対応が必要と認識した」と説明した。

利上げは４会合連続。ロイター調査に回答したエコノミスト２７人全員が、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを予想していた。

中銀は「こうした断固とした対応により、金融政策は適切な引き締め度合いになる」と説明。「これにより物価上昇の２次的影響を抑え、インフレ期待をしっかりと安定させる」と表明した。

フィリピンペソは予想を上回る利上げを受けて上昇したが、その後は上げ幅を失い、再び過去最安値に近づいた。インフレの高止まりと成長鈍化が引き続き主な懸念となった。

ペソが最近、過去最安値を付けたことも、中銀に対応を迫る圧力を強めている。燃料輸入への依存度が高いフィリピンでは通貨安が輸入インフレのリスクを高める。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争の開始以降、原油価格が急騰する中ペソは１０％近く下落した。

インフレ率は４カ月連続で鈍化した後、９月に加速した。上半期の弱い経済成長にもかかわらず、金融引き締めを維持する中銀が直面する難しさを浮き彫りにした。

中銀は２０２６年の平均インフレ率予想を６．１％に据え置く一方、２７年の予想を５．４％から６．０％に引き上げた。世界的な原油価格の高止まりとエルニーニョ現象のリスクを理由に挙げた。２８年には３．３％に鈍化し、目標範囲内に戻ると見込んでいる。

中銀のレモロナ総裁は、財政措置に支えられて景気が回復すると見込まれるため、政策を調整する余地があると説明。「引き続き追加利上げの可能性を排除していない」と述べた。

ＯＣＢＣ銀行の東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）担当シニアエコノミスト、ラバニア・ベンカテスワラン氏は、今回の利上げ幅が予想を上回ったことから、中銀は次回１２月１７日の会合では金利を据え置くと予想。ただ、今後数カ月にわたりコアインフレ率が高止まりすれば、追加利上げの可能性は残るとした。

items.title: Hermès-La croissance ralentit au T3, pénalisée par les accessoires en Chine
items.author: Alessandro Parodi, Tassilo Hummel, Elena Smirnova
items.creator: Alessandro Parodi, Tassilo Hummel, Elena Smirnova
items.summary: Hermès a publié jeudi un chiffre d'affaires du troisième trimestre légèrement inférieur aux attentes, les ventes de la division Vêtement et Accessoires du fabricant des sacs Birkin ayant reculé pour la première fois depuis plusieurs années en raison d'une faible demande sur son marché clé, la Chine.
items.body:
Hermès (HRMS.PA) a publié jeudi un chiffre d'affaires du troisième trimestre légèrement inférieur aux attentes, les ventes de la division Vêtement et Accessoires du fabricant des sacs Birkin ayant reculé pour la première fois depuis plusieurs années en raison d'une faible demande sur son marché clé, la Chine.
Ce résultat inférieur aux attentes, qui intervient peu après [USN:L8N45Y1DP TEXT:"des résultats trimestriels"] également inférieurs aux attentes pour LVMH (LVMH.PA) , pourrait renforcer les inquiétudes des investisseurs quant à la capacité d’Hermès à résister au ralentissement généralisé du secteur du luxe.
Vers 09h45 GMT, à la Bourse de Paris, l'action reculait de 8,5% à 1.240 euros, lanterne rouge du CAC 40 (.CAC40) , après la publication d'une croissance trimestrielle de 4,3%, la plus faible enregistrée par le groupe depuis le début de l'année 2020, lorsque la pandémie l'avait contraint à fermer temporairement ses boutiques dans le monde.
Lors d'une conférence téléphonique, le directeur financier d'Hermès, Éric du Halgouët, a déclaré aux journalistes que le marché chinois, crucial pour le groupe, restait "très difficile", tout en se disant confiant quant aux perspectives de long terme dans le pays et en confirmant la poursuite des investissements du groupe en Chine.
Les ventes trimestrielles ont progressé de 4,3% sur un an à taux de change constants, à 4,10 milliards d'euros, contre une croissance de 5,2% attendue par les analystes interrogés par Visible Alpha.
Les ventes de la division Maroquinerie-Sellerie, qui comprend les emblématiques sacs Birkin et Kelly, ont progressé de 10,8%, tandis que celles de l'activité Vêtement et Accessoires, qui représente plus d'un quart du chiffre d'affaires du groupe, ont reculé de 2% par rapport à l'an dernier.
Eric du Halgouët a précisé que ce recul de Vêtement et Accessoires tenait exclusivement de la faiblesse de la demande chinoise pour les accessoires vendus en grands volumes, tandis que la division continuait de croître dans toutes les autres régions. Le prêt-à-porter seul a progressé sur le trimestre, y compris en Chine, a-t-il ajouté.
OPTIMISME SUR L'ACTIVITÉ AUX ÉTATS-UNIS Les consommateurs chinois, qui représentent environ un cinquième des achats mondiaux de produits de luxe, ont longtemps constitué le principal moteur de croissance du secteur. La demande s'est toutefois nettement affaiblie depuis la pandémie de COVID-19.
Éric du Halgouët a estimé que, à fin septembre, malgré un léger ralentissement au troisième trimestre, l'activité restait stable en Chine, ce qui constituait déjà une performance notable compte tenu des difficultés du marché.
À l’inverse, le groupe s’est montré optimiste quant à l’évolution de son activité aux États-Unis, où il a récemment ouvert des boutiques dans des villes de taille intermédiaire, au-delà des grandes métropoles côtières. Selon Éric du Halgouët, la croissance a été portée par l’ensemble des magasins du pays et par toutes les catégories de produits.
Interrogé sur [USN:L8N4650AN TEXT:"les violences"] qui ont éclaté en France ces derniers jours et qui ont conduit au pillage de l'un de ses magasins à Marseille, Hermès a indiqué renforcer ses mesures de sécurité. Le groupe a toutefois jugé prématuré d'évaluer l'impact potentiel de ces événements sur son activité et, surtout, sur le tourisme.
La boutique de Marseille n'est pas près de rouvrir, a déclaré Éric du Halgouët aux analystes lors de la présentation des ventes du troisième trimestre, précisant que des vitrines avaient également été brisées dans les magasins de l'avenue George-V à Paris ainsi qu'à Nantes et Lyon, sans qu'aucune intrusion ne soit constatée dans ces points de vente.
Selon plusieurs analystes, les investisseurs sont de plus en plus nombreux à considérer que la valorisation historiquement élevée d'Hermès, portée par une décennie de forte croissance, pourrait progressivement se rapprocher des niveaux observés dans le reste du secteur, à mesure que le rythme d'expansion du groupe ralentit.
Plusieurs [USN:L8N4670PT TEXT:"revendeurs"] interrogés par Reuters estiment par ailleurs que la disponibilité accrue des sacs Birkin sur le marché de la seconde main a réduit une partie de leur attrait, suggérant que le modèle économique fondé sur la rareté pourrait être davantage mis à l'épreuve.
L'attrait du Birkin reste toutefois "intact", a déclaré Éric du Halgouët, ajoutant que le groupe maintenait son objectif d'augmenter ses capacités de production et ses volumes d'environ 6% par an au cours des prochaines années.

items.title: 豪サントス、ピッカ油田の影響で生産見通しを下方修正　株価下落
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rajasik Mukherjee　Nikita Maria Jino

[２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Rajasik Mukherjee　Nikita Maria Jino

[２２日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの石油・ガス開発大手サントスは２２日、アラスカの石油プロジェクト「ピッカ」における海水処理プラントの稼働開始遅れに伴う生産拡大への影響を受け、年間生産・販売量見通しの上限を引き下げた。これにより、同社の株価は一時１．８％下落した。

２０２６年の生産量を９９００万─１億０２００万石油換算バレルと見込んでおり、従来の９９００万─１億０５００万石油換算バレルから下方修正された。販売量は従来の１億０２００万─１億０８００万石油換算バレルから、１億０２００万─１億０５００万石油換算バレルへと引き下げられた。

ジェネレート・キウィセーバーの投資スペシャリスト、グレッグ・スミス氏は「投資家の注目は、２つの主要な成長プロジェクトのうちの１つであるピッカが予定より遅れ、目標生産量を下回って稼働しているという事実に集まっている」と指摘。「ピッカが修正されたスケジュール通りに生産のピークに達すれば、現在の懸念の大部分は解消されるだろう。さらなる遅延があれば、投資家の忍耐が試されることになる」と述べた。

一方、サントスの第３・四半期売上高は、前年同期の１１億３０００万ドルから２０億１０００万ドルに増加し、ビジブル・アルファの予想と一致。また、生産量は約２３％増加し、過去最高の２６３０万石油換算バレルを記録した。

サントスは生産量増加について、バロッサ油田が定常生産に達したこととピッカ油田の生産拡大によるものと説明。また、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）価格上昇と販売量増加、原油およびコンデンセートの販売増が売上高の伸びを支えたとしている。

２０２６年の生産量を９９００万─１億０２００万石油換算バレルと見込んでおり、従来の９９００万─１億０５００万石油換算バレルから下方修正された。販売量は従来の１億０２００万─１億０８００万石油換算バレルから、１億０２００万─１億０５００万石油換算バレルへと引き下げられた。

ジェネレート・キウィセーバーの投資スペシャリスト、グレッグ・スミス氏は「投資家の注目は、２つの主要な成長プロジェクトのうちの１つであるピッカが予定より遅れ、目標生産量を下回って稼働しているという事実に集まっている」と指摘。「ピッカが修正されたスケジュール通りに生産のピークに達すれば、現在の懸念の大部分は解消されるだろう。さらなる遅延があれば、投資家の忍耐が試されることになる」と述べた。

一方、サントスの第３・四半期売上高は、前年同期の１１億３０００万ドルから２０億１０００万ドルに増加し、ビジブル・アルファの予想と一致。また、生産量は約２３％増加し、過去最高の２６３０万石油換算バレルを記録した。

サントスは生産量増加について、バロッサ油田が定常生産に達したこととピッカ油田の生産拡大によるものと説明。また、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）価格上昇と販売量増加、原油およびコンデンセートの販売増が売上高の伸びを支えたとしている。

items.title: From SBI to ICICI: Major banking data breaches, cyberattacks in India
items.author: Barkha Mathur
items.summary: SBI's latest disclosure of exposed customer records adds to a history of cyber incidents affecting Indian banks ...
items.body: State Bank of India (SBI), the country’s largest lender, is investigating a data leak after identifying 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information among records found on the dark web. In a stock exchange disclosure on Wednesday, the bank said the source and extent of the exposure were still being investigated. The incident is the latest in a growing number of cyber security breaches involving Indian banks and their technology providers. Some incidents exposed personal information, while others enabled fraudulent withdrawals or disrupted payment services. Here are some of the major cases that exposed vulnerabilities in India’s banking systems recently. 1. SBI data exposure: October 2026 SBI received alerts on October 16 from its threat intelligence provider, the Defence Cyber Agency and the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) about suspected customer data exposure. A preliminary examination of around 375,000 records found on the dark web identified 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information. The data reportedly included names, mobile numbers, dates of birth, email and residential addresses, customer identification details and metadata associated with loan records. SBI said it has activated its cyber incident response and containment protocols and engaged an independent CERT-In-empanelled cybersecurity agency to investigate the incident. The bank said the breach does not have any material impact on the bank’s core business operations, financial performance or business continuity 2. Bank of Baroda: July 2026 Bank of Baroda disclosed a cybersecurity incident involving business email compromise, according to its exchange filing dated July 27. The dataset was advertised on a dark-web site as containing more than 700GB of information, based on an analysis of the site’s metadata, according to media reports. The bank initiated a forensic investigation and said the incident was not expected to have a material impact on its operations, financial performance or business continuity. 3. ICICI Bank ransomware claim: January 2025 and April 2024 The BASHE ransomware and cyber extortion group claimed in January 2025 that it had breached ICICI Bank and threatened to release data unless its demands were met. The claim was reported on January 23, with an initial ransom deadline reported for January 24. ICICI Bank did not publicly confirm the alleged breach. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) penalised ICICI Bank ₹97.80 lakh on April 29, 2025 for non-compliance with guidelines regarding its Cyber Security Framework in Banks, KYC rules, and card-issuance regulations. In April 2024, ICICI Bank's digital channels incorrectly mapped about 17,000 newly issued credit cards to the wrong users. Customers reported that the iMobile Pay app was displaying other customers' card details due to a technical glitch, including full card numbers and CVVs, the security codes used for card-not-present transactions. The bank said the affected cards represented about 0.1 per cent of its credit card portfolio. ICICI Bank acknowledged the exposure of credit-card information, blocked the affected cards and began issuing replacements. It said no misuse of the cards had been reported and promised to compensate customers for any financial loss resulting from the incident. The bank did not report confirmed customer losses arising from the error. The incident was a significant exposure of sensitive card information, but the bank's statement did not establish that the exposed details had been used fraudulently. 4. Alleged PNB data leaks In November 2021, cybersecurity firm CyberX9 alleged that a vulnerability in a Punjab National Bank (PNB) server had potentially exposed the personal and financial information of around 180 million customers for approximately seven months, according to media reports. PNB denied that its systems had been breached or customer data stolen. It said it had checked the relevant information systems and found no breach of the kind alleged. In February 2018, details associated with around 10,000 PNB debit and credit card accounts was offered for sale online. The information reportedly included cardholder names, expiry dates, personal identification numbers (PINs) and card verification values (CVVs). Singapore-based cybersecurity firm CloudSek detected the data and alerted the bank through a government agency. The bank denied the claim and said its security infrastructure is robust. 5. 300 cooperative banks and regional rural banks: July-August 2024 A ransomware attack on C-Edge Technologies, a banking technology service provider, disrupted payment services at nearly 300 cooperative banks and regional rural banks. Ransomware is malicious software that locks or encrypts systems, often to demand payment. The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) temporarily isolated C-Edge from its retail payment network to prevent the attack from spreading. The affected institutions accounted for around 0.5 per cent of India's payment-system volumes, according to a Reuters report. NPCI's precautionary action temporarily prevented customers of banks served by C-Edge from accessing affected payment systems. By August 1, the banks were back online. NPCI said a forensic review found that the ransomware had not spread to the lenders' own systems and remained confined to C-Edge's infrastructure.

items.title: 円債は入れ替え中心、通年度の実施規模は「期初想定の1兆円」上回る＝第一生命・26年度下期運用計画
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tomo Uetake

［東京　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tomo Uetake

［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - 第一生命保険は２２日、２０２６年度下期の一般勘定資産の運用について、円建て債券は上期に続いてポートフォリオの入れ替えを中心とし、残高は上期が増加したこともあり下期は減少し、通年度で横ばいとする計画を示した。上期に金利上昇局面で債券の入れ替えを加速したことから、通年度では期初に示した目線である「１兆円」を上回る規模のリバランスを想定している。

市村直人運用企画部長が資産運用計画説明会で明らかにした。

資産別の計画のうち円債については、金利動向やキャッシュフローを踏まえた責任準備金対応債券の入れ替えが中心で、残高は年度を通じて横ばいを見込む。上期は残高が若干増加したが、下期は「デュレーション調整の観点から、一部の短い債券についてはクレジット投資への振り向けも想定」（市村氏）しており、減少するという。    

第一生命では今年度の入れ替え規模について、期初時点では前年度実績の「１兆円が一つの目線」と説明していたが、市村氏は、第１・四半期のリバランスが約５０００億円に上ったとして、通年度の規模は当初想定を上振れそうだとの見通しを示した。

国債投資の対象年限について、市村氏は「キャッシュフロー・マッチングを進める中で、２０年から３０年の少し手前のところで負債対比で資産サイドが超過している状況なので、比較的売り目線。一方、買いは３０年から４０年を想定しているのが基本形だが、負債サイドのキャッシュフローを見ながら資産サイドを調整するため、必ずしもその年限を集中して購入するわけではない」と述べた。

第一生命では日銀の金融政策について、経済・為替動向などを見極めつつ、１２月の会合で次の利上げに動くと想定。その後はおおむね３カ月に１回のペースで利上げを継続し、ターミナルレートは２．０％程度とみている。また年度末の円金利見通しは、１０年が３．１０％と足元の２．８９％から小幅上昇、３０年は４．１０％と足元の３．８９％から小幅上昇と、ここからの上昇余地は大きくないとの見方だ。

国内金利が想定より上振れた局面では「基本的には入れ替えペースを加速する。大きく積み増していくことまでは現時点で考えていない」（市村氏）という。

外国債券のうち、「円債代替」である為替ヘッジ付き外債は、円資産対比でヘッジ後の利回り妙味をみて選択的に入れ替えを行う。残高は下期は償還もあるため減少、通年度では横ばいを見込む。オープン外債は、為替水準的に投資妙味が乏しいとの見方から、上期に続いて下期も残高を減らす。

一方、国内株式はリスク削減のため、上期に続き下期も残高を圧縮する。また外国株式は株価動向を踏まえた入れ替えを継続し、残高は下期が減少、通期では横ばいとする方針。

オルタナティブ資産は、ヘッジファンドやリアルアセット、プライベート・エクイティ、プライベート・デットのそれぞれに資金配分して積み増す計画。不動産も、賃料上昇が見込める物件への新規投資や入れ替えにより、残高を増加させる。

このほか、同社では今年度から一般勘定の運用ポートフォリオへの金（ゴールド）の組み入れを開始した。足元でインフレ圧力や地政学的リスクが高まる中、長期的な分散投資の確保などを目的として、段階的に積み増す計画。市村氏は「ポートフォリオの中でそれほど大きな規模になることは想定していない。３年程度の中期的にみて１％が一つの目安」との考えを示した。

第一生命の一般勘定の資産残高は、３月末時点で３３兆９１６５億円。うち外貨建て資産は４兆５８６２億円（１３．５％）。

２０２６年度下期の相場見通し（レンジと年度末）は以下の通り。

日本国債１０年物利回り　　　２．７５―３．２５％（年度末３．１０％）

日本国債３０年物利回り　　　３．７５―４．２５％（年度末４．１０％）

米国債１０年物利回り　　　　４．５０―５．５０％（同５．００％）

日経平均株価　　　　　　　　６万―７万５０００円（同６万８０００円）

ＮＹダウ　　　　　　　　　　５万─５万７０００ドル（同５万３５００ドル）

ドル／円　　　　　　　　　　１４０―１６２円　（同１５８円）

ユーロ／円　　　　　　　　　１７０―１９０円　（同１７９円）

The surge in the benchmark Japanese 10-year bond yield, up over 80 basis points this year, is starting to tease capital home, although recent safe-haven buying has pulled yields away from the three-decade high it hit in October.
Japanese investors sold a net 161.6 billion yen ($1.02 billion) of foreign long-term bonds through October 17, the smallest quantum in the streak, alongside 156.9 billion yen of short-term bills, Japan's Ministry of Finance data showed.
The pace of selling slowed as US Treasury yields eased from multi-decade highs, as investors sought safety in bonds from the ruction in the stock market over AI worries.

The benchmark 10-year US yield retreated by roughly 27 basis points from a 24-1/2-year high of 5.3645 per cent hit earlier this month.
Meanwhile, the 10-year French government bond yield climbed to a 24-year high of 5.022 per cent on Wednesday amid concerns over widespread protests in France.
The latest sales brought Japanese investors' total net disposals of foreign long-term bonds over the five weeks to about 3.43 trillion yen, taking year-to-date net sales to 5.18 trillion yen, the largest for the comparable period since 2022.
Domestic Japanese banks have led this year's selling, while life insurers have signalled plans to maintain or increase their domestic bond purchases in the second half of the fiscal year.
Investor focus this week will be on the investment plans from life insurers, who manage about $2.5 trillion in assets, about a quarter of which is held overseas, according to the Life Insurance Association of Japan.
In overseas equity markets, Japanese investors made net purchases of 128.3 billion yen in foreign stocks, marking their fifth weekly net buying in the past six weeks.
Meanwhile, foreign investors were net buyers of Japanese long-term bonds for a third consecutive week, purchasing a net 1.45 trillion yen during the week.
However, they sold 2.24 trillion yen of short-term bills, the largest weekly disposal in three weeks.

MANILA, Oct 22 : The Philippine central bank raised its key policy rate by a larger-than-expected 50 basis points (bps) to 5.5 per cent on Thursday, calling it a "decisive" move to combat price pressures while saying it was ready to tighten policy more to cool inflation.
"The Monetary Board recognized the need for a strong monetary policy response to broadening price pressures and further upside risks to inflation," the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) said in a statement.
The rate hike, the fourth consecutive increase, defied market expectations; all 27 economists polled by Reuters penciled in a quarter-point increase.
"Such a decisive response will make monetary policy appropriately restrictive," the BSP said. "This will contain second-round effects and firmly anchor inflation expectations."
