items.title: Musk’s public endorsement of SpaceX-Tesla deal may throw a wrench in talks
items.author: Milana Vinn
items.creator: Milana Vinn
items.summary: Elon Musk's public endorsement of a potential $3.5 trillion merger has rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks.
items.body:
Elon Musk's [USN:L4N4661IU TEXT:"public endorsement"] this week of a potential $3.5 trillion merger between SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) has rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, according to a person with direct knowledge of the talks.
The disclosure created a "mess" for the process, as it could lead to questions about how well Tesla shareholders' interests would be represented, the person said. The concerns reflect similarities some participants see with Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, which sparked years of litigation over Musk's role in the deal.
Musk, who serves as CEO of both SpaceX and Tesla and owns significant stakes in each company, this week told investors that the two companies were examining what would be the largest corporate transaction in history and revealed that both had formed special committees to evaluate it. The backlash to those remarks is reported here for the first time.
The parties have hired advisers, but discussions are at an early stage, three sources familiar with the matter said. SpaceX approached Tesla in recent weeks, and the companies have been discussing a range of transaction structures, including a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a merger under a newly formed holding company, the person familiar with the matter said. They are weighing different forms of merger consideration, including an all-stock deal, the person said. These details of the talks have not been previously reported.
Tesla, SpaceX and Musk did not respond to requests for comment.
SHAREHOLDER LITIGATION OVER TESLA'S SOLARCITY DEAL In related-party transactions such as a SpaceX-Tesla merger, independent board members typically oversee the process to safeguard public shareholders' interests.
That issue loomed large in Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, which triggered [USN:L1N36V3J9 TEXT:"years of litigation"] after shareholders alleged the world's richest man had influenced the process to bail out his investment in the struggling rooftop solar company. At the time, Musk owned roughly 22% of both Tesla and SolarCity, which was founded by his cousins.
Shareholders argued that Musk's involvement and public support undermined the deal's fairness. Central to the case were [USN:L2N2OL1K9 TEXT:"claims that despite his minority stake"], Musk was a controlling shareholder of Tesla due to his ties to board members and domineering style.
The Delaware Supreme Court later noted that plaintiffs' contention of the absence of an independent committee, together with "certain other facts concerning Musk's involvement in and public support for the transaction," warranted the finding of unfair dealing.
The courts ultimately upheld the acquisition as fair, though it took several years for the case to be resolved and Tesla directors settled allegations for $60 million.
MUSK CANNOT BE INVOLVED IN TALKS Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and just under half of SpaceX, and analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity. On Tuesday's call with investors, Musk acknowledged that as a conflicted party he cannot be part of the discussions of the special committees. Advisers are also in contact with his lawyers to ensure Musk is recused from the merger discussions, the source familiar with the talks said.
Eric Talley, a law professor at Columbia University, said a merger could benefit shareholders by eliminating the need for Musk to divide his time between the two companies. He added that any legal challenge may be harder to predict than the SolarCity case because Tesla is now incorporated in Texas rather than Delaware.
“The Texas thing is a wild card. No one knows how Texas deals with cases like this because Texas never dealt with cases like this,” Talley said, noting that Texas has sought to establish itself as a business-friendly alternative to Delaware, and Musk’s comments so far were not necessarily problematic.
Ultimately, he said, litigation risk would hinge on the terms of any transaction.
"Who's going to get the better side of this deal? And that's usually what gives rise to litigation," Talley said.
MUSK'S COMMENTS COULD AFFECT DISCUSSIONS People involved in the process worry Musk's public endorsement of the merger and disclosure of talks could intensify investor scrutiny, as interested parties typically avoid expressing views publicly while independent directors evaluate a deal, the source said.
The SolarCity case could become a reference point for investors and courts assessing any future SpaceX-Tesla transaction if advisers fail to fully insulate the special committees from Musk's influence, the source added.
A tie-up between Tesla and SpaceX would be the biggest deal in history, creating one of the world's largest industrial and technology groups. It would surpass Musk's acquisition earlier this year of his artificial intelligence company xAI by SpaceX, which ranks among the largest corporate transactions ever announced.
A deal of this size would also face scrutiny from global regulators, especially due to Tesla’s business in China and SpaceX’s work in US defense and AI.

items.title: ロシアとウクライナ、攻撃応酬続く　米特使は和平仲介
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［キーウ　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［キーウ　２２日　ロイター］ - ウクライナの首都キーウで２２日未明、ミサイルが着弾した。ロイター記者が明らかにした。一方、ウクライナは夜間に数百機のドローン（無人機）をロシアの首都モスクワに向けて発射した。戦争終結に向けた米国の仲介にもかかわらず、両国は激しい攻撃を続けている。

キーウ当局によると、ロシアの攻撃で１５人が負傷し、市内を流れるドニプロ川に架かる南橋の地下鉄設備が損傷。橋の通行も制限された。キーウでは２１日夕にも攻撃があり、６人が負傷している。

ウクライナ北東部ハルキウ州のシネグボフ知事は通信アプリ「テレグラム」で、ロシアの攻撃により女性１人が死亡し、他に４人が負傷したと明らかにした。

ポルタワ州クレメンチュク地区でもエネルギーインフラにドローンが着弾した。クレメンチュクは主要な工業都市で、ウクライナ最大級の製油所がある。

ロシアでは、ソビャニン・モスクワ市長がテレグラムで、夜間に６３０機のドローンが首都に向けて飛来し、近郊で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。

トランプ米政権のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、戦争終結を仲介するため、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、ロシアのプーチン大統領と協議した。

5年目に入ったウクライナとロシアの戦争は、戦闘でのドローン活用を象徴する事例の1つとなった。ドローンは軍事戦略を塗り替え、戦場の様相を変えており、双方がこの技術への投資を続けている。

ウラセンコさんは、救助のドローンが到着した瞬間を忘れられないと語った。

「ヘリコプターが着陸するようだった。ものすごいごう音だった。このうなり音は、一生忘れない。あの瞬間には、味さえあった。どんな味か説明できないが、確かにあった。信じられない体験だった」

ウラセンコさんは、ロシア軍のドローンが投下した弾薬で脚と首を負傷した。ここから長い試練が始まった。負傷しながらも、間に合わせの避難場所まで何とかはって移動し、何カ月も身を隠した。

ウラセンコさんは感情をあらわにしながら、自身の救助に向かった兵士たちが、その途中で命を落としたと語った。

そして、生き延びるために下した壮絶な決断を明かした。

「恐ろしい瞬間が何度かあった。自分で脚を切断した時もそうだ。脚が後ろに引きずられるだけになり、切断するしかなかった。引きずるたびに、骨がますますむき出しになった」

「やるしかなかった。あの脚が邪魔になっていた。もう助けようがなかった。だから切ることにした。切断して止血帯を巻き、すぐに包帯を巻いた。出血が止まったので、止血帯を緩めた。その時には、もう両脚ともなかった。両脚を失ったまま、陣地にとどまった」

今は戦闘地域を離れたウラセンコさんは、心の傷と重傷からの回復を目指している。それは戦争の中でもひときわ壮絶な体験だった。

items.title: メタに豪で集団訴訟、子どもへの有害コンテンツや依存巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [シドニー ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[シドニー ２２日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズ傘下のフェイスブックとインスタグラムが子どもを有害なコンテンツにさらし、アルゴリズムによって依存状態を持続させたとして、オーストラリアの裁判所に集団訴訟が提起された。

法律事務所ミンターエリソンが今月、オーストラリアで最高裁に次ぐ連邦裁判所に提訴した。交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）が利用者、特に子どもや１０代の若者に害を及ぼしたとして責任を問う訴訟は、同国で初めてとなる可能性がある。

・訴訟は原告８人を代表して起こされた。原告らは１８歳未満の時にメタから被害を受けたと主張し、賠償を求めている。

・メタの広報担当者は電子メールで「この訴訟については承知しており、断固として争う」と述べた。

・裁判所は１９日に出した報道禁止命令で、原告の身元が特定される可能性のある情報と訴状の内容を報じることを禁じた。

・オーストラリアでは、世界初となる１６歳未満のＳＮＳ利用禁止に加え、利用者がフィード上でアルゴリズムに基づくコンテンツ表示を無効にできるようにする新たな規則案を受け、政府と巨大ＩＴ企業の緊張が高まっている。今回の訴訟はこうした中で起こされた。

・メタは８月、子どもを依存させるようＳＮＳを設計したとの訴えを巡り、米国のほぼ全ての州と和解し、１８０億ドルを支払うことに合意した。

items.title: Typhoon Champi nears Taiwan, causing flight cancellations and disrupting US-Japan drills
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Taiwan issued a land warning on Thursday as powerful Typhoon Champi approached, prompting more than 200 flight cancellations in the region and forcing changes to a major US-Japan military exercise.
items.body:
Taiwan issued a land warning on Thursday as powerful Typhoon Champi approached, prompting more than 200 flight cancellations in the region and forcing changes to a major US-Japan military exercise.
At one point a super typhoon and one of the strongest storms in the Pacific this year, Champi weakened slightly on Thursday but was still packing gusts of more than 227 kph (141 mph) near its centre, according to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration (CWA).
The storm was about 520 km (320 miles) southeast of Taiwan's southern tip, the CWA said. The storm's track shows it will pass northeastern Taiwan, turn north toward the Chinese coast and eventually move into southern Japan.
The administration said its radius expanded slightly to 320 km (199 miles), large enough to cover most of Taiwan, and weather experts said its impact could last nearly two days.
Coastal towns received mobile phone alerts warning of waves exceeding 6 metres (20 feet), while nearly a metre (3 feet) of rain was forecast in northern mountain areas, including the hills near Taipei.
Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te called for the public to get ready now for the typhoon, and avoid going to the mountains or the coast.
"A little more preparation means less risk," he wrote on his Facebook page.
Taiwan's transport ministry said 125 flights had been cancelled on Thursday, mostly domestic ones, though the rail network was so far unaffected. The interior ministry said no evacuations of residents had yet been reported.
Taiwan is generally very well prepared for typhoons, which keeps casualties low. Although more common in summer, the storms can strike in autumn, bringing strong winds and torrential rain.
The typhoon is also forecast to pass over Japan's westernmost inhabited island, Yonaguni, in Okinawa Prefecture.
In Japan, major carriers Japan Airlines, ANA and Skymark have cancelled more than 100 flights, mostly domestic, between Thursday and Sunday, disrupting travel for over 11,000 passengers.
The approaching storm is also disrupting the major military exercise called Keen Sword that is underway around Japanese islands near Taiwan.
Held every two years, the exercise rehearses Japan's defence through coordinated land, sea and air operations, including missile defence drills and amphibious landings. It began on Monday, involving about 56,000 Japanese and US personnel alongside forces from five other countries, including the Philippines and Australia.
"Training activities are being adjusted on a day-to-day basis to ensure the safety of all participants," the US military said.

JERUSALEM: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and plans to withdraw family members from a number of other US missions in the region, US officials told Reuters.
The order came as attacks in Saudi Arabia killed at least one person and injured eight others at a civilian airport in Dammam and two people were killed in a drone attack on an oil field.
State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a post on X that the department ordered the departure of "non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only" amid attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis in Yemen on civilian targets in the country.
Washington had returned some diplomatic personnel to the region in recent months after many were pulled out when Tehran launched attacks on US facilities after the US-Israeli war on Iran began in late February.

"Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions," Pigott said.

Related:

UK to deploy fighter jets to help protect Saudi from Houthi attacks

Singaporeans advised to defer all travel to Saudi Arabia amid heightened security risks: MFA

Four US officials told Reuters that US missions in other Gulf states would also be ordering family members to leave. Pigott did not address changes to other missions outside Saudi Arabia.
The latest withdrawals follow an escalation of the fighting in Yemen, opening another front in the regional conflict triggered by the US-Israeli war on Iran. The wider conflict has snarled global energy trade and hurt Gulf economies.
After the departure order, Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority reported an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam that killed one person and injured eight others. Earlier in the day, two people were killed after Saudi air defences intercepted a drone that was attempting to hit a facility at Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oilfield, the energy ministry said.
The US embassy in Riyadh issued a security alert on Wednesday (Oct 21) about possible further attacks by the Houthis on Saudi Arabia, after recent deadly strikes including on Riyadh's airport.
The embassy and a CIA station hosted there came under attack by drones in early March, as Iran began launching attacks across the region.

FAST

Cloud services firm Cloudflare saw millions of exploitation attempts after the public disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in the widely used programming language PHP , CEO Matthew Prince said in a post on X late on Wednesday. 
"In the 10 hours before it was publicly announced, across the network we saw thousands of attempts to exploit it. That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours, and millions now," Prince said. 
Government websites in Europe and elsewhere went offline on Wednesday after the disclosure of vulnerabilities in PHP sent website operators around the world scrambling to protect their systems.
Japanese lender Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group said it was temporarily suspending some internet services due to emergency measures. 
Developers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday released urgent new fixes to vulnerabilities that had been lurking in their software for years until they were uncovered using AI, saying all users were "encouraged to update immediately."
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi also urged website owners on Wednesday to check whether their sites use PHP and prepare to apply the new fix. 
Japan's Finance Ministry also temporarily suspended some website content and services while security measures were being implemented. 

Source: Reuters/aj

items.title: Companies and governments rush to patch PHP flaws as hacking attempts surge into millions
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Companies and governments worldwide rushed on Thursday to patch critical flaws in the widely used PHP programming language, as a cybersecurity company reported millions of hacking attempts after the vulnerabilities were disclosed.
items.body:
Companies and governments worldwide rushed on Thursday to patch critical flaws in the widely used PHP programming language, as a cybersecurity company reported millions of hacking attempts after the vulnerabilities were disclosed.
The push came after governments in Europe and elsewhere took websites [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"offline"] as a precaution on Wednesday while website operators scrambled to secure systems running the software.
The emergency shutdowns of banking, airline, rail, tax and government services from Tokyo to Helsinki showed how much public and corporate systems rely on the software, and how hard it is to fix such flaws quickly once they are made public.
"It was a long day and a long night, I know for all the IT and security folks ... I've not seen anything like this in a long, long time," Microsoft (MSFT.O) CEO Satya Nadella said at a company event in Cologne, Germany, on Thursday.
He said the episode underscored the importance of building digital systems that can be maintained securely.
PHP developers released urgent [USN:L6N4670ZW TEXT:"fixes"] on Wednesday for vulnerabilities that had lurked in the software for years until they were uncovered using AI, urging users to "update immediately".
As companies and governments deployed patches and suspended websites as a precaution, hacking attempts surged into the millions, according to cloud services firm Cloudflare (NET.N) .
"In the 10 hours before it was publicly announced, across the network we saw thousands of attempts to exploit it," Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said in a post on social media X late on Wednesday.
"That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours, and millions now."
FROM JAPAN TO FINLAND Japanese companies including brokerage Nomura (8604.T) , lender Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306.T) , airline ANA (9202.T) and East Japan Railway (9020.T) said on Thursday they were temporarily suspending some internet services as part of emergency measures.
Insurer Tokio Marine Holdings (8766.T) said it had suspended the website of a group company.
Japan's Ministry of Finance and Meteorological Agency partially suspended online services to implement safety measures, while Japan's National Tax Agency temporarily took down its service.
The precautionary shutdowns underscore growing concerns over cybersecurity in Japan, which [USN:L1N45U0IU TEXT:"recorded"] more cyber incidents in the first nine months of the year than in all of last year, according to data from TrendAI.
French telecoms group Orange (ORAN.PA) said it had temporarily suspended access to certain PHP-based websites and applications across several subsidiaries as a precaution.
Tencent Cloud, one of China's largest cloud-computing providers, urged customers to install updated PHP versions but stopped short of calling for widespread website shutdowns.
Finland's state IT services provider Valtori said it had continued installing PHP security patches overnight and was gradually lifting precautionary service blocks after [USN:S8N3WF054 TEXT:"shutting down"] government public web services a day earlier.
"Restoring services can take days or even weeks, as in addition to updates, the systems need to be carefully tested," Valtori Director General Hannu Naumanen said in a statement.
Valtori said the outages were not caused by exploitation of the vulnerabilities or by a cyber breach, and that it was not aware of any active exploitation of the flaws.
Several Asian governments ordered cybersecurity inspections related to the PHP vulnerabilities on Thursday.
China's industry ministry urged organizations and users to inspect systems immediately and upgrade to the latest secure version of PHP. It also recommended strengthening cybersecurity monitoring and changing accounts, passwords and keys where necessary.
South Korea raised its private-sector cybersecurity alert level and activated emergency response measures, citing concerns over an increased risk of hacking attacks.

Oct 22 : Strong demand for electrified cars helped Europe's new-car market grow in September, offsetting another sharp decline in petrol and diesel vehicle sales, data from the European Automobile Manufacturers' Association showed on Thursday.
New-car registrations, a proxy for sales, rose 10.2 per cent year-on-year to 1.36 million vehicles across the European Union, Britain and the European Free Trade Association, ACEA said.
Demand for electrified vehicles remained strong across major European markets, supported by purchase incentives and a broader model lineup.
• Battery-electric, plug-in hybrid and hybrid car registrations jumped 59.9 per cent, 24 per cent and 5.3 per cent, respectively, and together accounted for 76.2 per cent of all new vehicles

アンソロピック、独立型ＡＩエージェント「デュエット」発表
13:05 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ。10月19日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２１日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックは、専門職や小規模事業者向けの能動的アシスタントとして機能する独立型ＡＩエージェントアプリ「クロード・デュエット」を発表した。

オープンＡＩやメタ・プラットフォームズなどの競合各社が、利用者に代わって自律的に業務を遂行するＡＩエージェントの開発を競っている。

• アンソロピックによると、デュエットは毎日、重要事項をまとめて報告するほか、会議の日程調整から財務予測やウェブアプリの作成まで幅広い業務を処理する。

• 利用待ちリストへの登録が必要な研究プレビュー版として、ｉＯＳ、アンドロイド、ｃｌａｕｄｅ．ａｉで利用できる。利用者が連携させたアプリを確認し、指示を待つのではなく、対応が必要な項目を知らせる。

• アンソロピックのＡＩモデル「Ｏｐｕｓ（オーパス）５．５」を基盤とし、当初は米国の「Ｐｒｏ」と「Ｍａｘ」プランの契約者を対象に提供する。利用上限は既存サービスと共通となる。

•  オープンＡＩは９月、スラックやマイクロソフトの「チームズ」など複数のアプリを横断し、利用者の目標達成に向けて動く常時稼働型エージェント「ｄｏｔｓ（ドッツ）」を投入した。一方、メタのＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」はダウンロード数が数百万件に達し、自律型ＡＩサービスに対する投資家の関心を高めた。

• デュエットは「クロード・マーケットプレイス」にあるＧメールやスラックなど６０００超の連携機能に対応する。ストライプのデジタルウォレット「Ｌｉｎｋ」やショッピファイの「Ｓｈｏｐ　Ｐａｙ」を使った購入も可能だ。

•  アンソロピックは、慎重な扱いを要する操作には利用者の承認が必要だと説明した。また、緊急性を誤って判断する場合があり、チケットの予約など個人的なタスクでは依然として効果が限定的だを認めた。

items.title: Gold hits over two-week low as oil rally fuels inflation worries
items.author: Vishak Mathew
items.creator: Vishak Mathew
items.summary: Gold slipped to its lowest level in more than two weeks on Thursday as a rally in oil prices heightened inflation worries, with the Federal Reserve due to deliver its policy decision next week.
items.body:
Gold slipped to its lowest level in more than two weeks on Thursday as a rally in oil prices heightened inflation worries, with the Federal Reserve due to deliver its policy decision next week.
Spot gold slid 1.4% to $4,081.89 per ounce by 0902 GMT.
US gold futures for December delivery fell 1.3% to $4,097.90 per ounce.
"Gold prices can fall further... because we are still seeing a lot of uncertainty around the energy market," said Soni Kumari, analyst at ANZ.
Oil prices rallied over $2 a barrel on Thursday after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns over a broader escalation of conflict and further disruptions to crude supplies.
While gold is typically considered a hedge against inflation, higher interest rates reduce the appeal of the non-yielding asset.
Last week's US [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer"] and [USN:L1N4610KT TEXT:"producer"] inflation data came in hotter than expected, largely because energy costs keep climbing. That strengthens the case for tighter policy, even though Fed officials are still expected to [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"hold off"] when they meet on October 27-28.
Goldman Sachs expects one more 25-basis-point hike in December, lifting the peak policy rate range to 4.00%-4.25%.
Traders are pricing in a 91% likelihood of an increase in December, according to CME's FedWatch Tool .
US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data, set for release on October 29 and closely watched by the central bank, could give more clues on rate outlook.
"Given that the PCE data will show that prices rose at an uncomfortably high pace for the Fed, the FOMC communications may strike a hawkish tone and that could weigh on gold prices," Hamad Hussain, climate and commodities economist at Capital Economics, said.
Among other metals, spot silver dropped 3.7% to $55.86 per ounce, platinum slid 2.6% to $1,586.22, its lowest since July 2026, while palladium fell 3.2% to $1,052.88 after hitting its lowest level since June 2025.

items.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性で対応急ぐ企業、政府機関も影響　官房長官「状況注視」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - ウェブサイトの動作に使われるプログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことを受け...
items.body:
ＰＨＰ脆弱性で対応急ぐ企業、政府機関も影響　官房長官「状況注視」
12:37 配信

コンピューターサーバーのケーブル。ベルリンで10月21日撮影。REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - ウェブサイトの動作に使われるプログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことを受け、日本国内でも金融機関などの企業や自治体、政府機関などに影響が広がっている。木原稔官房長官は２２日午前の会見で「現時点で関係する被害の報告は受けていない」と明らかにすると同時に、企業などに修正パッチの適用を勧めており、政府として状況を注視し、対応していく考えを示した。

＜企業などへの影響＞

三菱ＵＦＪ銀行は三菱ＵＦＪダイレクトやスマート口座開設アプリなどによる投資信託口座開設やＮＩＳＡ利用申し込みなどを一時停止。日本生命は安全性確認のための予防的システム対応として、一部サイトやサービスを一時停止した。三井ＤＳアセットマネジメントでも、対象サービスを一時停止している。滋賀銀行もサーバーメンテナンスを実施しており、ホームページにアクセスできない状況となっている。

ＪＲ西日本は臨時のシステムメンテナンスで一部ＷＥＢページなどの利用を停止。福岡県はホームページの一部機能を停止している。

ウェブ技術調査会社Ｗ３Ｔｅｃｈｓによると、プログラミング言語を特定できるウェブサイトのうち約７５％でＰＨＰが使われている。

＜政府機関＞

木原官房長官によると、厚生労働省と財務省などが一部のコンテンツについて予防のために一時的に公開の停止措置を講じている。

＜政府対応＞

高市早苗首相は２１日夜、Ｘへの投稿で、運用中のサイトがＰＨＰを使用しているか確認し、新たな修正プログラムを適用できるよう準備してほしいとサイト運営者に呼びかけた。木原官房長官によると、政府は国家サイバー統括室を中心に政府関連機関や重要インフラ事業者などに幅広く修正パッチ適用の注意喚起行った。

＜市場＞

株式市場では一部米半導体製造装置メーカーの下落を受け、半導体関連を中心に売られ、全体相場が下落するなか、関連銘柄を物色する動きが活発化。サイバーセキュリティクラウドやトレンドマイクロなど、セキュリティ関連株が上昇した。

外国為替市場や円債市場に大きな動きはみられていない。

items.body:
午前のドルは157円後半へ軟化、米金利が低下　レンジ推移は継続
12:31 配信

日本の1万円紙幣。10月20日撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５７円後半へ軟化した。米金利が低下してドル売りに傾いた。ここ最近のレンジの範囲内での推移は変わらず、日米中銀の金融政策決定会合や米中間選挙を前に様子見ムードも強いとの声がある。

・ドル１５８円前半から一時１５７．６８円まで下落

・米長期金利低下、５．１％台から５．０８％付近に

・ユーロ／ドル、前日の高値を上抜け１．１２５５ドル付近まで上昇

・ドル１５７円後半から１５８円半ばのレンジ推移は続く

・日米中銀会合や米中間選挙待ち、積極的な売買手控え

・２００日移動平均線突破できず、上値の重さ意識

＜みなと銀行資金証券部ストラテジストの苅谷将吾氏＞

「２０日に２００日移動平均線を突破できず、上値の重さが意識されている」

「来週の中銀会合を控える中で手掛かりなく、積極的な売買は手控えられている」

「日銀が基調的物価上昇率について２％程度に到達したと判断するかは注目」

「実需勢は為替予約を済ませている参加者も多く、レンジをブレイクしないと実需勢も出てきづらい」

請求を受け宝ＨＤは、内容を慎重に検討した上で対応方針を決め次第、速やかに開示するとしている。

バリューアクトは宝ＨＤの株式を買い進め、現在約２０．０％を保有する。６年以上にわたり戦略の見直しや実行力改善を非公開の場で求めてきたが、取締役会が実質的な対話に応じなかったとして、株主権の行使に踏み切った。

宝ＨＤを巡っては、香港投資ファンドのオアシス・マネジメントも５．０９％の株式を保有していることが大量保有報告書で明らかになっている。

items.title: Rupee snaps eight-day rally as oil climbs to highest since May
items.author: Jaspreet Kalra
items.creator: Jaspreet Kalra
items.summary: The Indian rupee snapped an eight-session-long winning streak on Thursday as Brent oil prices climbed to their highest since May on deepening worries about conflict in the Middle East, which hammered global equities as well.
items.body:
The Indian rupee snapped an eight-session-long winning streak on Thursday as Brent oil prices climbed to their highest since May on deepening worries about conflict in the Middle East, which hammered global equities as well.
The South Asian currency endured a volatile trading session, swinging from its strongest level in over six weeks to close down 0.4% at 94.8175 per dollar.
Earlier in the day, chunky foreign inflows for Jio Platforms' IPO added to tailwinds from the Reserve Bank of India's defensive measures that had boosted the currency but its gains faded as oil prices climbed in the latter half.
Traders pointed to broad-based dollar demand locally alongside broader signs of a risk-off move in global markets.
MSCI's All-World index (.MIWD00000PUS) was set for its largest daily fall in two weeks, down 0.4%, as tech shares from Seoul and Tokyo to Amsterdam and Paris came under pressure. Equity futures pointed to a weak start for shares on Wall Street as well.
OIL PRICES REMAIN A KEY RISK Oil prices have remained elevated despite oil flows from the Gulf holding up, reflecting market anxieties over the conflict.
"The sizeable risk premium currently embedded in prices is unlikely to fade until clear signs of de-escalation emerge and reassure investors that regional supply will remain uninterrupted," ING said in a note. Brent oil prices were last up 3.3% at $112.40 per barrel.
India imports nearly 90% of its crude requirements, making it one of the world's most vulnerable economies to the Middle East oil shock. This remains a key risk for the rupee, with market participants and observers split over how sternly the RBI should defend the currency in the face of fundamental pressures.
While senior IMF official Krishna Srinivasan [USN:L4N4670Q1 TEXT:"said"] on Wednesday that India should allow the dollar-rupee exchange rate to move as the first line of defence, former RBI deputy governor Michael Debabrata Patra [USN:L4N4680AC TEXT:"told Reuters"] that exchange rates tend to overshoot and can cause financial stability risks.

items.title: Oil Market Fragmentation Is Making Crude Both Cheap and Expensive
items.author: Javier Blas
items.creator: Javier Blas
items.summary: With oil, as with real estate, it’s all about location, location, location. The petroleum market has never been truly global, but rather a loosely connected collection of regional sources. When prices diverged, barrels were shuttled to the most lucrative destination. But with freight rates ballooning to prohibitively expensive levels, the region-to-region flow has been disrupted. The result? The the oil market is fragmenting.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比１．０９％...
items.body:
午前の日経平均は反落、6万4000円割れ　ＡＩ・半導体株に売り
11:55 配信

東京証券取引所。２０１５年６月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Thomas Peter

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比１．０９％（７０３円８１銭）安の６万３９１７円４３銭となった。米半導体製造装置メーカーのラム・リサーチ株が決算発表後の時間外で下落したことを受けて、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が売られ、相場の重しとなった。前場終盤には下げ幅を拡大し、節目の６万４０００円を割り込んだ。

・日経平均は前営業日比０．１３％安でスタートした後、プラス転換したが、再びマイナス圏に沈んだ。

・２２日朝に公表されたラムリサーチの決算を受けて、同社株は時間外取引で下落。東京市場でも半導体関連株を中心に売りが強まる。個別では、東京エレクトロン、アドバンテストなど寄与度の高い銘柄が軟調。

・日経平均は前場終盤に１．１４％（７３８円）安の６万３８８２円７７銭まで下落。ＴＯＰＩＸは小幅安。

・物色面では、サイバーセキュリティ関連株が大幅高。ウェブサイトの動作に使われるプログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことを受け、思惑買いが広がった。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．２８％安の４０３２．２２ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆１１９１億９３００万円。

・東証３３業種では、保険、サービス、鉱業など２０業種が値上がり。非鉄金属、ガラス・土石製品、銀行など１３業種が値下がりした。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが７７６銘柄（５０％）、値下がりは７２１銘柄（４６％）、変わらずは５５銘柄（３％）。

＜東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボ　シニアアナリスト　澤田遼太郎氏＞

「足元のマーケットは弱気に傾いており、半導体関連株はネガティブな材料に大きく反応しやすくなっている。一番の支えは決算の期待感だが、相場のムードが弱気な上、投資家の期待も高く、決算が良くても素直に買われるかは不透明」

「ＰＨＰの脆弱性の問題は、今のところ株式市場全体を押し下げるほどのネガティブな材料にはなっていないとみる。ただ、一部企業ではサービスを停止する事態となり、上値を抑える要因として意識されているのではないか」

items.title: Indian shares extend losses as high oil prices heighten inflation worries
items.author: Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
items.creator: Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
items.summary: Indian shares fell for a third straight session on Thursday, as an escalating Middle East war pushed oil prices higher to $112 per barrel, stoking inflation concerns for the world's third-largest importer of crude.
items.body:
Indian shares fell for a third straight session on Thursday, as an escalating Middle East war pushed oil prices higher to $112 per barrel, stoking inflation concerns for the world's third-largest importer of crude.
The benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.54% to 22,687.65, and the Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.62% to 73,249.39. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) dropped 1.1% and 0.9%, respectively.
Other Asian markets also slumped to near three-month lows, after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia intensified concerns over broader escalation of conflict and fears of supply disruptions.
The attacks prompted the US to order some diplomats and family members to leave its missions in the kingdom.
"Higher crude prices remains the key overhang for markets as they heighten price pressures in the economy, besides potentially weighing on corporate profit margins," said Sanjeeb Hota, director, head of strategy of equities at Standard Chartered India.
"It should also be noted that markets had logged strong gains last week and this could just be profit taking, rather than any adverse view on earnings," Hota said.
Thirteen of the 16 major sectors logged losses, with IT (.NIFTYIT) , energy (.NIFTYENR) and FMCG (.NIFTYFMCG) losing the most percentage-wise.
Heavyweight stocks on the benchmarks, HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) and Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) , fell 1.8% and 2%, respectively.
Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services (MMFS.NS) slid 3.3%, with multiple brokerages flagging mounting funding costs and risks from insurance distribution reforms.
Nestle India (NEST.NS) dipped 2.8%, Abbott India (ABOT.NS) dropped 1.3% and Zydus Wellness (ZYDS.NS) declined 3.4% after receiving notices from India's food safety regulator.
Abbott said it was not aware of the social media content cited by the regulator until receiving the notice, and that it did not endorse the claims. Nestle said the notice reiterated earlier label-related concerns to which it had submitted a detailed response. Zydus Wellness did not respond to Reuters' request for comment.
Cybersecurity firm eMudhra (EMUD.NS) slid 20%, taking its two-session losses to 36%, after the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team issued an advisory stating that some of eMudhra's intermediate certificates were compromised.

items.title: JSW Steel Q2 results preview: Adj. PAT could grow 60-110% YoY, say analysts
items.summary: Elara Capital said that steel demand remained resilient, supported by channel restocking ahead of expected price hikes.
items.body:
Home / Markets / News / JSW Steel Q2 results preview: Adj. PAT could grow 60-110% YoY, say analysts

JSW Steel Q2 results preview: Adj. PAT could grow 60-110% YoY, say analysts Elara Capital said that steel demand remained resilient, supported by channel restocking ahead of expected price hikes.

JSW Steel, JSW (Photo: Reuters)

SI Reporter New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 22 2026 | 2:49 PM IST

Listen to This Article

JSW Steel Q2 results preview : Integrated steel producer JSW Steel could report strong growth in net profit for the July-September quarter (Q2) of the financial year 2026-27 (FY27), helped by firmer prices, limiting the usual seasonal pressure on profitability.
  Domestic hot-rolled coil (HRC) and cold-rolled coil (CRC) prices remained firm in Q2FY27, up ~21-22 per cent YoY and ~3–4 per cent QoQ, respectively. The primary rebar and semis prices declined in the second quarter, falling ~3 per cent QoQ and ~1 per cent QoQ, respectively.
  Elara Capital said that steel demand remained resilient, supported by channel restocking ahead of expected price hikes, healthy demand from the pipe sector, improving construction activity following a patchy monsoon, and strong auto demand, particularly for galvanized products.
 

  Against this backdrop, JSW Steel is expected to post a 60-110 per cent year-on-year (YoY) rise in the adjusted net profit for the quarter under review, while its net sales could grow in double digits.
  JSW Steel Q2 preview Here's what brokerages expect:

  Kotak Institutional Equities (KIE)
According to KIE, the net sales could rise 23.2 per cent year-on-year (YoY) and 17.6 per cent quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) to ₹54,888.4 crore while the adjusted profit could see a 110.7 per cent YoY and 7 per cent QoQ rise to ₹4,965.5 crore.
  The brokerage said it expects JSW Steel's India operations (ex-BPSL) to report volumes of ~7 million tons (+13.2 per cent YoY and +17 per cent QoQ), with JVML volumes at ~1.1 million tons. "We build in seasonal price weakness with standalone steel realizations to decrease by 1.1 per cent QoQ (+27 per cent YoY)," it said.

  Further, it estimates India operations' EBITDA/ton to decrease to ₹13,744/ton (+26 per cent YoY and -10.1 per cent QoQ) led by QoQ lower realizations/higher coking coal costs during the quarter.
  Motilal Oswal Financial Services (MOFSL)
According to MOFSL, the adjusted PAT could rise 60 per cent YoY to ₹3300 crore on the back of a 7 per cent growth in sales in Q2 FY27.
  The brokerage said that a flat-to-marginal rise in NSR will support earnings. Meanwhile, sales volume is expected to remain healthy over capacity ramp-up.
  Guidance on capex status and demand/pricing outlook along with commentary on cost inflation will be key monitorables, said MOFSL analysts.

  Disclaimer: Views and outlook in this report belong to the brokerages and analysts cited. They do not reflect the views of Business Standard. Readers are advised to exercise discretion.

Stocks fall, bonds gain as Meta dents tech optimism

FAST

LONDON, Oct 22 : Global stocks retreated on Thursday, as tech earnings' optimism provided only fleeting support and was offset by nagging concern over the outlook for AI, while stalemate in the Gulf pushed up oil prices.
MSCI's All-World index was set for its largest daily fall in two weeks, down 0.4 per cent, as tech shares from Seoul and Tokyo to Amsterdam and Paris tumbled. 
Meta, the first of the so-called AI hyperscalers to publish quarterly results, reported third-quarter revenue late on Wednesday that beat expectations. But any optimism was short-lived, after the company unveiled a plan to issue non-voting stock that revived concern over its mounting capital commitments.
"There are lots of cross currents in markets at the moment, which are grappling for a narrative right now," Ben Laidler, head of macro and equity strategy at Bradesco BBI, said.

"The big concern is that AI-driven earnings narrative, which has supported US earnings and spread to global equities, may be challenged here."
Meta also suffered a legal blow overnight, after a judge in New Mexico ordered the company to pay a $25 billion penalty to the state in a data privacy case.
In Europe, the STOXX 600 fell 1 per cent, weighed down by tech-related stocks such as ASML, Schneider Electric and Siemens Energy. US stock futures fell between 1 per cent and 2 per cent, suggesting a drop at the open bell later.
Shares in Meta fell around 0.8 per cent and those in Tesla, which also reported earnings and cut its spending forecast ahead of a possible merger with SpaceX, dropped nearly 5 per cent in the premarket.
Geopolitical concerns played out in oil markets, where Brent crude rose 3 per cent to $112 a barrel, near a five-month high, after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia raised the risk of wider conflict and supply disruptions in the Middle East.
There was enough nervousness about the possible damage to the global economy to offset concern about a sustained pickup in inflation to drive flows into government bonds, which pushed US Treasury yields down by the most in a week. The 10-year note was last 7 basis points lower at 5.075 per cent, trading below that of France for the first time in 13 years.
French government bonds have been battered this month, driving yields above 5 per cent for the first time since 2002, as investors looked for signs the government can contain social unrest and bring spending under control.
The euro, which has been dragged 0.8 per cent lower this month, was steady on Thursday, trading around $1.1241, leaving the dollar index, which tracks the US currency against a basket of six others, down 0.1 per cent. 
The yen drew safe-haven demand, leaving the dollar down 0.7 per cent on the day at 157.1, after Deputy Bank of Japan Governor Ryozo Himino signalled his readiness to raise borrowing costs. The Korean won was muted at 1324, after the Bank of Korea left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.00 per cent on Thursday.
Gold missed out on safe-haven flows, dropping 1.2 per cent to $4,090 an ounce, while in cryptocurrencies, bitcoin and ether both lost 3 per cent to trade at $82,000 and $2,412, respectively. 
(Additional reporting by Jiaxing Li in Hong Kong; Editing by Kate Mayberry, Shri Navaratnam and Susan Fenton)

Source: Reuters

ANKARA: Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement on Wednesday (Oct 21) to boost defence cooperation and strengthen defensive capabilities, the Turkish Defence Ministry said.
In a statement, the ministry said the countries signed the Badr Memorandum of Understanding in Doha as a sign of their desire to further deepen cooperation and develop partnerships.
"The agreement holds substantial economic importance," it said, adding the accord sought to foster cooperation in military production, boost military capabilities, and help collaboration in technical military training, research and development.
"By leveraging the unique military production capabilities of each country, the initiative will facilitate cooperation and integration, enhance defence industrial capacities, and enable the fulfilment of the needs of allied and friendly nations," it added.

Türkiye, which has NATO's second-largest army and a robust defence industry, has been helping Gulf nations, including Qatar, where it has a military base, bolster their defences amid the Iran war.
In August, it signed a mutual defence pact with nuclear-armed Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, under which an attack on one party constitutes an attack on all. Ankara also has close ties with Indonesia, notably in the defence industry.
The ministry said the Badr accord would strengthen ties between the countries' defence industries and bolster collaboration to promote security and achieve shared objectives.
Haluk Gorgun, the chairman of Türkiye's Defence Industry Presidency, said the accord formed the foundation of a "strategic cooperation" to develop joint production and technology.
"Technology sharing, joint development and strengthening domestic production capabilities lie at the heart of sustainable defence industry. As Türkiye, we value partnerships that go beyond off-the-shelf procurement models, that foster the development of a nation’s own human capital and industrial infrastructure," Gorgun said in a statement.
"We believe that the Badr Memorandum of Understanding will contribute to transforming the complementary capabilities of Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia, and Türkiye into concrete projects," he added.

items.title: インド中銀、追加利上げ示唆　積極引き締めには慎重＝議事要旨
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ムンバイ ２１日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（ＲＢＩ、中央銀行）は２１日、７日に開いた金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）の議...
items.body:
インド中銀、追加利上げ示唆　積極引き締めには慎重＝議事要旨
11:07 配信

ムンバイにあるインド準備銀行（RBI）本部で8月撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

[ムンバイ ２１日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（ＲＢＩ、中央銀行）は２１日、７日に開いた金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）の議事要旨を公表した。それによると、委員らはインフレ抑制のために追加利上げが必要になる可能性を示唆した一方、経済成長へのリスクを踏まえ、積極的な金融引き締めサイクルを支持するまでには至らなかった。

ＲＢＩは７日、主要政策金利であるレポ金利を全会一致で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、５．５０％とした。利上げは約４年ぶり。金融政策のスタンスは「中立」から「調整された引き締め」へ変更した。マルホトラ総裁はこの変更は実質的に利下げの可能性がなくなったことを示していると述べた。

インドでは中東戦争による原油価格の急騰やモンスーン降雨量の不足を受けて食品価格が上昇し、インフレ懸念が強まっている。このため市場では、今後１２カ月間で１００ｂｐ強の利上げが織り込まれている。

マルホトラ総裁は議事要旨で「インフレが幅広い分野に広がりつつある兆候が強まっている」と指摘した。

インドの９月の消費者物価上昇率（ＣＰＩ）は５．５４％と、市場予想を上回る伸びとなり、中銀の許容上限である６％に近づいた。これにより追加利上げの必要性が強まっている。

中銀は最新の見通しで、１０－１２月期の平均インフレ率が６％になると予測している。

グプタ副総裁はこうした状況を踏まえ「インフレの広がりを示す、より決定的な証拠を待つよりも、金融政策の効果には時間差があることを意識すべきだ」と主張。「インフレ率を低水準に抑え、インフレ期待を安定させるためには、政策金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ＭＰＣ委員のサウガタ・バタチャリヤ氏は議事要旨で「あらゆる情報を総括すると、現時点では金融政策を引き締める強い経済的根拠がある」と指摘し、「あまりに急速な政策金利の調整は、成長を抑制するリスクがある」と付け加えた。

ただ最終的にどの程度の金融引き締めが必要になるかについては、委員やエコノミストの間で見方が分かれている。

ＭＰＣ委員のナゲシュ・クマール氏とラム・シン氏はともに、金融政策スタンスの変更に反対した。シン氏は特に、この変更が長期にわたる利上げサイクルを示唆する可能性があるが、現時点ではその必要性はないと主張した。

シン氏は議事要旨で「現段階では、長期にわたる利上げサイクルの継続ではなく、小幅かつ段階的なレポ金利の引き上げが妥当だ」と指摘。積極的な金融引き締めの見通しは、金利に敏感な分野にとどまらず、需要全体を弱める可能性があると述べた。

items.title: CPP and OAS: Should you take the money or wait?: Stan Wong
items.summary: Who would turn down a 42 per cent pay raise? That is effectively the choice facing Canadians deciding when to collect their Canada Pension Plan (CPP).
items.body:
Who would turn down a 42 per cent pay raise? That is effectively the choice facing Canadians deciding when to collect their Canada Pension Plan (CPP).
Waiting until 70 rather than starting at 65 increases monthly payments by 42 per cent. The catch? Five years without collecting a penny.

Clients frequently ask me whether they should begin collecting CPP as early as age 60, wait until 65 or defer until 70, and when they should start Old Age Security (OAS). Many instinctively favour taking the money early. But the better question is how these decisions fit into their overall financial plan.
Do you actually need the income? Consider two retirees, both aged 65. One has a workplace pension, substantial investments, and no immediate need for additional income. Deferring CPP could strengthen financial security later. The other relies on investment withdrawals to pay everyday expenses. Collecting earlier might reduce the need to sell investments during a market downturn.
The same pension rules can produce very different answers. A comprehensive financial plan can project cash flow, compare investment withdrawals, and identify the trade-offs of waiting, including forgone returns and potential taxes.
Taxes can change the calculation Both CPP and OAS are taxable, but only OAS faces an income-tested recovery tax, commonly called the clawback.
For the 2026 income year, the OAS clawback starts above $95,323 in individual net income, with 15 cents recovered for each additional dollar. This generally affects recoveries from July 2027 through June 2028. At a net income of $120,000, including OAS, roughly $3,700 would be recovered. For recipients aged 65 to 74, the benefit can be fully clawed back at $155,320.
CPP has no comparable clawback, although receiving it can increase taxable income and, consequently, OAS repayments. The broader retirement income picture is crucial: someone retiring before mandatory withdrawals from a registered retirement income fund (RRIF) begin may benefit from drawing down savings in a registered retirement savings plan (RRSP) during lower-income years while deferring benefits. Someone expecting substantial RRIF income later might face larger OAS clawbacks even after waiting.
Coordinating pension income, registered account withdrawals and income-splitting opportunities can change which starting dates are most tax-efficient.
The financial reward for waiting CPP can start at 60, with payments reduced by 36 per cent relative to 65. After 65, payments increase by 0.7 per cent for each month deferred, reaching 42 per cent at 70.
OAS can start at 65. Waiting increases payments by 0.6 per cent monthly, or 36 per cent at 70. Neither benefit increases further for deferral beyond 70.
Someone entitled to $1,000 monthly in CPP at 65 would receive $1,420 at 70, before future inflation adjustments. The maximum monthly OAS payment for aged 65 to 74 is $762.50 in late 2026. A 36 per cent increase would lift that base payment to approximately $1,037, before indexing. Both benefits are inflation-adjusted, and OAS rises automatically another 10 per cent at 75.
How long must you live to come out ahead? Delaying $1,000 monthly in CPP from 65 to 70 means forgoing $60,000, then receiving an additional $420 monthly. On a simple cumulative-payment basis, the higher benefit catches up near age 82. For OAS, the comparable break-even is around age 83, accounting for the 10 per cent increase at 75 applicable to both starting ages. Taxes, inflation, and investment returns can change these results.
According to the Office of the Chief Actuary’s 32nd CPP report , a Canadian man aged 65 in 2025 is projected to live another 21.6 years, reaching approximately age 87; for women, the projection is 24.1 years, reaching approximately age 89.
These averages cannot predict individual outcomes. Health, lifestyle, and family history should inform longevity assumptions. For those who live into their 90s, higher inflation-adjusted benefits may reduce pressure on portfolios later in life. Individuals eligible for the Guaranteed Income Supplement should generally not defer OAS because doing so delays access to that supplement.
A total wealth planning decision There is no universally correct age to begin CPP or OAS. Spouses may benefit from different starting dates, and taking one benefit earlier while deferring the other may make sense.
Before deciding, Canadians should prepare or update a comprehensive financial plan that models different scenarios for income needs, tax exposure, portfolio sustainability, and estate objectives.
The goal is not simply to collect sooner or secure the largest monthly cheque. It is to make these decisions within a broader total wealth plan that supports after-tax income and lasting financial security.

items.body:
テスラ、サイバーキャブの年内販売目指す　米当局は調査継続
10:56 配信

イーロン・マスク氏のイメージとテスラのロゴ。6月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Abhirup Roy

[サンフランシスコ ２１日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは２１日、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」の一般向け販売を年末までに開始することを目指していると明らかにした。同車には連邦規則が通常義務付けている手動操作装置がなく、米自動車安全当局が調査を進めている。

サイバーキャブは金色の２人乗り車両で、バタフライドアを備え、ハンドルやペダル、ミラーなしで自動走行する。

車両技術担当副社長のラース・モラビー氏は、第３・四半期決算発表後のアナリスト向け説明会で「テスラの成長に伴い、顧客に提供する車両は、自動運転専用に設計されたものが中心になる。サイバーキャブがその第１弾となる」と述べた。

「２０２６年末までにサイバーキャブを顧客に届けようとしている」とし、「今年は小規模にスタートし、顧客の手に渡る自動運転車の納車や保有、車両群の管理について学びながら規模を拡大していく」と語った。

テスラは９月上旬、テキサス州オースティンで少数のサイバーキャブによる有料乗車サービスを開始。しかし、その直後、米道路交通安全局（ＮＨＴＳＡ）は、同社がサイバーキャブについて連邦の自動車安全規則に適合すると判断した根拠を調べるため、調査を開始したと発表した。

大半の国では新型車や新技術の投入前に規制当局の承認が必要だが、米国では自動車メーカーが連邦基準への適合を自己認証すれば、公道に投入できる。

ＮＨＴＳＡはコメントを控えた。同局は９月、テスラによるサイバーキャブ認証の根拠と、どの範囲の基準について同車に適用されないと判断したのかを調べていると説明した。同社の回答期限は１０月３０日となっている。

items.title: Karachi’s unchecked urbanisation fuels heat water, infrastructure crisis
items.summary: Karachi’s built-up area has expanded by nearly 32 per cent between 2010 and 2025, surpassing 1,400 square kilometres, as agricultural land, grazing areas and open spaces continue to disappear under ...
items.body:
Karachi’s unchecked urbanisation fuels heat water, infrastructure crisis Karachi’s built-up area has expanded by nearly 32 per cent between 2010 and 2025, surpassing 1,400 square kilometres, as agricultural land, grazing areas and open spaces continue to disappear under concrete development, intensifying concerns over Pakistan’s urban planning failures, as reported by The Express Tribune.
ANI | Updated: 22-10-2026 14:19 IST | Created: 22-10-2026 14:19 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Karachi’s built-up area has expanded by nearly 32 per cent between 2010 and 2025, surpassing 1,400 square kilometres, as agricultural land, grazing areas and open spaces continue to disappear under concrete development, intensifying concerns over Pakistan’s urban planning failures, as reported by The Express Tribune. According to The Express Tribune, citing an official note from the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO), satellite-based analysis shows that rapid urbanisation has transformed Karachi’s surrounding landscape, increasing pressure on natural resources and essential infrastructure.
SUPARCO stated that the growing spread of buildings and paved surfaces is worsening the urban heat island effect, reducing natural water absorption and potentially increasing the risk of flooding during heavy monsoon rainfall. The consequences could include declining labour productivity, rising healthcare costs and greater pressure on electricity, water and drainage networks.
Urban planner M Toheed, associated with the Institute of Business Administration (IBA), said Karachi had lost around 40 per cent of its green cover over the past 15 years, while its built-up footprint continued to grow. The estimate requires further verification through comparable land-cover data. Toheed stated that the expanding concrete landscape was creating serious consequences for residents. Reduced vegetation and shade, combined with humid weather, make it harder for the human body to regulate temperature, increasing the risk of heat-related illness. The economic burden also extends to workers facing reduced productivity and households struggling with higher cooling costs.
Toheed said Karachi’s population growth had outpaced infrastructure development. He cited prolonged electricity outages in areas including North Karachi and Lyari, with interruptions reportedly reaching 18 hours on Baba Bhit Island. Unreliable electricity and water supplies leave residents with fewer ways to cope with extreme temperatures, while disrupting businesses and daily activities, as cited by The Express Tribune.
SUPARCO also linked the loss of natural drainage capacity to greater flood vulnerability, highlighting Karachi’s devastating 2020 floods as an example of the consequences of intense rainfall and inadequate drainage, as reported by The Express Tribune. (ANI)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mehnaz Yasmin　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コム...
items.body:
欧州新興企業、域外に大量流出リスク　規制など制約多く＝ＡＷＳ幹部
10:44 配信

米アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウドサービス部門ＡＷＳのロゴ。2024年4月、独ハノーバーで撮影。 REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

Mehnaz Yasmin　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウドサービス部門ＡＷＳの幹部は２１日、ロイターのインタビューで、欧州の有望なスタートアップ企業が域外に大量流出するリスクが高まっていると警告した。規制上の障壁や資金不足、人材のスキル不足を背景に、これらの企業は域外への移転を検討しているという。

欧州は人工知能（ＡＩ）分野で米国や中国との差を縮めるのに苦戦。厳格な規制に加え、エネルギー制約やデータプライバシーへの懸念が足かせとなっており、最先端のＡＩモデルを独自に生み出した例は少ない。現在はオープンＡＩやアンソロピックなど海外企業への依存が続いている。

こうした中でＡＷＳの欧州・中東・アフリカ（ＥＭＥＡ）地域担当マネジングディレクター、タヌジャ・ランデリー氏は「欧州企業は１ユーロを投じるごとに最大０．４０ユーロを規制対応に費やしており、その分を技術投資に回せていないと話している」と述べた。

またＡＷＳが実施した調査を引用して「欧州のスタートアップのおよそ１０社に４社が、事業拡大のため域外への移転を検討している。急成長企業に限れば、その割合は半数を超える。スタートアップ企業は十分な資金や支援を得られないことから、拠点の見直しを進めていると訴えている」と語った。

ランデリー氏によると、欧州企業の半数超がＡＩを活用している一方、明確なＡＩ戦略を持ち、ＡＩガバナンス体制を整備し、業務変革に向けた投資を進めている企業は５社に１社にとどまる。特に推論分野への投資を進める必要があるという。

欧州では世界で最も厳しいＡＩ規制の１つとされる欧州連合（ＥＵ）のＡＩ法や、深刻な電力・送電網制約が発展の妨げとなっている。

ランデリー氏は「欧州はより迅速に行動する必要がある。安全性と進歩は二者択一ではなく、両立できるものだ」と強調した。

Epic Games said its shooter title "Fortnite" will return to Apple's (AAPL.O) App Store in Australia on Thursday after a federal court ordered the iPhone maker to open up its iOS operating system, having found it violated competition law.

"We will request a stay and appeal the outcome to seek a resolution that respects our intellectual property and protects the safe, secure experience that consumers and developers expect from the App Store," an Apple spokesperson told Reuters.

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 21 : Tesla is aiming to start selling its Cybercab robotaxis to the public by the end of this year, its engineering chief said on Wednesday, even as the US auto safety agency probes the vehicles that come without manual controls which federal regulations typically require. 
The gold, two-seaters – that come with butterfly doors and drive themselves without any steering wheel, pedals or mirrors – are one of the key bets CEO Elon Musk has made in his ambition of turning the EV maker into an AI and robotics company.
"As Tesla grows, we'll mainly deliver fully designed autonomous vehicles to our customers and Cybercabs will be the first," Lars Moravy, Tesla's vice president of vehicle engineering, told analysts after reporting third-quarter results.
"We're trying to get Cybercabs to customers by the end of this year, 2026," he said. "As we start small this year, and we learn ... about delivery and ownership and fleet management of autonomous vehicles in customer hands, we'll continue to scale that."

After years of missed promises by Musk, Tesla started offering paid rides on a small fleet of Cybercabs in Austin, Texas, early last month amid a frenzy of fans and social media influencers. 
Just hours later, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said it opened an investigation into Cybercabs to assess how Tesla determined the cars comply with federal vehicle-safety regulations.
Those regulations, written decades ago for human-driven vehicles, require manual controls and limit commercial deployment of vehicles that are designed without them. 
Unlike most other countries, where new vehicle models and technology need regulatory clearance ahead of launch, automakers in the US can deploy them on the public roads by self-certifying that they meet federal standards.
NHTSA declined to comment. The agency last month said it was looking into the basis of Tesla's certification of the Cybercab and the extent to which the company determined that certain standards were not applicable to the vehicle. Tesla has until October 30 to respond to the agency. 
NHTSA has proposed changes to federal safety standards to allow AVs that are designed without human controls. Until those changes are complete, existing standards remain in force, NHTSA has said.    
SCALING THE CYBERCAB
"I think the key thing which we are trying to make sure is that we have all the regulatory approvals where we can start deploying the Cybercabs as fast as we can produce them," Ashok Elluswamy, Tesla's head of AI, said on the call.
That aside, "scaling would not be that much of a challenge," he said, adding that the Cybercab was "one of the easiest products" to scale in terms of manufacturing.
The Cybercab is part of Tesla's robotaxi network that includes autonomous Model Ys, some with human safety monitors. Over time, Tesla intends to make the Cybercab the main driverless vehicle model operating within a larger robotaxi network.
Tesla plans to expand the Cybercab service to Dallas next month, Elluswamy said. 
The vehicle, however, will mainly be Tesla owned and used for its ride-hailing service, Musk said.

items.title: 韓国中銀、政策金利据え置き　成長見通し改善で利上げ示唆
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Cynthia Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２２日、政策金利を３．００％に据え置い...
items.body:
韓国中銀、政策金利据え置き　成長見通し改善で利上げ示唆
10:08 配信

ソウルにある韓国銀行。２０１６年３月撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

Cynthia Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２２日、政策金利を３．００％に据え置いた。７月と８月にそれぞれ０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施した後、利上げを休止した。ただ、経済成長見通しを引き上げ、輸出の勢いについても楽観的な見方を維持し、タカ派姿勢を堅持した。

７人で構成する金融政策委員会は、７日物レポ金利を３．００％に維持することを決めた。ロイター調査ではアナリスト３４人全員が据え置きを予想していた。

中銀は、インフレや金融の安定、国内経済の動向を見極めながら「今後の利上げの時期とペースを判断する」とし、追加引き締めの可能性を引き続き残した。

声明で「今年と来年の成長率は、８月時点の予測であるそれぞれ３．３％と２．９％を大幅に上回る見通しだ」と表明。今回の据え置き決定は、対外リスクのほか、７月と８月の連続利上げが時間差で及ぼす影響を見極めるために必要だったと説明した。

来年の総合インフレ率とコアインフレ率は従来予測を上回るとの見通しも示した。

＜次回利上げ、柔軟に判断＞

申鉉松総裁は記者会見で、政策金利の最終到達点に関する質問にはコメントを控え、「（市場のコンセンサス予想が示す）道筋に厳密に従う必要があるとは考えていない」と述べた。 

あらかじめ決めた道筋に固執するのではなく、新たなデータをその都度評価していく方針を示し、「われわれ自身の考えを精緻化し、引き続き柔軟な姿勢で金融政策を運営する」と語った。

アナリストのコンセンサス予想では、１１月と２０２７年第１・四半期にそれぞれ追加利上げが実施され、政策金利は３．５０％でピークに達する見通し。

教保証券のアナリスト、ペク・ユンミン氏は「市場予想に盲目的に従わないという総裁の発言は、最終到達金利が３．５０％になることに疑問を呈したと解釈すべきではない。むしろ、実際の利上げの道筋が、予想されている１１月と来年第１・四半期という日程とは異なる可能性を示している」と指摘。「１１月の利上げを見送ることにはリスクがある。インフレ抑制に向けた断固たる姿勢を示すには、利上げの実施が重要だからだ」と述べた。

３年物国債先物はほぼ横ばい。市場では、中銀が１１月にも追加利上げを実施する可能性を示唆することがおおむね織り込まれていた。

７月と８月の利上げは、韓国中銀にとって３年余りぶりの連続利上げだった。申氏はその後、引き締めは緩やかなペースで進めることが望ましいとの考えを示していた。 

ただ、１０月１３日の国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のイベントでは、インフレ率が目標に収束するまで金融政策を制約的に維持すると改めて表明した。

９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）上昇率は２．９％と、８月の３．１％から鈍化したものの、中銀の目標である２％を引き続き上回った。

人工知能（ＡＩ）向けの世界的な支出を追い風に輸出は好調で、１─９月の輸出額は初めて８０００億ドルを突破した。

SEOUL: The Bank of Korea kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Thursday (Oct 22) but maintained a hawkish stance by upgrading its economic growth forecasts and remaining upbeat about the country's export momentum.
The seven-member monetary policy board at the BOK voted to keep the seven-day repurchase rate at 3 per cent, a decision that was forecast by all 34 analysts surveyed by Reuters.
The central bank said that further tightening remains on the table, stating it "will decide the timing and pace of future increases" while assessing inflation, financial stability and domestic economic trends.
"The growth rates for this year and next year are expected to be considerably higher than the August forecasts of 3.3 per cent and 2.9 per cent, respectively," the BOK said in a statement, adding a pause on Thursday was needed to evaluate external risks and the lagging effects of its back-to-back hikes in July and August.

It also said that both headline inflation and core inflation for next year will exceed its previous forecasts.
"The Bank of Korea left its policy rate unchanged at 3 per cent at today’s meeting, but we doubt this marks the end of the tightening cycle, and have pencilled in one hike for the BOK’s final meeting of the year in November," Gareth Leather, an analyst at Capital Economics said in a note after the decision.
The July and August increases were the central bank's first consecutive hikes in more than three years, after which Governor Shin Hyun Song said a gradual pace of tightening was preferred.
Shin, however, reiterated at an International Monetary Fund event on Oct 13 that policy would remain restrictive until inflation converges to its target.
Headline consumer inflation slowed to 2.9 per cent in September from 3.1 per cent in August, remaining above the bank's 2 per cent target.
Exports are powering ahead thanks to global spending on artificial intelligence. Shipments from January to September topped US$800 billion for the first time ever.
With growth expected to remain firm and inflation above target, median forecasts in the survey showed the BOK raising its base rate to 3.25 per cent at its November meeting, in line with the BOK's dot plot projection.
Shin will hold a news conference at 0210 GMT (10.10am Singapore time).
 
 

Source: Reuters/nh

items.title: Hormuz war risk pushes crude shipping costs sevenfold, squeezes refiners’ margins: Goldman Sachs
items.summary: War-related risks in the Strait of Hormuz and an increase in ship-to-ship transfers account for more than half of the USD 20 per barrel year-on-year rise in global crude oil freight rates, according ...
items.body:
Hormuz war risk pushes crude shipping costs sevenfold, squeezes refiners’ margins: Goldman Sachs War-related risks in the Strait of Hormuz and an increase in ship-to-ship transfers account for more than half of the USD 20 per barrel year-on-year rise in global crude oil freight rates, according to a report by Goldman Sachs (GS).
ANI | Updated: 22-10-2026 13:33 IST | Created: 22-10-2026 13:33 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

War-related risks in the Strait of Hormuz and an increase in ship-to-ship transfers account for more than half of the USD 20 per barrel year-on-year rise in global crude oil freight rates, according to a report by Goldman Sachs (GS). The surge in shipping costs is putting pressure on refiners, particularly in Asia, which rely heavily on crude oil imports from distant suppliers. These refiners may have to pass on the higher costs to consumers or accept lower profit margins.
Brent crude crossed USD 110 per barrel this week and was trading at around USD 111.51 per barrel at the time of reporting. Another crude oil benchmark was trading at around USD 99.31 per barrel. Goldman Sachs said global crude oil shipping costs are now seven times higher than a year ago. The report noted, “The global average crude freight rate surged above USD 20/bbl from USD 3/bbl a year ago.”
The increase in freight rates initially began in the very large crude carrier (VLCC) segment and on Middle Eastern routes but has since spread to all major crude trading routes, with long-distance voyages particularly affected.While most crude oil benchmarks do not directly include transportation costs, higher freight rates can affect refiners' profitability and influence their choice of suppliers. According to GS, “high freight rates may reduce refiners margin’ overall demand for crude and/or skew it towards more closely located crude supplier.”
The report identified five key factors behind the USD 20 per barrel year-on-year increase in average global crude freight rates. These include a USD 7 per barrel war risk premium for crossing the Strait of Hormuz, USD 4 from ship-to-ship transfers outside the Persian Gulf, USD 4 from higher maritime fuel prices, USD 3 from inefficient tanker allocation and increased vessel diversions, and USD 2 from restrictions on the Iranian tanker fleet. The report said these factors “will likely continue to support global freight rates as long as the conflict on the Middle East persists.”
Goldman Sachs said refiners that depend on crude imports from distant suppliers, particularly in Asia, face higher costs.“Refiners with greater dependence on imported crude from distant suppliers (e.g., refiners in Asia) would have to either pass higher freight costs on to final consumers or accept lower net refinery margins,” the report said. However, passing on these costs to consumers could be difficult in markets where alternatives to oil, such as electric vehicles in China, are widely available, or where retail fuel prices are regulated.
The rise in freight costs has put particular pressure on Asian refiners' profit margins. This could lead to lower refined fuel output and push up global fuel prices. Meanwhile, crude oil producers that depend on distant buyers may have to offer steeper discounts to maintain demand. In contrast, suppliers located closer to major consumption centres could benefit from a shift in demand.
The report said producers serving distant markets may need to “discount” their crude more heavily, while crude from more centrally located suppliers, such as Brent in north-western Europe and ESPO in Russia, “may gain from some demand reallocation.” Goldman Sachs also highlighted the impact of higher tanker operating costs, driven by rising crew salaries and bunker fuel prices. The report estimated that “global maritime fuel oil prices have increased by nearly $50/bbl, or 70% yoy amid weak exports from the Persian Gulf and Russia and resilient bunker demand from tankers and container ships.” (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

FAST

TOKYO: Major Japanese lenders see increased demand for funds among corporate borrowers compared with three months ago, a survey showed on Thursday (Oct 22), indicating the central bank's recent interest rate hikes have yet to tighten financial conditions.
Financial conditions are becoming increasingly important in predicting the timing of the Bank of Japan's next rate hike. The bank has said it will scrutinise how past increases affect corporate funding to assess how close its rate is from a level it deems neutral to the economy.
In a survey, that the BOJ conducted over Sep 9 through Oct 13, a diffusion index measuring the ratio of major banks that saw corporate fund demand rise versus those seeing demand shrink stood at +3, compared with -1 in a survey three months earlier.
A positive reading indicates more banks saw corporate fund demand increase compared with those that saw demand fall.
The BOJ raised its policy interest rate to a 31-year high of 1.25 per cent on Sep 18 and signalled a pivot towards a policy focusing on forestalling risk of inflation overshooting its 2 per cent target.

items.title: Balochistan killings raise questions over Pakistan’s record on enforced disappearances
items.summary: The bodies of two men previously reported missing after their alleged detention by Pakistani security forces have been discovered in Balochistan’s Kech district, while another family has renewed its ...
items.body:
Balochistan killings raise questions over Pakistan’s record on enforced disappearances The bodies of two men previously reported missing after their alleged detention by Pakistani security forces have been discovered in Balochistan’s Kech district, while another family has renewed its demand for justice over a disappearance dating back to 2015, as reported by The Balochistan Post.
ANI | Updated: 22-10-2026 12:29 IST | Created: 22-10-2026 12:29 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The bodies of two men previously reported missing after their alleged detention by Pakistani security forces have been discovered in Balochistan’s Kech district, while another family has renewed its demand for justice over a disappearance dating back to 2015, as reported by The Balochistan Post. According to The Balochistan Post, the bodies were recovered from the Saloi Kaur area of Buleda and identified as Yasir and Mehran.
Reports said both victims bore signs of torture, raising fresh concerns over alleged custodial killings in the region. Paank, the human rights wing of the Baloch National Movement, condemned the deaths and called for an independent investigation. The organisation said Yasir, a 19-year-old student from Minaz, Buleda, was allegedly taken from his home by Frontier Corps personnel on March 2, 2026.
Mehran was reportedly detained during a raid on his residence on November 16, 2025, and transferred to a military camp, the organisation said. Paank called for accountability and an investigation into the alleged involvement of security personnel.
Meanwhile, the Voice for Baloch Missing Persons (VBMP) continued its protest outside the Quetta Press Club for the 6,394th consecutive day on Tuesday. Relatives of Abdul Rehman Marri joined the demonstration, seeking information about his whereabouts and demanding his safe recovery.

items.title: Russia pounds Kyiv, Ukraine launches drones, despite talk of renewing negotiations
items.author: Olena Harmash, Gleb Bryanski
items.creator: Olena Harmash, Gleb Bryanski
items.summary: Ukraine said Russia fired at least 21 ballistic missiles in three waves. Russia said Ukraine launched 630 drones towards the capital Moscow during the night.
items.body:
Russia pounded Kyiv with ballistic missiles and Ukraine sent hundreds of drones towards Moscow overnight as the warring sides kept up a barrage of attacks despite the latest US push to end the conflict.
Russia said on Wednesday it was ready to resume US-mediated talks with Ukraine next month, after President Vladimir Putin hosted US envoy Steve Witkoff for talks in St Petersburg.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy [USN:L1N4670ZQ TEXT:"said he hoped"] negotiations, which would be the first since February, would take place early in November.
Ukraine said Russia fired at least 21 ballistic missiles in three waves. Russia said Ukraine launched 630 drones towards the capital Moscow during the night.
The two sides held an exchange of war dead, with Moscow handing over 252 bodies and Ukraine handing over 25, according to the Belta state news agency in neighbouring Belarus. Such exchanges have accompanied moves towards talks in the past.
But while Witkoff spoke of "some degree of momentum" after meeting Zelenskiy and European and NATO officials in Oslo earlier in the week, the Kremlin expressed doubts.
"The Americans sensed some new nuances (in Oslo) and told us about this. But these nuances, so to speak, do not entirely satisfy us," Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said.
A senior Russian official, briefed on the results of the Putin-Witkoff talks, said they were relatively short and not substantive. The American brought a set of proposals drafted in Oslo and handed them to Putin for review, the person said.
Another source close to the Kremlin said the US proposals included a scenario where Ukraine would cede all of its Donbas region to Russia in return for receiving a guarantee of its future security from NATO.
Russia says it launched the war, the deadliest in Europe since World War Two, in part to prevent Ukraine from joining NATO. It has repeatedly said it would not end fighting unless Ukraine cedes more land, limits the size of its forces and is permanently barred from forming alliances.
Ukraine, which says the invasion was an unprovoked war of conquest, has long dismissed Russia's conditions as a demand for capitulation that would leave it defenceless against future Russian attacks.
US PRAISE FOR 'HUMANITARIAN' PUTIN GOES DOWN BADLY WITH KYIV Zelenskiy's meeting with Witkoff was aimed in part at smoothing over a deterioration in relations with Washington this month, after President Donald Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel and lifted sanctions on Moscow.
Kyiv says Washington failed to provide early-warning data on Russian missile launches, throttled the SpaceX satellite system used to guide Ukrainian drones, and withheld missile defence systems bought on its behalf by Europeans. Washington denies any shift in policy to intentionally hamper Ukraine's forces.
Trump has repeatedly rebuked Ukraine for attacking Russian oil refineries while saying little about far deadlier Russian attacks on Ukraine. He called for Zelenskiy to be replaced and said Russia's actions in Ukraine have been "fine".
Zelenskiy, who long avoided any criticism of the Trump administration, has increasingly pushed back against what he describes as a shift towards sympathy with Moscow.
On Thursday Zelenskiy snapped back at Witkoff for saluting Putin as a "humanitarian" during his visit to Russia, when the US envoy thanked Putin for [USN:L8N4670PP TEXT:"releasing a 74-year-old American"] captured by Russian forces in Ukraine.
"Three waves of ballistic missiles have been launched at Kyiv by Russian 'humanitarians' since yesterday evening," Zelenskiy posted on X. "They used 21 missiles. Unfortunately, numerous sites across the city have been hit and damaged."
He said 2 people were killed and 34 injured, including five children, in attacks on a dozen Ukrainian regions.
Russia said it carried out a "massive strike" overnight on port infrastructure in Ukraine's Odesa region, as well as on vessels used by the Ukrainian military.
In Russia, two people were wounded near Moscow by drones launched towards the capital during the night, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin [USN:P8N44K018 TEXT:"said"] on Telegram. Most of the drones were downed at long range, he added.
In the Russian border region of Belgorod, one man was killed and another wounded by Ukrainian drones, local officials said.
With the frontlines of the war largely static, both sides have escalated long-range air strikes this year. Russia has particularly targeted the Ukrainian power grid, while Ukraine has aimed at Russian oil refineries. Both have struck data centres, commercial warehouses and Black Sea shipping.
The war has ground on for more than 4-1/2 years, defying Trump's pledge during his 2024 election campaign that he could end it in a day. No breakthrough emerged from three short meetings in Istanbul last year and three rounds of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi and Geneva at the start of this year.

items.title: Cricket Australia suspends Megan Schutt for breaching prescription medication use requirements
items.summary: Schutt received the ban from Cricket Australia for failing to adhere to requirements around the use of prescription medication, with the veteran right-armer to also miss the opening game of the ...
items.body:
Cricket Australia suspends Megan Schutt for breaching prescription medication use requirements  Schutt received the ban from Cricket Australia for failing to adhere to requirements around the use of prescription medication, with the veteran right-armer to also miss the opening game of the domestic Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) season as part of her suspension, as per the ICC.
ANI | Updated: 22-10-2026 11:52 IST | Created: 22-10-2026 11:52 IST

Megan Schutt. (Photo: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

In a massive blow, Australian pacer Megan Schutt has been ruled out of the final of the three-match series against New Zealand at home after receiving a two-match ban for medication use by Cricket Australia. Schutt received the ban from Cricket Australia for failing to adhere to requirements around the use of prescription medication, with the veteran right-armer to also miss the opening game of the domestic Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) season as part of her suspension, as per the ICC.
"Australian player Megan Schutt has been suspended for two matches," Cricket Australia confirmed via a statement as quoted by the ICC. "The breach was a failure to adhere to requirements under the Sports Science and Sports Medicine guidelines with regard to prescription medication. This relates to a single incidence which occurred while out of competition and was not for performance enhancing purposes," the statement added.
"The two-match ban includes all international and domestic cricket. We will continue to provide appropriate support to Megan and reinforce the standards and responsibilities expected of everyone representing our game," the statement continued. Schutt accepted the ban immediately and released her own statement to confirm.
"I fully accept the penalty handed down and apologise for failing to meet the standards expected of me," Schutt said. I am sorry for the attention this has caused and appreciate the support I have received. While this occurred out of competition and was not performance related, I understand that I am responsible for following the Sports Science and Sports Medicine Guidelines, which players receive regular education on, and I should have adhered to these guidelines," she added.
Australia currently lead the three-match T20I series against New Zealand 2-0 and will be looking to complete a series sweep in Sydney on Thursday. While Schutt has yet to take part in the T20I series, the 33-year-old was in good form during the recent ODI series with Bangladesh as part of the ongoing ICC Women's Championship as she collected 10 wickets across the three games. (ANI)

items.title: Austrian and Swiss women freed after 18 months in Niger reach Benghazi, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday.
items.body:
An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday.
[USN:L1N4530IW TEXT:"The Austrian"], identified by Austrian authorities as Eva G, who is in her 70s, was kidnapped in the desert town of Agadez in central Niger in January 2025. Little information has been released about which group was holding her or what demands they may have made. She had been living in Niger for years.
The Swiss woman was taken hostage in April 2025.
Without naming her, Swiss Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis confirmed in a post on X that the woman had been freed and said she was on her way back to Switzerland.
His ministry said the government formed a task force after her capture, including police and intelligence services, and that it had stayed in regular contact with Austria.
The ministry said that for reasons of privacy protection it would not provide more details about the case.
The Austrian Foreign Ministry separately confirmed the release of Eva G after what it called a "long, complex, and highly sensitive diplomatic process."
The two officials said the women were handed over to authorities from their respective countries and that the operation was overseen by Saddam Haftar, deputy commander-in-chief of Libya's armed forces.
Niger, like its neighbours Mali and Burkina Faso, is battling a jihadist insurgency linked to al Qaeda and Islamic State that spun out of a Tuareg rebellion in northern Mali in 2012. The fighting has killed thousands and displaced millions across West Africa's central Sahel region over the past decade.
Kidnappings appeared to intensify in Niger last year.

items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s main stock index rose more than 250 points, helped by financial and technology sectors, while U.S. stock markets also climbed higher.
items.body: TORONTO — Canada’s main stock index rose more than 200 points Wednesday, helped by gains in the technology sector, while U.S. markets also rose.  The S&P/TSX composite index was up 217.03 points at 36,324.99. In New York, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 360.21 points at 52,856.09. The S&P 500 index was up 44.60 points at 7,757.17, while the Nasdaq composite was up 278.04 points at 26,702.86.   The Canadian dollar traded for 71.14 cents US compared with 71.15 cents US on Tuesday. The December crude oil contract was down 67 cents US at US$97.15 per barrel. The December gold contract was up US$7.40 at US$4,150.00 an ounce. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 21, 2026.

items.title: Meta puts Muse agent at heart of AI strategy
items.author: CNA
items.summary: More than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half.
items.body:

Meta puts Muse agent at heart of AI strategy

More than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half. 

Meta’s Muse Charm offers real-time voice and avatar interaction in a small standalone device that does not require a phone. (Photo: Meta)

FAST

Meta introduced new non-voting shares on Wednesday (Oct 21) to help fund the social media giant's costly AI expansion, as executives laid out their vision for organising the company's future around its nascent AI agent business.
Shares of the Facebook and Instagram parent rose more than 4 per cent in extended trading. Meta also forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates and reported strong growth of its new consumer AI agent app Muse.
The company has been pouring money into advanced chips and data centres to compete more aggressively with AI market leaders OpenAI and Anthropic, propelling it to the vanguard of an emerging consumer AI agent race while also eroding its historically strong free cash flow.
Meta will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control.
